Maul trained in secret, hunting beasts and even a lone Padawan, until the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY finally let him loose. He duelled Qui-Gon Jinn on Tatooine and later killed him on Naboo, but Kenobi cut him in half and left him for dead. He survived, broken and half-mad, in the junk pits of Lotho Minor until his brother Savage Opress found him during the Clone Wars. Talzin's magick restored his mind and gave him new legs. Maul then became a crime lord. He took over Mandalore through Death Watch and forced Black Sun, the Pykes and the Hutts into his Shadow Collective. Sidious struck back by killing Savage, and Talzin was killed soon after, but Maul survived both blows and a final clash with Ahsoka Tano during the Siege of Mandalore. Under the Empire he ruled the underworld from the shadows as the head of Crimson Dawn, working through Dryden Vos and later Qi'ra. His hunt for Sith secrets on Malachor pulled him into the lives of Ezra Bridger and Kanan Jarrus. His obsession finally led him to Kenobi's hiding place on Tatooine, where their last duel ended with a single stroke. Maul died believing the boy Kenobi was protecting would avenge them both.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Maul.socialDesc: Maul, Darth Sidious's apprentice, survived being cut in half on Naboo to become a crime lord, then met his end on Tatooine at Obi-Wan Kenobi's blade.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Maul.timeline:
54 BBY - Birth on Dathomir

Born to Mother Talzin, leader of the Nightsisters. He grows up as a Nightbrother alongside his brothers Feral and Savage Opress.

~40 BBY - Taken by Darth Sidious

Sidious, once Talzin's ally, takes the angry young Zabrak from Dathomir to become his secret Sith apprentice. Talzin swears she will have her revenge.

~40 BBY - Training as a Sith

Maul is trained as a Sith warrior and assassin and builds his own double-bladed lightsaber. On Malachor, Sidious makes him breathe the ashes of fallen Sith, and the visions leave him hungry for revenge on the Jedi.

~33 BBY - Hunting on Twon Ketee

While restless for action, Maul hunts rathtars and stalks Jedi on Coruscant. Sidious warns him to stay hidden until the time is right.

~33 BBY - The Padawan Eldra Kaitis

With a crew of bounty hunters led by Cad Bane, Maul tracks down a captured Padawan who is up for auction. He kills her on Drazkel's moon, then kills the crime boss Xev Xrexus to protect the Sith's secret.

33 BBY - Kwenn

Sidious sends Maul to Kwenn while the pirate Zilastra plots against members of the Jedi Council. There he confronts the Jedi outpost's seneschal, Voh.

32 BBY - Duel on Tatooine

Maul tracks Queen Amidala to Tatooine with his probe droids and attacks Qui-Gon Jinn. It is the first time in a millennium that the Jedi have faced a Sith, and Jinn barely escapes.

32 BBY - Battle of Naboo

In the Theed power generator, Maul fights Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi and kills Jinn. Kenobi then cuts him in half and he falls down a reactor shaft, presumed dead. Sidious replaces him with Count Dooku.

32 BBY - Exile on Lotho Minor

Kept alive by his hatred, Maul ends up on a junk world. He builds himself a spider-like six-legged body and slowly loses his mind.

~20 BBY - Found by Savage Opress

During the Clone Wars, Savage Opress finds his brother with a talisman from Talzin. Talzin's magick restores Maul's mind and gives him cybernetic legs.

~20 BBY - Revenge on Kenobi

Maul massacres villagers on Raydonia to draw Kenobi out, then duels him aboard a tanker. He takes Savage as his apprentice.

~20 BBY - Skirmish on Florrum

The brothers kill Adi Gallia but are beaten by Kenobi and Hondo Ohnaka's pirates. They barely escape the crash of their ship.

~19 BBY - The Shadow Collective

Maul brings Death Watch, Black Sun, the Pyke Syndicate and the Hutts together into a criminal alliance. He uses it to seize Mandalore and makes Almec his puppet prime minister.

~19 BBY - Battle of Mandalore

Darth Sidious arrives and kills Savage Opress. He defeats and captures Maul to use him against his own allies.

19 BBY - Second Battle of Dathomir

Maul escapes Sidious and regroups his syndicates. In retaliation, Sidious sends Grievous to Dathomir, and Talzin dies protecting her son.

19 BBY - Siege of Mandalore

Maul sets a trap to lure Anakin Skywalker and Kenobi to Mandalore, but Ahsoka Tano leads the Republic forces instead. She captures him as the Jedi Purge begins.

19 BBY - Escape During Order 66

Maul breaks free when the clones turn on Ahsoka aboard their Venator. He flees as the ship crashes.

~18 BBY - The Shadow Lord

Now hunted by the Inquisitors, who call him "the Shadow," Maul works to rebuild his criminal empire in secret, away from the new Empire's eyes.

10 BBY - Master of Crimson Dawn

From behind the scenes, Maul controls the Crimson Dawn syndicate through Dryden Vos. After Vos is killed, he summons Qi'ra to take her place at his side.

3 BBY - Mission to Malachor

Maul reaches the Malachor Sith Temple, forms an alliance with Ezra Bridger and blinds Kanan Jarrus. He escapes after Darth Vader arrives.

2 BBY - Holocrons and Visions

Maul takes the Ghost crew hostage to force Ezra to join a holocron fusion. Through their shared vision, he learns that Obi-Wan Kenobi is alive.

2 BBY - Death on Tatooine

Maul follows Ezra to Tatooine and faces Kenobi one last time. Kenobi cuts him down in a single exchange, and Maul dies in Kenobi's arms, hoping the Chosen One will avenge them.

birth.source: Wookieepedia 'Maul' infobox (birth: 54 BBY, Dathomir) and Early life section: 'In 54 BBY, the boy who would be dubbed Darth Maul was born the son of Mother Talzin on Dathomir.'

death.source: Wookieepedia 'Maul' infobox (death: 2 BBY, Tatooine). He was killed by Obi-Wan Kenobi in the Star Wars Rebels Season Three episode "Twin Suns".

notes.detail: "Darth" is a Sith title, not a name or identity. Wookieepedia lists his names as "Maul" and "Darth Maul", and he was also known as the "Shadow Lord" (and simply "the Shadow" to the Inquisitors). "Darth Maul" or "Shadow Lord" would be a more useful altTitle.
Wookieepedia's infobox gives his species as Zabrak, specifically Dathomirian. It is optional, but it separates him from Iridonian Zabrak such as Eeth Koth.

Wookieepedia flags a conflict between the Ahsoka novel and The Clone Wars Season Seven over the Siege of Mandalore and its aftermath. The details of his capture and escape vary between the two. Our dates are unaffected.

The year Sidious took Maul (~40 BBY) is given only as 'around' that year. Much of his childhood comes from 'unreliable memories' and in-universe legends in the Darth Maul and Other Followers of the Dark Side / Myths & Fables material, and those accounts contradict each other. Treat the pre-Naboo events as approximate.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Huyang.description: Huyang is the Jedi Order's lightsaber teacher. The ancient droid spent a thousand generations aboard the training ship Crucible, helping younglings turn the kyber crystals they found during the Gathering into their first blades. His students included Yoda, Mace Windu, Bell Zettifar and Kanan Jarrus. His memory banks hold a record of every lightsaber and the Jedi who built it. His past is so old that younglings joked he had arrived at the Temple in a big blue box. During the Clone Wars he took Ahsoka Tano's group of initiates to Ilum. When Hondo Ohnaka's pirates raided the Crucible, he hid the students' crystals inside his own chest and kept fighting after losing his head and arms. He lived through the Jedi Purge. Years later he helped Ahsoka train Sabine Wren and flew with her as she searched for Ezra Bridger and Grand Admiral Thrawn. That search ended in another galaxy, where he gave Ezra a spare emitter he had made for Kanan and stayed on Peridea with Ahsoka and Sabine.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Huyang.socialDesc: Huyang is the ancient droid professor who taught Jedi younglings, Yoda among them, to build lightsabers, and later joined Ahsoka Tano's hunt for Thrawn.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Huyang.timeline:
~25,020 BBY - Built

The Mark IV architect droid is built. Stories say he reached the Jedi Temple in a big blue box. He goes on to serve the Jedi Order as a lightsaber architect.

Before 800 BBY - Teaching a young Yoda

He helps the youngling Yoda build his lightsaber. Huyang later calls Yoda's hunt for his kyber crystal an excellent story.

High Republic Era - Bell Zettifar's first saber

Aboard the Crucible, he oversees Bell Zettifar as he builds his first lightsaber and trains against remotes.

232 BBY - Repairing Barabo's lightsaber

Nubs, Nash Durango, RJ-83 and Yoda bring him the broken lightsaber of Jedi Master Barabo. He recognizes it at once and repairs it.

Before 19 BBY - Mace Windu and Kanan Jarrus

He guides Mace Windu through building his lightsaber. Later he helps the young Caleb Dume, who becomes Kanan Jarrus, and gives him one of two matching emitters he owns.

22 BBY - Legends among the initiates

Early in the Clone Wars, initiates getting ready for the Gathering trade rumors about how old he is and where he came from.

20 BBY - The Gathering on Ilum

He goes with Ahsoka Tano and a clan of younglings to Ilum. Back on the Crucible, he coaches them as they build and personalize their lightsabers.

20 BBY - Raid on the Crucible

Hondo Ohnaka's pirates board the ship. Huyang hides the initiates' crystals in his chest. He loses his head and arms to blaster fire but still beats a pirate.

20 BBY - Rescue on Florrum

Ganodi reattaches his head, and he helps fly the Crucible to pick up the others before it crashes. The Jedi and the pirates team up against General Grievous and escape to Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet, where Huyang is fully repaired.

19 BBY - Surviving the Purge

He outlives the Jedi Order's destruction and survives the years of the Empire.

Before 9 ABY - Training Sabine Wren

He joins Ahsoka Tano while she trains Sabine Wren, who finds the fussy droid irritating.

~9 ABY - Mission to Arcana

While Ahsoka looks for the star map to Thrawn and Ezra Bridger, he keeps her T-6 shuttle at a distance. He picks her up just before the HK droids explode.

~9 ABY - Investigation on Lothal

He scans the mercenaries' lightsabers and identifies Baylan Skoll as a Jedi-trained fighter. He stays with Sabine in the hospital after Shin Hati wounds her and helps pull data from a captured HK droid's head.

~9 ABY - Mentor to master and apprentice

He oversees Sabine's training aboard the shuttle and urges Ahsoka and Sabine to stay together.

~9 ABY - Another galaxy

After reaching Peridea, he gives Ezra Bridger the spare emitter matching Kanan's and praises Ezra's new blue lightsaber.

~9 ABY - Left on Peridea

When Thrawn gets away and Ezra goes home, Huyang stays behind on Peridea with Ahsoka and Sabine.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's Huyang infobox gives 'c. 25,020 BBY'. The 'c.' means the canon date is approximate, not an exact year.

death.source: No death is recorded. Huyang is still active in Ahsoka (~9 ABY), where he is left on Peridea, and he is listed for Ahsoka Season 2.

notes.suggested: Keep -25020 but show it as approximate (c. 25,020 BBY)
notes.detail: Wookieepedia gives 'c. 25,020 BBY', a circa date. The year comes from canon, so it is not a pure guess like startYearUnknown implies. It is still not exact, and showing it as a precise fact overstates it.
The infobox gives the model as Mark IV and the class as architect droid.

notes.suggested: Jedi Order; Galactic Republic; New Republic
notes.detail: These affiliations are listed in the Wookieepedia infobox.
He appears in the Young Jedi Adventures episode 'Nubs's Big Mistake', dated 232 BBY. Add it only if the timeline tracks that series.
At the end of Ahsoka Season 1 (~9 ABY), Huyang is stranded on Peridea with Ahsoka and Sabine, and he is expected back in Ahsoka Season 2. Keeping the end year open and unknown is correct.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Kanan_J.description: Kanan Jarrus is best known as the Jedi who survived Order 66 as a teenager and later helped build the rebellion that grew into the Rebel Alliance. He was raised in the Jedi Temple as Caleb Dume and became Depa Billaba's Padawan late in the Clone Wars. He fought beside her clone battalion on Kardoa, Mygeeto and Kaller until the clones turned on her and she died so he could escape. The smuggler Janus Kasmir taught him how to lie, steal and survive, and after that he went by a new name and drifted across the Outer Rim with his lightsaber hidden away. During the Gorse Conflict he met Hera Syndulla, joined her crew aboard the Ghost and became her second-in-command and her partner. Together they formed the Spectres cell on Lothal. Although he had never finished his own training, he took Ezra Bridger as his apprentice, defeated the Grand Inquisitor, and carried on after Maul blinded him on Malachor, learning from the Bendu to see through the Force. He also taught Sabine Wren to wield the Darksaber. In 1 BBY, during the fight to free Lothal, he held back a fuel explosion so that Hera and his friends could escape, and it killed him. He lived on through the Force as the loth-wolf Dume and through his son Jacen, and his voice was among those that helped Rey at Exegol.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Kanan_J.socialDesc: Kanan Jarrus, the Padawan who fled Order 66 as Caleb Dume, became a rebel Jedi, mentored Ezra Bridger and died saving Hera Syndulla on Lothal.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Kanan_J.timeline:
33 BBY - Birth

Born Caleb Dume. He is taken to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant so young that he never knows his parents.

~22 BBY - Youngling at the Temple

Trains with fellow initiates Tai Uzuma and Sammo Quid under Yoda. He builds his first lightsaber with help from Huyang, and with Depa Billaba he watches Ahsoka Tano's training session.

~20 BBY - Bombing at the Jedi Temple

Passes the Initiate Trials. He helps Depa Billaba stop the Separatist bomber Rackham Sear, and afterwards she takes him as her Padawan, which makes him a Jedi Commander in the Grand Army.

~20 BBY - Skirmish on Kardoa

On his first mission he is wounded in a droid ambush and saved by the clone trooper CT-1157, who earns the nickname "Stance" for it.

~19 BBY - Third Battle of Mygeeto

Skull Squadron covers him and his unit. Stance is killed, and Caleb defeats Colonel Coburn Sear, his first kill.

19 BBY - Battle of Kaller

At 14 he fights under Billaba in the last days of the Clone Wars. She gives him a holocron, and he fights alongside Clone Force 99.

19 BBY - Order 66

Billaba's clones turn on her, and she dies telling him to run. Hunter of the Bad Batch lets him escape, and he hides out alone in Plateau City.

19 BBY - Partnership with Janus Kasmir

The smuggler Janus Kasmir takes him in. He cuts off his Padawan braid, hides his lightsaber and learns to live as a thief while the clones Grey and Styles hunt him. Later he flees and takes the name Kanan Jarrus.

~18–11 BBY - Years adrift

Moves from world to world as a pilot, bounty hunter and ranger, keeping his Force abilities hidden and staying out of the Empire's sight.

11 BBY - Gorse Conflict

While hauling cargo on Gorse he meets Hera Syndulla. Together they defeat Count Denetrius Vidian, and he joins her crew aboard the Ghost.

~11–5 BBY - Forming the Spectres

Becomes Hera's second-in-command and builds the crew with Zeb Orrelios, Sabine Wren and Chopper, running raids against the Empire around Lothal.

5 BBY - Taking Ezra Bridger as his Padawan

Meets Ezra Bridger on Lothal and reveals himself as a Jedi while rescuing Wookiee slaves on Kessel. He then takes Ezra as his apprentice.

5 BBY - Capture and rescue at Mustafar

Captured by the Empire and interrogated by the Grand Inquisitor. His crew rescues him above Mustafar, where he defeats the Inquisitor in a duel. The Spectres then join Phoenix Cell.

4 BBY - Knighted on Lothal

A Jedi Temple Guard formerly known as the Grand Inquisitor names him a Jedi Knight in the Lothal Jedi Temple.

3 BBY - Blinded on Malachor

Maul blinds him during the mission to the Sith temple on Malachor.

2 BBY - Meeting the Bendu

On Atollon the Bendu teaches him to see through the Force and helps him repair his bond with Ezra.

2 BBY - Training Sabine with the Darksaber

Teaches Sabine Wren to use the Darksaber and helps win Mandalorian support for the rebellion.

2 BBY - Battle of Atollon

Survives Grand Admiral Thrawn's attack on Chopper Base with the rest of Phoenix Cell.

1 BBY - Death on Lothal

Rescues Hera from Governor Pryce's forces in Capital City. When a fuel pod is set alight, he holds back the blast with the Force so that his friends can escape, and he dies in the explosion.

1 BBY - Dume the loth-wolf

His presence in the Force appears to Ezra as a giant loth-wolf named Dume. Hera later gives birth to their son, Jacen.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

His voice is among the Jedi who encourage Rey in her fight against Darth Sidious.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and Early life section give 33 BBY. This matches his being 14 at the Battle of Kaller and Order 66 in 19 BBY.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox gives 1 BBY on Lothal: he died during the rescue of Hera Syndulla in Star Wars Rebels, 'Jedi Night'.

notes.detail: His birth name. He used it through the Clone Wars, including in The Bad Batch and Tales of the Jedi, before he became Kanan Jarrus.

notes.current: Star Wars Rebels, The Bad Batch
notes.suggested: Add Tales of the Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker
notes.detail: As Caleb Dume he appears in Tales of the Jedi, watching Ahsoka's training session with Depa Billaba. His voice is one of the Jedi voices Rey hears at the Battle of Exegol in The Rise of Skywalker (35 ABY).

Wookieepedia flags a continuity conflict over his Order 66 escape and early apprenticeship. The Kanan comic, The Bad Batch and Tales of the Jedi each tell it a little differently. This does not affect his birth or death years.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Maz_Kan.description: Maz Kanata is the ancient, goggle-wearing pirate queen whose lakeside castle on Takodana served as a neutral haven for smugglers, pirates and travelling musicians for about a thousand years. Her house had a single rule: no fighting, and no politics. She is Force-sensitive, but she never became a Jedi. Over the centuries she travelled the galaxy collecting relics, trusting the ones that spoke to her through the Force. During the High Republic she took in the infant Qort, who later became a Jedi, and stood beside her friend Sav Malagán when the Nihil attacked Takodana. She kept her abilities hidden during the Empire's reign. Even so, she helped Leia Organa plan her disguise as Boushh to rescue Han Solo, and in the years after Endor she left home again, sensing that the Force was out of balance. At some point she came into possession of Anakin and Luke Skywalker's lightsaber. Thirty years after Endor, she offered it to Rey and pushed her to accept her calling. When the First Order destroyed her castle, she put the saber in Finn's hands instead. Later she pointed Finn and Rose Tico toward a codebreaker on Canto Bight, and in the end she joined the Resistance on Ajan Kloss as an adviser to Leia. She mourned Leia's death and awarded Chewbacca a medal after the victory at Exegol.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Maz_Kan.socialDesc: Maz Kanata, the ancient pirate queen of Takodana, kept Luke Skywalker's lightsaber safe, pushed Rey toward the Force and later advised the Resistance.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Maz_Kan.timeline:
973 BBY - Birth

Maz Kanata is born, more than a thousand years before the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

~966 BBY - Pirate Queen of Takodana

Living in an ancient castle beside Nymeve Lake, Maz becomes known as a pirate queen. She gives young smugglers money, gear and contacts and eventually controls more than a thousand ports while the Republic is still young.

~966 BBY - Centuries of Collecting

Maz travels the galaxy for centuries, gathering relics and treasures. She stores them in her castle's vaults and in hidden caches that she logs in her Smuggler's Guide.

~240 BBY - Taking in Qort

Criminals leave a baby Aloxian at her castle. Maz calms him with a vonduun crab skull helmet and asks Jedi Master Sav Malagán for help, and the child, Qort, is taken into the Jedi Order.

232 BBY - Jet Pack Trouble on Tenoo

Maz visits her friend Marlaa Jinara on Tenoo to get her jet pack repaired. The pack malfunctions and flies off, and the youngling Kai Brightstar helps get it back.

~232 BBY - Nihil Attack on Takodana

Krix Kamerat's Nihil cell attacks Takodana's Jedi Temple. Maz and Sav Malagán watch Qort, freed from his mask, drive the raiders off.

19 BBY - Hiding Her Gifts

After the Galactic Empire rises and the Jedi are purged, Maz keeps her Force abilities secret.

1 BBY - A Voice in the World Between Worlds

Ezra Bridger hears Maz's voice while he is inside the World Between Worlds.

0 ABY - Striking Back at the Empire

Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Maz learns that the Empire has been gathering information on her. She hires a mercenary to hit Imperial targets on six worlds.

4 ABY - Planning Han Solo's Rescue

On Ord Mantell, Maz meets her "boyfriend" Chewbacca again and suggests that Leia Organa disguise herself as the bounty hunter Boushh to get into Jabba's palace.

~4 ABY - Han Solo Brings Trouble

After Endor, Han Solo comes to her castle to meet an Imperial defector with information about Kashyyyk. When Imperial forces follow him, Maz orders him to clean up the mess.

5 ABY - Mercy for Romwell Krass

Maz frees Imperial agent Romwell Krass and a New Republic pilot from her dungeon after their brawl and tells Krass to find peace. Sensing that the Force is out of balance, she sets off to explore the galaxy aboard the Tua-Lu.

9 ABY - Galactic Legend

Maz is now counted among the most famous pirates in the galaxy, and competitors at the Hunters tournament on Vespaara trade stories about her.

34 ABY - Counsel for Rey and Finn

Han Solo brings Rey, Finn and BB-8 to her castle. Maz challenges Finn's urge to run, and when the Skywalker lightsaber calls to Rey, she urges her to take it.

34 ABY - Battle of Takodana

The First Order destroys her castle. Maz gives the lightsaber to Finn, who fights beside Han and Chewbacca until the Resistance arrives.

34 ABY - A Union Dispute

While caught in a firefight, Maz sends Finn and Rose Tico to Canto Bight to find a master codebreaker.

35 ABY - Joining the Resistance

After helping Poe Dameron's Resistance with intelligence, Maz joins them on Ajan Kloss as an adviser. She urges them to find Exegol, is present at Leia's death, and gives Chewbacca the Medal of Bravery after the victory.

birth.source: Wookieepedia, Maz Kanata infobox and biography (born 973 BBY), which matches canon statements that she had lived more than a thousand years by the time of the First Order–Resistance war.

death.source: Wookieepedia gives no death date. She is alive at the end of The Rise of Skywalker (35 ABY).

notes.current: Episode VII: The Force Awakens, Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker
notes.suggested: Episode VII: The Force Awakens, Episode VIII: The Last Jedi, Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker
notes.detail: Maz appears by hologram in The Last Jedi during the 'union dispute' scene, sending Finn and Rose to Canto Bight. Lupita Nyong'o played her in all three sequel films.

English-language canon does not name her species, so 'Unknown' is correct. However, the Japanese edition of The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary calls it 'ギルブロジアン' (roughly 'Gilbrosian'). Wookieepedia also flags a conflict between Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide and that Visual Dictionary. Keep 'Unknown' for now.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Max_Reb.description: Max Rebo is the bandleader of the Max Rebo Band, famous for playing his red ball jett organ with his feet while the group entertained Jabba the Hutt and the crowd at his Tatooine palace. His brother Azool Phantelle was a swindler. Once, in Mos Eisley, angry locals mistook Max for Azool and chased him. Max ended the chase by throwing Azool's stolen money back to the crowd, and Jabba then put Azool to work as a waiter on his sail barge. In 4 ABY, Rebo was playing in the throne room when Oola was fed to the rancor and when Leia Organa arrived disguised as Boushh. He then rode the Khetanna out to the Great Pit of Carkoon, where he was drawn into a plot to poison Jabba. He was caught, but Luke Skywalker's rescue of Han Solo distracted the Hutt. Rebo escaped when the barge was destroyed. After Jabba's death he kept playing, and by 9 ABY he performed on a newer organ at Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary in Mos Espa, where Boba Fett visited more than once. When the Pyke Syndicate bombed the cantina, Garsa Fwip and his bandmates were killed, but Rebo survived a second explosion.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Max_Reb.socialDesc: Max Rebo, the blue Ortolan who played organ with his feet for Jabba the Hutt, survived the sail barge blast and later the bombing of Garsa's Sanctuary.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Max_Reb.timeline:
Date unknown - Birth on Orto

Maximilian Rebo is born on Orto, a cold world, to Jeph Rebo and his wife. His brother is Azool Phantelle.

Date unknown - Forms the Max Rebo Band

Rebo starts his own jizz band and becomes known for playing the red ball jett organ with his feet. Posters advertise "Max Reebo" as early as the Clone Wars.

~22 BBY - Name on the posters

Posters for "Max Reebo" are seen around the galaxy during the Clone Wars and later during the Imperial era, which shows his act was already well known.

~4 ABY - Mistaken for his brother

In Mos Eisley, people Azool had swindled mistake Max for him and chase him. Azool pulls him onto a speeder bike to get away. Max ends the chase by throwing the stolen money back to the crowd, and Jabba makes Azool a waiter on the Khetanna as punishment.

4 ABY - Playing in Jabba's palace

The band is playing for Jabba when Oola is dropped into the rancor pit, and is still there when Leia Organa arrives disguised as the bounty hunter Boushh.

4 ABY - Plot against Jabba

On board the Khetanna at the Great Pit of Carkoon, Rebo is drawn into a plot to poison Jabba. He is caught, but Luke Skywalker's rescue of Han Solo distracts the Hutt.

4 ABY - Escapes the sail barge

Rebo gets out alive before the Khetanna explodes over the Dune Sea.

9 ABY - Playing at Garsa's Sanctuary

Rebo now plays a newer organ at Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary in Mos Espa, backed by a Bith guitarist and the drummer droid R0-1N6. Boba Fett visits the cantina more than once.

9 ABY - Survives the Sanctuary bombing

The Pyke Syndicate bombs the Sanctuary during business hours. Garsa Fwip and the band are killed, but Rebo survives.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's infobox gives no birth date, and no canon source dates his birth. The earliest in-universe trace is 'Max Reebo' posters in The Clone Wars (~22–19 BBY), so he was an adult by then.

death.source: No death in canon. He was last seen alive in The Book of Boba Fett (9 ABY), after surviving the Pyke bombing of Garsa's Sanctuary.

notes.detail: Wookieepedia lists 'Max Reebo' posters in The Clone Wars ('Lightsaber Lost', 'Lethal Trackdown', 'Orders') and Rebels as appearances of Max Rebo. That means he was a working, advertised bandleader around 22–19 BBY, so a 20 BBY birth guess can't be right. Moving the guess to roughly 40–50 BBY would place him as an adult during the Clone Wars. Canon gives no actual birth year.

The Clone Wars and Rebels appearances are posters only, and the name is spelled 'Reebo'. Wookieepedia counts them as Max Rebo, but they are the only evidence for his age. Treat them as supporting the guess, not as a date.
His full name, Maximilian, was established in the short story 'Fancy Man' in From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi (2023).

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Chewbac.description: Han Solo's loyal co-pilot and best friend, Chewbacca spent more than two centuries fighting alongside the heroes who shaped the galaxy. A veteran of the Clone Wars, he escaped Trandoshan hunters on Wasskah with Ahsoka Tano and helped Yoda flee Kashyyyk when Order 66 was issued. The Empire enslaved him, and he was rescued from a Mimban prison by a young Han Solo, to whom he swore a life debt. The two pulled off the Kessel Run, won the Millennium Falcon from Lando Calrissian and became notorious smugglers, until a charter to Alderaan pulled them into the Rebellion. Chewbacca helped rescue Princess Leia from the Death Star, covered Luke Skywalker at Yavin, survived Hoth and Cloud City, freed Han from Jabba's palace and helped bring down the shield generator on Endor. After the war he helped liberate his enslaved homeworld of Kashyyyk and went back to his family, then returned to smuggling with Han after Ben Solo fell to the dark side. He was at Han's side when his friend was killed on Starkiller Base. He then flew Rey to Ahch-To, piloted the Falcon at Crait, survived his apparent death on Pasaana and fought at Exegol, where the Sith were finally defeated.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Chewbac.socialDesc: Chewbacca, the Wookiee warrior who co-piloted the Millennium Falcon beside Han Solo, fought from the Clone Wars to Exegol and outlived the Sith he defied.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Chewbac.timeline:
200 BBY - Birth on Kashyyyk

Born in the city of Rwookrrorro on Kashyyyk to Attichitcuk during the High Republic Era. He later marries Mallatobuck and has a son, Lumpawaroo.

20 BBY - Hunted on Wasskah

Captured by Garnac's Trandoshan hunting guild and taken to Wasskah as prey. He joins Ahsoka Tano, Jinx and O-Mer, builds a transmitter that calls in Tarfful's Wookiee relief force, and helps defeat the hunters.

19 BBY - Battle of Kashyyyk

Fights beside Yoda, Luminara Unduli and Tarfful against the Separatist invasion. When Order 66 is issued, he helps Yoda escape the clone troopers in an escape pod.

~19 BBY–10 BBY - Enslaved by the Empire

Captured with other Wookiees by Trandoshan slavers and made to cut wroshyr trees for the Empire. He is handed over to the Empire and moved between Imperial facilities before ending up on Mimban as "the Beast."

10 BBY - Meeting Han Solo

Han Solo is thrown into his cell on Mimban and the two escape together. Chewbacca swears a life debt to Han and joins Tobias Beckett's gang.

10 BBY - Vandor Heist and the Kessel Run

Takes part in the failed conveyex heist on Vandor and the raid on Kessel, where he frees enslaved Wookiees. He flies as the Falcon's co-pilot for the first time on the record-setting Kessel Run.

10 BBY - Showdown on Savareen and Winning the Falcon

Survives Beckett's betrayal on Savareen and helps hand the coaxium over to Enfys Nest. Han then wins the Millennium Falcon from Lando on Numidian Prime.

9 BBY - Hunted by Zuckuss and 4-LOM

Rescues Han from the bounty hunters Zuckuss and 4-LOM at Valtos after crime lord Nodo puts a bounty on the pair.

1 BBY - Hired at Mos Eisley

Chewbacca and Han agree to fly Obi-Wan Kenobi, Luke Skywalker and the droids to Alderaan. They find the planet destroyed and help rescue Princess Leia from the Death Star.

0 BBY - Battle of Yavin

He urges Han to turn back, and the Falcon's return drives off Darth Vader so Luke can destroy the Death Star. Chewbacca is later honored with a medal.

0 ABY - Rescue on Cyrkon

Rescues Rebel lieutenant Caluan Ematt from Cyrkon and escapes ISB Commander Alecia Beck.

3 ABY - Hoth and Cloud City

Escapes Echo Base with Han, Leia and C-3PO. At Cloud City, Lando betrays them to Vader and Han is frozen in carbonite. Chewbacca escapes with Leia and Lando.

4 ABY - Rescue of Han Solo

Gets into Jabba's palace on Tatooine as Leia's "prisoner" and helps free Han and defeat Jabba.

4 ABY - Battle of Endor

Fights alongside the Ewoks and helps destroy the Death Star II's shield generator, which lets the Alliance fleet destroy the station.

5 ABY - Liberation of Kashyyyk

With Han and New Republic allies, he frees Kashyyyk and its enslaved Wookiees from Imperial control. He then returns home to his family.

~28 ABY - Back to Smuggling

After Ben Solo turns to the dark side and destroys Luke's new Jedi, Chewbacca rejoins Han as a smuggler. The pair eventually lose the Falcon and fly the Eravana instead.

34 ABY - Recovering the Falcon

They get the Falcon back over Jakku, along with Rey, Finn and BB-8, and help bring the map to Luke Skywalker to the Resistance.

34 ABY - Battle of Starkiller Base

Plants explosives on Starkiller Base and watches Kylo Ren kill Han. He wounds Kylo, then flies the Falcon to rescue Finn and Rey.

34 ABY - Ahch-To and Crait

Flies Rey to Ahch-To to find Luke Skywalker, then pilots the Falcon to save the Resistance survivors at Crait.

35 ABY - Quest for Exegol

Travels to Pasaana and Kijimi searching for Palpatine's hidden world. He is captured by the First Order and seemingly killed when Rey destroys a transport, but he is actually held on the Steadfast and rescued.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

Flies the Falcon at the head of the Citizens' Fleet against the Final Order and sees the Sith finally defeated. Maz Kanata gives him a medal.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox (born 200 BBY, Kashyyyk). It matches Solo: A Star Wars Story, where Chewbacca says he is 190 at the Kessel Run in 10 BBY.

death.source: Chewbacca is alive at the end of The Rise of Skywalker (35 ABY), and no canon death is recorded. The Wookieepedia infobox leaves the death field empty.

notes.detail: 200 BBY holds up (infobox, plus 'I'm 190' in Solo at 10 BBY). One catch: the article body also says he was born 'one hundred and eighty years before the Clone Wars,' and counting from 22 BBY that gives about 202 BBY. It looks like rounding, so no change is needed. It's only worth knowing if someone questions the year.
According to Wookieepedia's Early life section, he was born in the city of Rwookrrorro.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Padm%C3.description:
"

Padmé Amidala is best known as the teenage queen who stood up to the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo, and later as a senator who argued for democracy and peace while the Republic fell apart around her. She grew up in a modest family, went on relief missions as a child, and entered public service young. Elected monarch at fourteen, she took the regnal name Amidala and often posed as one of her own handmaidens for protection. When the Trade Federation occupied her world, she escaped the blockade with two Jedi and met a slave boy named Anakin Skywalker on Tatooine. She then called for a vote of no confidence in Chancellor Valorum, which helped Palpatine take power. After that she returned home, won the Gungans over as allies, and personally captured Viceroy Nute Gunray to free Naboo. She served two terms as queen and then became Naboo's senator, where she led the opposition to the Military Creation Act and survived repeated attempts on her life. During the Separatist Crisis she fell in love with Anakin, her Jedi bodyguard, and married him in secret after the Battle of Geonosis. Through the Clone Wars she kept working for a negotiated peace. Her pregnancy fed Anakin's fear of losing her, and that fear helped drive him to the dark side. She saw the Republic become an Empire and confronted her husband on Mustafar, where he choked her. She died on Polis Massa after giving birth to the twins Luke and Leia, still insisting there was good in him, and her children would one day bring that good back out.

"
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Padm%C3.socialDesc: Padmé Amidala: teenage queen who defied the Trade Federation, then a senator who fought for peace, secretly wed Anakin Skywalker and died birthing twins.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Padm%C3.timeline:
"

46 BBY - Birth on Naboo

Born Padmé Naberrie, the younger daughter of Ruwee and Jobal Naberrie and the sister of Sola.

~39 BBY - Relief Mission to Shadda-Bi-Boran

At age seven she goes with her father and Senator Onaconda Farr on a relief mission to relocate the Shadda-Bi-Boran. The effort fails, and it shapes her lifelong commitment to helping others.

~38 BBY - Apprentice Legislature

At eight she joins Naboo's Apprentice Legislature. She later works as a junior senatorial adviser and studies at the Theed Royal Academy.

~34 BBY - Legislative Youth Program and Supervisor of Theed

At twelve she takes part in the Legislative Youth Program, where she has a brief romance with Palo Jemabie. The same year she begins a two-year term as supervisor of Theed.

32 BBY - Elected Queen of Naboo

She campaigns anonymously against the sitting queen, Sanandrassa, wins the election, and is crowned under the regnal name Amidala. She also recruits her handmaidens, led by her decoy Sabé.

32 BBY - Chommell Sector Summit

She hosts a summit of neighboring worlds to end Naboo's isolationism.

32 BBY - Blockade and Invasion of Naboo

She refuses to sign the Trade Federation's treaty. After droid armies occupy Theed, Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi rescue her.

32 BBY - Stranded on Tatooine

Disguised as the handmaiden Padmé, she meets the young slave Anakin Skywalker, whose Podrace win pays for the parts to repair her ship.

32 BBY - Vote of No Confidence

On Palpatine's advice she moves for a vote of no confidence against Chancellor Finis Valorum before the Senate. The move helps Palpatine get elected chancellor.

32 BBY - Battle of Naboo

She reveals her true identity to Boss Nass to win the Gungans as allies. She then storms the Theed palace and captures Viceroy Nute Gunray, and later presents the orb of peace at the victory celebration.

32–28 BBY - Rebuilding Naboo

She leads Naboo's recovery and the debate over planetary defense, which causes a lasting rift with Captain Panaka. She serves two terms as queen.

28 BBY - Steps Down and Becomes Senator

She refuses a proposed constitutional change that would give her a third term. Queen Réillata then appoints her senator for Naboo and the Chommell sector. On Coruscant she survives a Trade Federation plot against her and finds allies in Bail Organa, Mon Mothma and Mina Bonteri.

22 BBY - Assassination Attempts on Coruscant

She returns to Coruscant to oppose the Military Creation Act, and her decoy Cordé is killed in a starship bombing. After another attempt on her life, the Jedi assign Anakin Skywalker to protect her.

22 BBY - Retreat to Naboo and Tatooine

In hiding on Naboo she falls in love with Anakin. She goes with him to Tatooine, where his mother dies.

22 BBY - First Battle of Geonosis

She is captured trying to rescue Obi-Wan Kenobi, survives the execution arena, and fights alongside the Jedi as the Clone Wars begin.

22 BBY - Secret Wedding

She marries Anakin in a secret ceremony on Naboo, with C-3PO and R2-D2 as witnesses.

~22–19 BBY - Senator in the Clone Wars

She pursues peace talks, including with her old mentor Mina Bonteri. She uncovers corruption and survives kidnappings and plots, including the Banking Clan affair with Rush Clovis, all while keeping her marriage hidden.

19 BBY - Pregnancy

After Anakin returns from the Outer Rim sieges, she tells him she is pregnant. His visions of her dying in childbirth push him toward Palpatine.

19 BBY - Petition of the 2,000 and Birth of the Empire

She joins the Delegation of 2,000, which challenges the chancellor's emergency powers. She is in the Senate when Palpatine declares himself Emperor.

19 BBY - Confrontation on Mustafar

She flies to Mustafar to beg Anakin to flee with her. He accuses her of betrayal and chokes her.

19 BBY - Death on Polis Massa

She gives birth to Luke and Leia and dies soon after, telling Obi-Wan that there is still good in Anakin.

19 BBY - Funeral on Naboo

She is laid to rest in Theed, apparently still pregnant, to hide that the twins survived.

"

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and Early life section: born 46 BBY on Naboo. Consistent with her being elected queen at about 14 in 32 BBY.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 19 BBY on Polis Massa, two days after Empire Day, after giving birth to Luke and Leia (Revenge of the Sith).

notes.detail: She was widely known by her regnal title Queen Amidala, and posed as the handmaiden 'Padmé' while serving as queen. Either works as an alternate title.

notes.current: Episodes I–III, The Clone Wars (movie), The Clone Wars (TV series)
notes.suggested: Add Tales of the Jedi and Star Wars: Forces of Destiny if the timeline tracks them
notes.detail: Wookieepedia's update list includes the Tales of the Jedi episode 'Resolve' and several Forces of Destiny shorts ('Monster Misunderstanding', 'Raiders of the Lost Gundark'), and she appears in both.

notes.suggested: Consider timeline markers for queen (32–28 BBY) and senator (28–19 BBY)
notes.detail: Wookieepedia says she served two terms as queen ending in 28 BBY, then became senator. These are useful fixed points.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hondo_O.description: Hondo Ohnaka is the galaxy's most charming opportunist, a pirate whose career lasted decades and who kept turning up, for a price, on the edges of its biggest wars. Sold into slavery by his con-artist parents, he escaped, learned the criminal trade as an advisor to Porla the Hutt, then betrayed his master and fled with a band of fellow servants. He conned a collector out of a fleet of ships and built the Ohnaka Gang into a feared crew based on Florrum. During the Clone Wars he captured Count Dooku and then Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, hoping to ransom all three. The plan failed, and it made him a lasting enemy in Dooku, who later sent General Grievous to destroy his base. Hondo swung between foe and ally of the Jedi: he raided Felucian villages, kidnapped Ahsoka Tano, and then helped her and a group of younglings escape Grievous. He armed the Onderon rebels and fought off Maul and Savage Opress. After the Empire broke up his gang he worked alone as a smuggler and bounty chaser, became an unlikely friend to Ezra Bridger and the Spectres, and helped free Lothal. By the time of the First Order he had rebuilt his fortunes as the head of Ohnaka Transport Solutions on Batuu, a front for smuggling, and he quietly helped the Resistance after Crait.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hondo_O.socialDesc: Hondo Ohnaka, pirate king of Florrum, captured Count Dooku, aided Jedi and rebels alike, and was still running scams on Batuu in the Resistance era.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hondo_O.timeline:
Unknown - Birth on Sriluur

Born to a pair of con artists. His mother teaches him to pick pockets instead of singing him lullabies.

Unknown - Sold into slavery

His parents sell him, claiming it is an offering to the Weequay god Quay. He escapes by disguising himself as a policeman aboard a ship bound for Boonta.

Unknown - Advisor to Porla the Hutt

Starts as Porla's cupbearer and rises to become the Hutt's trusted advisor, learning the criminal trade along the way.

Unknown - Betrayal and flight

Plots with fellow servants to rob Porla of his skiff, vehicles and weapons, then leads the runaways into a life of piracy.

Unknown - Founding the Ohnaka Gang

Pressures a collector on Farana into handing over a Corona-class frigate, which becomes his flagship Acushnet, along with six Flarestar attack shuttles. He sets up a sprawling base on Florrum and becomes its pirate king.

Unknown - Mercenary days with Aurra Sing

Joins a mercenary crew with Aurra Sing, starts an on-and-off romance with her, and gets to know Jango Fett and Cad Bane.

~32 BBY - Auction of Eldra Kaitis

Bids at Xev Xrexus's auction for a captured Jedi Padawan, then pays to join the hunt for her. Aurra Sing's crew kills his men and steals one of his shuttles.

22 BBY - Capturing Count Dooku

Takes Dooku prisoner after the Count crashes on Vanqor and demands a spice ransom from the Republic. He then drugs and imprisons Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker too. All three escape, and the Jedi spare him.

~21 BBY - Raids on Felucia

Extorts nysillin from a Felucian village until Jedi and hired bounty hunters drive him off. He duels Anakin on a cliff edge before retreating.

~21 BBY - Sheltering Aurra Sing and Boba Fett

Gives refuge to Sing and young Boba Fett on Florrum, then persuades Boba to reveal where the Republic hostages are held. He secretly rescues Sing and keeps Slave I.

~20 BBY - Arms for Onderon

Delivers rocket launchers to the Onderon rebels at Anakin Skywalker's request.

~20 BBY - Raid on the Crucible and fall of Florrum

Captures Ahsoka Tano while trying to steal the younglings' kyber crystals. Dooku sends Grievous to seize Florrum and jail Hondo. The younglings free him, and he flies Slave I to rescue them.

~20 BBY - Defeating Maul and Savage Opress

Fights off Maul and Savage Opress after they turn part of his crew against him, fighting beside Obi-Wan Kenobi. He then loots the brothers' wrecked ship.

~20 BBY - Clash with the Blood Bone Order

Loses the plundered cargo of the Steady On when Lassa Rhayme and Asajj Ventress raid his base.

~19 BBY - Gang dissolved

The new Empire breaks up the Ohnaka Gang, and Hondo carries on alone as a freelance outlaw.

Imperial Era - Heist on Jedha

Helps Dok-Ondar take a kyber statue from the Temple of the Kyber and fights Chirrut Îmwe along the way.

~11 BBY - Hunting Qi'ra

Teams up with IG-88 to capture Crimson Dawn's Qi'ra on Ord Mantell. She turns the two against each other and collects bounties on both of them.

Imperial Era - Forged journal auction

Tries to sell forged copies of "Maz Kanata's Journal." The Rang Clan exposes the forgery, and the auction ends in a firefight.

~3 BBY - Brothers of the Broken Horn

Gets Ezra Bridger and Chopper involved in stealing Azmorigan's ship, which begins his friendship with the Spectres.

~2 BBY - The Wynkahthu Job

Leads the Spectres on a salvage job aboard a sunken Imperial transport and is arrested by the Empire.

~1 BBY - Liberation of Lothal

Helps Ezra Bridger and the rebels drive the Empire off Lothal.

~3 ABY - A Pirate's Fortune

Works with Kay Vess against the Rokana Raiders.

~34 ABY - Ohnaka Transport Solutions on Batuu

Runs a shipping front for smuggling at Black Spire Outpost, leasing the Millennium Falcon from Chewbacca for smuggling runs. He also helps the Resistance after the Battle of Crait.

birth.source: The Wookieepedia infobox leaves the birth field empty, and canon gives no birth year. He is already an established pirate captain at the Xrexus auction around 32 BBY (Darth Maul 2017), so he was born well before then.

death.source: The Wookieepedia infobox leaves the death field empty. He is alive and active on Batuu around 34 ABY (Galaxy's Edge), and no death is recorded in canon.

notes.current: The Clone Wars (TV series), Star Wars Rebels, Galaxy's Edge
notes.suggested: Add Star Wars Outlaws, if the timeline tracks games
notes.detail: Hondo is a main character in Star Wars Outlaws' 'A Pirate's Fortune' story expansion, set around 3 ABY. It is also why the Rokana Raiders appear in his affiliations. Wookieepedia's Update tag lists Star Wars Outlaws among sources not yet written into his article.
The Wookieepedia infobox lists both Sriluur and Florrum as homeworlds. Sriluur is correct as his birthplace, but Florrum is where his identity as pirate king is rooted.

No canon birth year exists, so keep the guess flag. 52 BBY would make him about 20 at the ~32 BBY Xrexus auction, where he already commands the Acushnet and a gang. That is plausible but tight, given his earlier years in slavery, as Porla's advisor, and in piracy. An earlier guess such as ~60 BBY might suit his decades-long career better, but either would be invented.
His last dated canon appearance is around 34 ABY on Batuu (Galaxy's Edge media). He is not recorded as dead, so an open-ended column is correct.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Morgan_.description: Morgan Elsbeth turned grief into an empire-building career and spent her life trying to bring back Grand Admiral Thrawn. She was a young Nightsister in 20 BBY when General Grievous massacred her coven and killed her mother, Selena. The Mountain Clan took her in, but its Matron cast her out after Elsbeth's push to arm the clan got the Matron's daughter Nali killed. Believing she was the last of her kind, she looked to the Empire for power and revenge. She made herself magistrate of Calodan on Corvus, industrialized the forest world and stripped planets of resources to feed the Imperial Navy. When Moff Isdain rejected her TIE Defender design, Thrawn took notice. He tested her in a staged fight and accepted her into his service, and she became one of his most devoted followers, running shipyards on Corellia. Long after the Empire fell, she kept Corvus under her rule. In 9 ABY she killed a New Republic envoy and burned the planet's forests. Around that time she hired Din Djarin to kill Ahsoka Tano, but the two teamed up against her. Tano beat her in a duel and forced her to reveal where the map to Thrawn was hidden. Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati freed her from New Republic custody. She took the map, finished the hyperspace ring Eye of Sion and jumped to Peridea, where she was reunited with Thrawn and the Great Mothers. There she received the Gift of Shadow and the Blade of Talzin, stayed behind to hold off the Jedi, and died at Tano's hands. Her sacrifice let Thrawn and the Great Mothers escape back to the galaxy.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Morgan_.socialDesc: Morgan Elsbeth, Nightsister survivor turned Imperial magistrate of Corvus, served Thrawn loyally and died on Peridea so he could escape exile.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Morgan_.timeline:
Before 20 BBY - Birth on Dathomir

Born to the Nightsister Selena and raised among the witches of Dathomir. Canon gives no birth year.

20 BBY - Massacre of the Nightsisters

General Grievous's droid army wipes out the Nightsisters. Elsbeth sees her mother killed in a duel with Grievous, destroys a commando droid with a knife, and escapes before collapsing.

20 BBY - Taken in by the Mountain Clan

Mountain Clan members find her unconscious and nurse her back to health. Their Matron shows her the burned Nightsister lands, and Elsbeth decides she is the last of her people.

20 BBY - Exiled by the Matron

Elsbeth leads a group of clan youths to a hidden Nightsister weapons cache, where she takes a pair of sickles. Separatist droids attack them and Nali, the Matron's daughter, is killed. The Matron casts Elsbeth out.

Imperial Era (before 9 BBY) - Magistrate of Calodan

Elsbeth wins control of Calodan on Corvus by promising the people wealth. She fortifies the city, industrializes the planet, and strips worlds of resources to supply the Imperial Navy.

Imperial Era - The TIE Defender Pitch

She presents her TIE Defender design on Coruscant. Moff Isdain rejects it as too expensive and seizes Corvus's factories, and the people of Calodan turn on her.

Imperial Era - Joining Thrawn

She defeats Rukh in a fight that Admiral Thrawn and Gilad Pellaeon have staged to test her. She admits she is after power and revenge, and Thrawn takes her into his service, stationing part of his 96th Task Force over Corvus.

Imperial Era - Industrialist of the Empire

As one of Thrawn's most loyal followers, she becomes a powerful starship builder with shipyards on Corellia, while Calodan suffers under her harsh rule.

1 BBY - Thrawn Lost

Purrgil carry Thrawn and the Chimaera away from Lothal and into exile.

After 5 ABY - Visions of the Great Mothers

After the Empire collapses, Elsbeth keeps her subjects in the dark and starts receiving visions from the Great Mothers. She begins working to bring Thrawn back.

~9 ABY - Burning of Corvus

She refuses New Republic envoy Nadura's call to stand trial, kills Nadura and her escort, and orders the forests around Calodan burned.

9 ABY - Confronting Ahsoka Tano

Ahsoka Tano arrives in Calodan demanding to know where Thrawn is. Elsbeth takes civilians hostage and refuses.

9 ABY - Hiring the Mandalorian

She offers Din Djarin her pure beskar spear to kill Tano. Instead, he joins forces with Tano.

9 ABY - Defeat at Calodan

Djarin wipes out her army and kills Lang, and Tano beats Elsbeth in a duel. Elsbeth reveals that the map to Thrawn is hidden on Arcana. Wing takes over Calodan and Djarin keeps the spear.

9 ABY - Imprisonment and Rescue

The New Republic arrests her as an Imperial sympathizer. Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati free her from the cruiser Vesper while she is being taken to trial.

9 ABY - Arcana and Seatos

She finds the ruined Nightsister stronghold on Arcana and sends Hati after the map. With the map in hand, she uses magick to unlock the route to Peridea at the reflex point on Seatos.

9 ABY - Launch of the Eye of Sion

Her Corellian operation is exposed, but the last hyperdrive is installed. With Sabine Wren as her prisoner, she makes the jump to the far galaxy just ahead of Hera Syndulla's fighters.

9 ABY - Reunion on Peridea

The Great Mothers welcome her on Peridea, and Thrawn arrives to praise her efforts.

9 ABY - Gift of Shadow

Elsbeth offers to stay behind and hold off the Jedi. She pledges herself to the sisterhood and receives the Gift of Shadow and the Blade of Talzin.

9 ABY - Death on Peridea

In a rematch with Tano she destroys one of Tano's lightsabers but is cut down. Her stand gives Thrawn and the Great Mothers time to escape Peridea.

birth.source: The Wookieepedia infobox leaves the birth field blank. The article only says she was born on Dathomir before the Clone Wars and was a young adult at the 20 BBY Battle of Dathomir (Tales of the Empire). Our 48 BBY guess is plausible but has no canon basis.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 9 ABY on Peridea, killed by Ahsoka Tano in Ahsoka Part Eight, 'The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord'.

notes.detail: Wookieepedia's lead calls her a Force-sensitive Nightsister. She uses magick to activate the map on Seatos, the Great Mothers give her the Gift of Shadow, and she wields the Blade of Talzin.

notes.suggested: Ahsoka, The Mandalorian, Tales of the Empire
notes.detail: Tales of the Empire (2024), episodes 4–6 (her 'Path of Anger' arc), shows her surviving the 20 BBY massacre, her time with the Mountain Clan, her rule on Corvus and her recruitment by Thrawn.

notes.suggested: Affiliation: Nightsisters / Galactic Empire / Thrawn's forces
notes.detail: The fact list doesn't show her Nightsister identity or her service to Thrawn, which are what define her. It could also carry her title (Magistrate of Calodan) as altTitle.
Canon gives no birth year. Tales of the Empire shows her as a young woman in 20 BBY, so any year from about 45 to 38 BBY fits. 48 BBY is acceptable if it stays labelled as a guess.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Kit_Fis.description: Kit Fisto was one of the Jedi Order's finest swordsmen, remembered as much for his easy grin in battle as for his skill with a blade. Already a seasoned Jedi Master before the Clone Wars, he trained the Padawan Nahdar Vebb, took part in Mace Windu's rescue of kidnapped children on Oosalon, and joined missions such as the troubled expedition to an underwater research station on Tordus. He survived the arena massacre at Geonosis and then led clone troops in the first battle of the war. As a Jedi General and member of the Jedi High Council, he fought alongside Windu on Hissrich and was sent after the fugitive Nute Gunray. That hunt led him into General Grievous's fortress, where Vebb was killed but Fisto came close to beating the cyborg. He later oversaw the quarantine of the brain-worm-infested ship carrying Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee, flew in the starfighter strike that got the rescue team off Lola Sayu, and fought underwater on Mon Cala, where he was captured and tortured before helping restore the planet's alliance and crown Prince Lee-Char. In the war's last days he went with Windu, Agen Kolar and Saesee Tiin to arrest Chancellor Palpatine. Palpatine revealed himself as Darth Sidious and killed him within moments.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Kit_Fis.socialDesc: Kit Fisto, the grinning Jedi Master and famed swordsman who nearly beat Grievous, fought across the Clone Wars and fell trying to arrest Palpatine.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Kit_Fis.timeline:
Unknown - Birth on Glee Anselm

Kit Fisto is born on the ocean world of Glee Anselm. Canon gives no birth year. He is later taken into the Jedi Order.

34 BBY - Rescue on Oosalon

Now a Jedi Master, Fisto is one of the Jedi who wait in reserve while Mace Windu lets himself be captured by the warlord Guattako, who kidnapped children to use as soldiers. By the time Fisto's group gets through the tunnels, Guattako is already dead.

~33 BBY - Shut Out of the Glee Anselm Peace Talks

An Anselmi official objects to Jedi involvement in the Republic-mediated peace talks after the Hope of Glee Anselm statue is stolen. He argues that a Nautolan like Fisto makes the Order biased, so the Republic hires bounty hunters instead.

Before 22 BBY - Training Nahdar Vebb

Fisto takes the Mon Calamari Nahdar Vebb as his Padawan. Together with Mace Windu and Shaak Ti, they investigate the Axil Research Station on Tordus and fight to keep the sinking facility from being lost to the ocean depths.

22 BBY - First Battle of Geonosis

Fisto is part of the Jedi assault team that storms the Petranaki Arena. He is one of the few survivors rescued by the new clone army, then leads clone troopers and Saber-class tanks for the rest of the battle.

22 BBY - Jedi General and Council Member

With the Clone Wars under way, Fisto becomes a Jedi General with his own clone unit and fleet, and takes a seat on the Jedi High Council. Vebb passes his trials and becomes a Jedi Knight while Fisto is away at war.

22 BBY - Operation on Hissrich

Fisto serves in Mace Windu's squad on Hissrich. He protects the native population from Separatist drilling, saves Windu from the droid commander AD-W4, and fights his way into the droid base.

22 BBY - Lair of General Grievous

Fisto tracks the escaped Nute Gunray to the Vassek system, only to find the trail was a trap set by Dooku that leads into Grievous's fortress. Grievous kills Vebb and Commander Fil. Fisto cuts off one of the General's hands, recovers Vebb's lightsaber and escapes, bringing back the location of Grievous's lair.

22 BBY - Attack on the Jedi Temple

Fisto is seen entering the Holocron Vault during Cad Bane's raid on the Temple. He is also among the Council members present when Todo 360 bursts into the communications center with a bomb.

~21 BBY - Brain Worm Crisis

From the Ord Cestus medical station, Fisto guides the infested ship carrying Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee in to dock. He then boards it once the Geonosian brain worms have been frozen, and finds both Padawans alive.

~21 BBY - Battle of Lola Sayu

Fisto flies alongside Saesee Tiin and Adi Gallia in the starfighter assault that breaks through the Separatist defenses. The attack lets Plo Koon's gunship reach the survivors of the Citadel rescue and get them off the planet.

~21 BBY - Battle of Mon Cala

Fisto leads clone SCUBA troopers against the Separatist-backed Quarren and protects Prince Lee-Char. Riff Tamson captures and tortures him. He is freed in time to join the final battle and watch Lee-Char crowned king.

20 BBY - Protecting the Chancellor

Fisto joins the Council's planning to guard Chancellor Palpatine at the Festival of Light on Naboo. As the war drags on, he takes a more active role on the Council.

19 BBY - Death on Coruscant

After learning that Palpatine is a Sith Lord, Mace Windu brings Fisto, Agen Kolar and Saesee Tiin to arrest him. Darth Sidious cuts down Kolar and Tiin, and Fisto dies only moments later.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's Kit Fisto infobox leaves the birth field blank, and no canon source gives a birth year.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 19 BBY on Coruscant, killed by Darth Sidious during the attempted arrest in Revenge of the Sith.

notes.detail: Canon (Star Wars: Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu / Wookieepedia) places Fisto among the Jedi on the Oosalon mission in 34 BBY, apparently already a Jedi Master. A 45 BBY birth would make him about 11 then, still a youngling. He also had to have fully trained Nahdar Vebb before 22 BBY. Nautolan lifespans are roughly human, so a guessed birth around 60 BBY or earlier fits canon much better. Canon itself gives no birth year.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Han_Sol.description: Han Solo is the galaxy's most famous smuggler-turned-hero, the cocky pilot of the Millennium Falcon who went from street thief to Rebel general. Raised as a scrumrat for the White Worms gang on Corellia, he escaped by enlisting in the Imperial Navy, where a recruiting officer gave him the surname Solo. He washed out of the Carida flight academy for insubordination and was sent to the mud of Mimban. There he met Chewbacca and deserted with Tobias Beckett's crew. The coaxium heist that followed cost him his mentor and his first love, Qi'ra, but won him the Falcon from Lando Calrissian and the record Kessel Run in twelve parsecs. Years of smuggling for Jabba the Hutt left him deep in debt, and then a charter job for Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi pulled him into the Rebellion. He rescued Princess Leia, saved Luke at the Battle of Yavin, and was frozen in carbonite at Cloud City before his friends freed him. He then led the strike team that destroyed the second Death Star's shield generator on Endor. He married Leia and had a son, Ben, but when Ben fell to the dark side as Kylo Ren, Han drifted back to smuggling. Rey and Finn brought him back into the fight, and during the Resistance assault on Starkiller Base he tried to bring his son home and was killed by him. A year later, Han's memory helped Ben turn back to the light.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Han_Sol.socialDesc: Han Solo made the Kessel Run in twelve parsecs, became a Rebel general at Endor, and died on Starkiller Base at the hands of his son, Kylo Ren.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Han_Sol.timeline:
32 BBY - Birth on Corellia

Han is born in a poor district of Corellia. His father, Ovan, is a shipyard worker at Corellian Engineering Corporation who tells him he is meant to fly ships, not build them, and later abandons him.

~24 BBY - Scrumrat of the White Worms

Han joins Lady Proxima's White Worms gang as a street thief and meets fellow scrumrat Qi'ra, who later becomes his first love.

13 BBY - Escape from Corellia

Han steals a vial of coaxium, defies Proxima, and flees with Qi'ra. She is recaptured at the spaceport, and Han enlists with the Empire to get offworld. The recruiting officer gives him the surname Solo.

13 BBY - Cadet at Carida

As Cadet 124-329, Han shows real talent as a pilot but keeps disobeying orders. He crashes a stolen TIE fighter and helps his fellow cadets rescue Beilert Valance on Qhulosk.

~10 BBY - Expelled and Sent to Mimban

A court-martial expels Han from the flight academy. He is sent to the 224th Imperial Armored Division as a mudtrooper corporal.

10 BBY - Meeting Chewbacca

On Mimban, Han is thrown into a pit with Chewbacca, a Wookiee held prisoner by the Empire. The two escape together and desert with Tobias Beckett's gang.

10 BBY - The Vandor Heist

The raid on a coaxium conveyex fails. Rio Durant and Val are killed, and the crew now owes a debt to Dryden Vos of Crimson Dawn.

10 BBY - The Kessel Run

Han reunites with Qi'ra and teams up with Lando Calrissian. He pilots the Millennium Falcon through the Kessel Run in twelve parsecs with stolen unrefined coaxium.

10 BBY - Showdown on Savareen

After Beckett betrays the crew, Han shoots him. Qi'ra kills Vos, takes his place in Crimson Dawn, and leaves Han behind. Han then wins the Falcon from Lando in a game of sabacc.

~10–1 BBY - Smuggler for Jabba

With Chewbacca as his co-pilot, Han smuggles for Jabba the Hutt. When he dumps a spice shipment to avoid Imperials, he ends up with a bounty on his head.

1 BBY - Charter to Alderaan

At Mos Eisley, Han agrees to fly Luke Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi and the droids to Alderaan. He finds the planet destroyed and the Falcon captured by the Death Star.

1 BBY - Rescue of Princess Leia

Han helps free Leia Organa from the Death Star and delivers the stolen plans to the Rebel base on Yavin 4.

0 BBY - Battle of Yavin

Han comes back at the last moment and drives Darth Vader off Luke's tail, which lets Luke destroy the Death Star.

0–3 ABY - Rebel Operative

Han flies missions for the Rebel Alliance while still trying to settle his debt to Jabba.

3 ABY - Battle of Hoth and Flight to Bespin

Han escapes Echo Base with Leia and falls in love with her. At Cloud City, Lando's hand is forced and Darth Vader captures the group.

3 ABY - Frozen in Carbonite

Vader tests the carbon-freezing chamber on Han. Boba Fett then takes him to Jabba on Tatooine.

4 ABY - Rescue from Jabba's Palace

Leia frees Han from the carbonite. His friends defeat Jabba at the Great Pit of Carkoon.

4 ABY - Battle of Endor

Now a general, Han leads the Pathfinders with Ewok help to destroy the shield generator protecting the second Death Star.

4 ABY - Marriage to Leia

Han and Leia marry on Endor soon after the battle. Han keeps leading operations against the Empire's remnants.

5 ABY - Birth of Ben Solo

Leia gives birth to their son, Ben, around the time of the Battle of Jakku.

~5–28 ABY - Racer and Pilot

Han spends the New Republic years in civilian life, flying and racing. Ben's growing darkness puts a strain on the family.

28 ABY - Loss of His Son

Ben falls to the dark side under Snoke and destroys Luke's Jedi temple. Han and Leia separate, and Han goes back to smuggling. The Falcon is later stolen from him.

34 ABY - Reclaiming the Falcon

Han and Chewbacca find the Falcon with Rey and Finn and help take BB-8 to the Resistance.

34 ABY - Death on Starkiller Base

During the Resistance attack, Han confronts his son, Kylo Ren, and begs him to come home. Kylo stabs him with his lightsaber, and Han falls into the weapon's core.

35 ABY - Memory on Kef Bir

A vision of Han appears to Ben Solo and helps him give up the name Kylo Ren and return to the light.

birth.source: Wookieepedia Han Solo infobox: born 32 BBY, Corellia; biography: "born ... on Corellia ... in 32 BBY".

death.source: Wookieepedia Han Solo infobox: died 34 ABY, Starkiller Base, Ilum (killed by Kylo Ren in The Force Awakens).

notes.suggested: Add "Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker"
notes.detail: Harrison Ford appears as Han in The Rise of Skywalker (35 ABY), in the memory/vision scene with Ben Solo on Kef Bir. If seenIn is meant to include posthumous appearances, add it; otherwise ignore this.

"Nerf herder" is an insult Leia throws at Han in The Empire Strikes Back. It isn't a nickname or second identity. The article lists only one alternate identity for him: his Imperial designation, Cadet 124-329.

notes.suggested: Add Affiliation: Rebel Alliance / Resistance; Rank: General
notes.detail: Han was promoted to general before Endor and later fought with the Resistance. Neither fact is tracked right now.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Bib_For.description: For decades Bib Fortuna was the pale, whispering gatekeeper at Jabba the Hutt's side. As Jabba's majordomo he ran the daily business of the Tatooine palace and decided who got to see the crime lord, while secretly hating his master and waiting for a chance to kill him and take over his empire. He had grown rich selling fellow Twi'leks into slavery, and he beat his rival Bidlo Kwerve for the majordomo job. He held the post by the time of the 32 BBY Boonta Eve Classic, where he woke a dozing Jabba for the end of Anakin Skywalker's winning race. In the early days of the Empire he paid Cid to recover the young rancor Muchi, a job Clone Force 99 carried out. He also handed out work to Han Solo and Chewbacca, stood beside Jabba when Darth Vader came to hire bounty hunters, and waited impatiently for Boba Fett to deliver the frozen Han Solo. Luke Skywalker got past him with a Jedi mind trick, and he survived the destruction of the Khetanna at the Great Pit of Carkoon despite being presumed dead. He then took over Jabba's palace as a bloated crime lord in his own right. His rule ended in 9 ABY, when Boba Fett and Fennec Shand stormed the palace and Fett shot him on his throne and took it for himself.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Bib_For.socialDesc: Bib Fortuna, Jabba the Hutt's majordomo, secretly plotted his master's death, seized the palace after Jabba fell, and was shot dead by Boba Fett.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Bib_For.timeline:
Unknown - Early life on Ryloth

Born into the Fortuna clan, a prominent family with close ties to the criminal underworld, he gets rich as a slave trader selling fellow Twi'leks.

Before 32 BBY - Becomes Jabba's majordomo

Enters Jabba the Hutt's service and beats Bidlo Kwerve for the post of majordomo. He gives Jabba the rancor Pateesa as a birthday present, and Kwerve ends up as one of the rancor's early victims.

32 BBY - Boonta Eve Classic

Watches the podrace from Jabba's private balcony and wakes the sleeping Hutt to announce young Anakin Skywalker's victory over Sebulba.

19 BBY - Recovering Muchi

Hires Cid on Ord Mantell to rescue the young rancor Muchi from Zygerrian slavers. He threatens her over the delays, then arrives at her parlor in person just as Clone Force 99 returns with the rancor.

~8–2 BBY - Dealing with Han Solo

Hires Han Solo and Chewbacca, along with Greedo, to steal Krestrel D'Naran's urn from Corellia. He then gives up Solo's location to Marshal Buck Vancto, on the condition that Vancto waits until the job is finished.

~0 ABY - Darth Vader at the palace

Is held at lightsaber point by Darth Vader, who comes to hire bounty hunters. He is present for the Empire's negotiations with Jabba the next day, and he later threatens the mercenary Saponza on Jabba's behalf.

3 ABY - The hunt for Han Solo

Chases Boba Fett over his late delivery of the frozen Solo. He runs the palace while Jabba is away at Crimson Dawn's gathering on Jekara, and he gives in when Fett storms the palace looking for answers.

~4 ABY - Kijimi power play

Helps Zeva Bliss take control of the Spice Runners of Kijimi from her mother, Zarah.

4 ABY - Rescue of Han Solo

Brings C-3PO and R2-D2 before Jabba and falls for Luke Skywalker's mind trick. He plots to kill Jabba during the execution trip to the Great Pit of Carkoon. Jabba dies there and the Khetanna is destroyed, but Fortuna survives even though he is presumed dead.

4–9 ABY - Crime lord of Tatooine

Takes over Jabba's palace with servants and slaves of his own, and grows obese from years of overindulgence.

9 ABY - Death

After the second rescue of Grogu, Boba Fett and Fennec Shand storm the palace. Fortuna greets Fett nervously, and Fett shoots him dead and takes his throne.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's Bib Fortuna infobox leaves the birth field empty. Canon only says he was already Jabba's majordomo by 32 BBY and served him for decades.

death.source: Wookieepedia's Bib Fortuna infobox gives his death as 9 ABY on Tatooine. Boba Fett kills him in The Mandalorian 'Chapter 16: The Rescue', in the post-credits scene.

notes.detail: Fortuna's death is shown in the post-credits scene of The Mandalorian 'Chapter 16: The Rescue' (Season 2 finale). The Book of Boba Fett only mentions it or shows it again in a Chapter 4 flashback.

Wookieepedia lists his Book of Boba Fett appearances as a mention in Chapters 1–2, a painting in Chapter 3 and a flashback in Chapter 4. He is never shown alive in the present day there. Keeping the entry is defensible, but it is a flashback-only appearance.
Canon gives no birth year. The only anchor is that he was already majordomo by 32 BBY and served Jabba for decades. Keeping -57 flagged as a guess is appropriate.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mace_Wi.description: Mace Windu was the Jedi Order's greatest champion in the last years of the Republic. He sat on the Jedi High Council and served as Master of the Order, and he was one of the few Jedi ever to stand toe to toe with a Sith Lord and win. As a baby he lost his parents and was taken to the Temple. He trained as a Padawan under Cyslin Myr and later under Yoda, and became a Knight around 50 BBY. He took Katri's seat on the Council after the deadly mission to Raxus Secundus, which he carried out alongside his friend Dooku. He trained Depa Billaba and invented Vaapad, a fighting style that channels his own inner darkness into controlled aggression, and his amethyst lightsaber became a symbol of his authority. He doubted Qui-Gon Jinn's claim that the Sith had returned, and he never fully trusted Anakin Skywalker. Even so, he led the Jedi rescue at Geonosis, where he beheaded Jango Fett. In the Clone Wars that followed he served as a general, a diplomat and an adviser to Chancellor Palpatine. Freeing Ryloth earned him the name "Hammer of Ryloth." In 19 BBY Anakin revealed that Palpatine was Darth Sidious. Windu went to arrest him and defeated him, but then Anakin turned on him, and Sidious killed him. The Empire used his attempt to justify Order 66 and later painted him in its propaganda as a traitor and a gang leader.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mace_Wi.socialDesc: Mace Windu, Jedi Master of the High Council and creator of Vaapad, led the Republic's clone armies and fell confronting Darth Sidious in 19 BBY.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mace_Wi.timeline:
72 BBY - Birth on Haruun Kal

Born to the most powerful members of his tribe. Like other toddlers on Haruun Kal, he gets an inoculation that leaves a small scar.

~71 BBY - Orphaned

Garu-bears kill his parents, but his mother hides him in a tree first. The tribe notices how strangely calm he is, and a visiting Jedi recognizes that he is Force-sensitive.

~71 BBY - Taken to the Jedi Order

In a tribal ritual he picks the shell of a lightsaber over a lushfruit and a puzzle pyramid. With the tribe's blessing, he is sent to the Jedi Temple to train.

~65 BBY - Youngling Trials

He struggles to build his first lightsaber around an amethyst kyber crystal until Professor Huyang teaches him patience. He spars with T'ra Saa and becomes friends with Sora Bulq.

60 BBY - Mission to Mathas

As Cyslin Myr's Padawan he helps capture Drooz, a con man posing as a Jedi prophet. Myr teaches him to rein in his anger and leave Drooz's punishment to the courts.

~50 BBY - Knighted

Finishes his training under Yoda and becomes a Jedi Knight. His early missions include protecting a kidnapped alien king, investigating Warden Mattis Coto at Devshi, and recovering the coaxium ultra formula on Ro Mira.

~50 BBY - Rescue of Depa Billaba

Rescues Depa Billaba and Sar Labooda from pirates and brings them to the Temple. He later trains Billaba all the way to knighthood.

~49 BBY - Jedi Master

Reaches the rank of Master in his early twenties, somewhere between 50 and 48 BBY. He creates the Vaapad fighting style with help from Sora Bulq.

~49 BBY - Incident on Raxus Secundus

He and Dooku recover the body of Master Katri and discover that her own Raxian guards killed her. After her funeral, Windu is given her seat on the High Council.

~45 BBY - Master of the Order

Becomes an elected leader of the Jedi, serving alongside Yoda, and carries a new electrum-finished lightsaber that marks his rank.

41 BBY - Ontotho Uprising

Helps end the conflict between the Daa Corporation and the Fylari, then knights Cere Junda for her heroism.

34 BBY - Mission to Oosalon

Lets himself be captured so he can find the warlord Guattako's hidden base. He puts his broken lightsaber back together with the Force and helps rescue 26 kidnapped children.

32 BBY - The Return of the Sith

Doubts Qui-Gon Jinn's report of a Sith warrior and turns down the request to train Anakin Skywalker. After Jinn's funeral on Naboo, he accepts that the Sith have survived.

~29 BBY - Watching Over Skywalker

Keeps a close eye on Anakin's training and reluctantly agrees to let Chancellor Palpatine mentor the boy.

26 BBY - Testing Kenobi and Skywalker

Helps stage Yoda's fake kidnapping to test Obi-Wan and Anakin as a team.

22 BBY - Separatist Crisis

Warns Palpatine that there aren't enough Jedi to protect the Republic. He assigns Kenobi and Skywalker to guard Padmé Amidala and follows Kenobi's discovery of the clone army.

22 BBY - First Battle of Geonosis

Leads a Jedi strike team into the Geonosian arena and beheads Jango Fett. This battle starts the Clone Wars.

22 BBY - Hammer of Ryloth

As a Jedi General, he frees Ryloth from Separatist occupation alongside Cham Syndulla.

~21 BBY - General of the Clone Wars

Leads clone troopers on the front lines, oversees the war effort from Coruscant, and serves as a diplomat and adviser to the Chancellor.

19 BBY - Suspicion of the Chancellor

Grows wary of Palpatine's increasing power and of Anakin's closeness to him, and senses the dark side gaining strength.

19 BBY - Death on Coruscant

After Anakin reveals that Palpatine is Darth Sidious, Windu leads Kit Fisto, Saesee Tiin and Agen Kolar to arrest him. Windu alone survives the fight and overpowers Sidious, but Anakin cuts off his hand and Sidious throws him to his death.

19 BBY - Legacy

Palpatine uses Windu's attempt to justify Order 66 and the Jedi Purge. Imperial propaganda brands him a criminal, but people like Cham Syndulla still remember him with respect.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and Biography: born 72 BBY (7905.355 C.R.C.) on Haruun Kal. This matches his stated ages: forty around 32 BBY and fifty around 22 BBY.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 19 BBY on Coruscant, killed by Darth Sidious in the duel in Palpatine's office (Episode III: Revenge of the Sith).

notes.current: Episode I, Episode II, The Clone Wars (movie), The Clone Wars (TV series), Episode III
notes.detail: Windu has a major role in the Tales of the Jedi episode "Choices", the Raxus Secundus mission with Dooku that the article covers, which is how he gets his Council seat.
The article gives him the epithet "The Hammer of Ryloth" and the alias "Solver" (used on the Metagos mission). One of these could go in altTitle.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Landoni.description: Lando Calrissian is the galaxy's most charming scoundrel: a card sharp, smuggler and self-styled "galactic entrepreneur" who once owned the Millennium Falcon and who, against every instinct for self-preservation, became one of the heroes of the Rebellion. As a young gambler flying with his droid partner L3-37, he joined the coaxium heist on Kessel, lost L3 in the raid, and later lost the Falcon itself to Han Solo in a rematch at sabacc. He then went legitimate, or close to it, with a mining venture on Lothal where he crossed paths with the Ghost's rebel crew, and he rose to become Baron Administrator of Cloud City on Bespin. When Darth Vader used the city to trap Luke Skywalker, Lando was forced to hand over his old friend Han, then broke the deal, evacuated his people, and set out to undo the damage. He helped free Han from Jabba's palace, took a general's commission, and flew the Falcon into the core of the second Death Star at Endor to deliver the killing shot. In the years of peace he became a father, only for the First Order to steal his infant daughter; after a fruitless hunt with Luke for the Sith assassin Ochi, he withdrew into solitude on Pasaana. Called back by the Resistance in 35 ABY, he rallied a vast fleet of ordinary citizens to turn the tide at the Battle of Exegol.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Landoni.socialDesc: Lando Calrissian is the smooth gambler who lost the Millennium Falcon, betrayed then saved his friends on Bespin, and flew into the Death Star II.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Landoni.timeline:
