~43 BBY - Birth on Socorro

Landonis Balthazar Calrissian is born on Socorro into the Calrissian family.

Before 10 BBY - Gambler and smuggler

Lando makes his name at sabacc, wins the Millennium Falcon in a game at Bespin, wins a moon in the Oseon Belt, and flies with his self-built droid partner L3-37.

Before 10 BBY - Debts and escapades

He runs weapons, pays off a debt to Dryden Vos's Crimson Dawn, and helps arm Petrusian slaves in an uprising against an Imperial outpost on Kullgroon before the Falcon is impounded on Vandor.

10 BBY - The Kessel heist

On Vandor, Han Solo stakes his claim to the Falcon at sabacc and Lando wins by cheating. He joins Qi'ra, Beckett, Han and Chewbacca to steal coaxium from Kessel, where L3-37 is destroyed and her mind is merged with the Falcon's navicomputer during the escape through the Maelstrom.

10 BBY - Losing the Falcon

After abandoning the crew on Savareen, Lando is tracked to Numidian Prime, where Han steals his spare card and wins the Falcon for good.

~5 BBY - Galactic entrepreneur on Lothal

Lando buys land on Lothal to mine minerals, wins Chopper from Zeb Orrelios at sabacc, and tricks the Ghost's rebel crew into helping him acquire a puffer pig from Azmorigan.

4 BBY - Smuggling the Spectres off Lothal

With Darth Vader hunting the rebels on Lothal, Lando lends them his droid and masking transponders in exchange for shield generators, allowing them to escape.

Before 3 ABY - Baron Administrator of Cloud City

Lando takes charge of Cloud City, a Tibanna gas mining colony on Bespin, running it with his aide Lobot while staying out of the Empire's way.

3 ABY - Betrayal on Bespin

Coerced by Darth Vader, Lando hands over Han, Leia and Chewbacca. When Vader keeps altering the deal, Lando frees his captives, orders the city evacuated, and flees with the rebels aboard the Falcon after failing to stop Boba Fett.

3 ABY - Joining the Rebellion

Lando throws in with the Rebel Alliance and begins the search for the carbonite-frozen Han, crossing paths with bounty hunters and Crimson Dawn along the way.

4 ABY - Rescue of Han Solo

Disguised as a guard in Jabba's palace on Tatooine, Lando helps free Han and survives the fight at the Great Pit of Carkoon.

4 ABY - Battle of Endor

Promoted to general, Lando leads the fighter assault on the second Death Star, flying the Falcon into its core with Nien Nunb and firing the shot that destroys the station.

4 ABY - Liberation campaigns

In the weeks after Endor, Lando helps drive Imperial forces from worlds including Cloud City as the Empire begins to collapse.

After 4 ABY - Life in the New Republic

Lando returns to business and adventures with Han, including a hunt for the missing Phylanx transmitter, and forms a relationship with Kaasha Bateen.

Before 35 ABY - A daughter taken

Lando becomes father to Kadara, who is kidnapped by the First Order while still an infant.

Before 35 ABY - The search for Ochi

Some six years later, Lando and Luke Skywalker track the Sith assassin Ochi of Bestoon to Pasaana while investigating the growing darkness, but the trail goes cold.

Before 35 ABY - The Hermit of Pasaana

Lando settles alone on Pasaana, where the Aki-Aki know him as the Hermit, while staying in touch with the Solo family.

35 ABY - Rejoining the fight

Lando helps Rey, Finn, Poe and Chewbacca on Pasaana, meets Jannah, and returns to the Resistance base on Ajan Kloss.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

Flying the Falcon with Chewbacca, Lando leads the Citizens' Fleet to Exegol to reinforce the Resistance, helping bring down the Final Order and end the war.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox: "c. 43 BBY, Socorro". The circa marker means it is an approximation, not a stated exact year.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox has no death field. He is alive at the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY and no later canon source records his death.

notes.suggested: Keep -43 but consider labelling it approximate
notes.detail: Wookieepedia gives his birth as "c. 43 BBY". The year is the accepted canon estimate, but the source marks it as circa, not exact. If the app can say "circa", use it. Otherwise the current value is still the best available figure.
The Aki-Aki of Pasaana knew him as "the Hermit". His full name is Landonis Balthazar Calrissian, and "Baron Administrator" is his best-known title. Any of these could fill the empty altTitle.

notes.suggested: Affiliation: Rebel Alliance / New Republic / Resistance; Child: Kadara Calrissian
notes.detail: The infobox lists Alliance, New Republic, Resistance and Citizens' Fleet affiliations and a daughter, Kadara, none of which we track.

notes.suggested: Consider Star Wars Outlaws, if games are tracked
notes.detail: Lando appears as a mentor to Kay Vess in Star Wars Outlaws (the Lando's Luck content). Otherwise the list covers his screen appearances.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Saw_Ger.description: Saw Gerrera is best known as the Rebellion's most uncompromising fighter, a guerrilla leader whose methods made even the Alliance keep him at arm's length. He first took up arms with his sister Steela during the Clone Wars, when a Separatist-backed coup put a puppet king on Onderon's throne. Trained by Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Captain Rex, their rebels helped restore King Ramsis Dendup, but Saw was tortured by the droid general Kalani and lost Steela in the final battle, a death he blamed on himself for the rest of his life. When the Republic became the Empire, he turned his fight against the new regime, formed the Partisans and hid the Erso family on Lah'mu. After Galen Erso was taken, he raised young Jyn as his own and trained her as a soldier before leaving her at sixteen to protect her. His bombings and willingness to spend lives made him a feared figure. Worn down by years of combat and dependent on a breathing apparatus, he broke with Mon Mothma and Bail Organa and set up his final base on Jedha, drawn by the Empire's kyber mining there. There he finally received Galen's message about the Death Star and showed it to Jyn. Then he chose to stay behind and died when the battle station's test shot destroyed Jedha City.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Saw_Ger.socialDesc: Saw Gerrera, Onderon freedom fighter turned militant Partisan leader, raised Jyn Erso and fought the Empire by any means until Jedha's destruction.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Saw_Ger.timeline:
~42 BBY - Birth on Onderon

Born on Onderon in the last years of the Republic and raised in the capital city of Iziz alongside his sister Steela. Records of his birth were later destroyed.

~22 BBY - Coup on Onderon

After the Separatists put King Sanjay Rash on Onderon's throne in place of Ramsis Dendup, Saw and Steela are banished from Iziz for defying him. They start gathering fighters for a resistance.

Pre-20 BBY - Rhydonium work camp

Held prisoner in a jungle rhydonium labor camp as a youth, where he develops his strange attachment to the volatile substance.

20 BBY - Jedi advisors arrive

With Lux Bonteri, Saw asks the Jedi Council for help. Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ahsoka Tano and Captain Rex come to train the Onderon rebels in guerrilla tactics.

20 BBY - Guerrilla war in Iziz

The rebels move into the capital and knock out the city's power generator with a hijacked tank. Steela, not Saw, is elected leader of the movement.

20 BBY - Capture and torture

A solo attempt to rescue King Dendup ends with Saw's capture and torture by the super tactical droid Kalani. His words persuade General Tandin to defect, and Tandin helps the rebels free him and the king.

20 BBY - Death of Steela

During the final battle in the Onderon highlands, the gunship Saw shoots down crashes near Steela, and she falls to her death. The Separatists withdraw and Dendup is restored, but Saw blames himself for her death.

19 BBY - Resisting the Empire

After the Empire is proclaimed, Saw's Onderonian fighters are branded insurgents and keep fighting. On Onderon he crosses paths with Clone Force 99.

~13 BBY - Takes in Jyn Erso

After hiding the Erso family on Lah'mu, Saw rescues young Jyn when Orson Krennic seizes Galen and kills Lyra. He raises Jyn as his own and trains her as a Partisan.

14 BBY - Kashyyyk

Leads Partisan operations against the Imperial occupation of Kashyyyk and fights alongside Cal Kestis.

~6 BBY - Leaves Jyn behind

Leaves the sixteen-year-old Jyn to fend for herself after her identity is put at risk.

5 BBY - Segra Milo

Meets Luthen Rael, disputes his fellow rebel cells' agendas and refuses to join a coordinated effort.

~2 BBY - Mission to Jalindi

Works with the Ghost crew's Ezra Bridger to sabotage an Imperial relay station and discovers an Imperial kyber shipment, but his ruthlessness drives the Spectres away.

~2 BBY - Break with the Alliance

Formally cut off and censured by Mon Mothma and Bail Organa's Alliance as an extremist.

1 BBY - Holdout on Jedha

Now dependent on a respirator and armored suit, Saw leads a Partisan insurgency against the Imperial occupation of Jedha City.

1 BBY - Reunion with Jyn and death

Saw receives defector Bodhi Rook and plays Galen Erso's message about the Death Star for Jyn. When the station's test shot destroys Jedha City, he stays in his base and dies in the blast.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox leaves birth blank and states that records of his birth and age were destroyed. Our 42 BBY guess fits a young adult in 20 BBY but has no canon basis.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 1 BBY on Jedha, during the destruction of Jedha City (Rogue One).

notes.detail: Canon intentionally leaves his birth undated. Wookieepedia notes that records of his birth and age were destroyed. Keep the guess flag. -42 is a reasonable placement.
Saw appears on Kashyyyk in 14 BBY in Jedi: Fallen Order (the article's 14 BBY infobox image). Add it if the timeline tracks games.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Darth_S.description: The Sith Lord who brought down the Galactic Republic and ruled the galaxy as its Emperor, Sheev Palpatine led a double life for decades. In public he was a mild senator. In secret he was Darth Sidious, apprentice to Darth Plagueis. He killed his master and took the Zabrak child Maul from Dathomir to train as his own apprentice. Then he engineered the Trade Federation's invasion of his own homeworld, and the crisis it caused won him the office of Supreme Chancellor in 32 BBY. Working with his second apprentice, Count Dooku, he ran both sides of the Clone Wars. That let him gather emergency powers, turn Anakin Skywalker into Darth Vader and wipe out the Jedi with Order 66. In 19 BBY he declared himself Emperor. His Empire held the galaxy for a generation until the Rebellion rose against it. At the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Vader turned on him to save Luke Skywalker and threw him down a reactor shaft. Palpatine had planned for this. Using dark side transference, his spirit moved into a failing clone body on the hidden world of Exegol. From there he set the Contingency in motion to destroy what was left of the Empire, created Snoke to steer the First Order, and built the Final Order. He announced his return in 35 ABY but was finally destroyed at the Battle of Exegol by his granddaughter Rey, who turned his own lightning back on him with the strength of the Jedi behind her.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Darth_S.socialDesc: Sheev Palpatine schemed as Darth Sidious to topple the Republic, ruled the galaxy as Emperor, and returned from death only to fall at Exegol to Rey.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Darth_S.timeline:
84 BBY - Birth on Naboo

Sheev Palpatine is born into the noble Palpatine family and grows up in Theed, where he learns politics and manipulation early.

65 BBY - Theed Power Generator Ceremony

As a rising figure in Naboo public life, Palpatine attends the opening of the Theed power generator.

52 BBY - Sith Apprentice and Senator

By now he is Darth Plagueis's apprentice, under the name Darth Sidious. With his master's help he is elected Senator of Naboo, which also makes him senator for the Chommell sector. Around this time he begins mentoring the young Wilhuff Tarkin.

42 BBY - Meeting Dooku

Rael Averross introduces Palpatine to Jedi Master Dooku. Later, after Dooku leaves the Order, Sidious draws him toward the Sith.

~40 BBY - Claiming Maul

On Dathomir, Sidious takes Mother Talzin's son Maul as his apprentice, breaking his promise to make Talzin his right hand.

Before 32 BBY - Murder of Darth Plagueis

Following the Rule of Two, Sidious kills his master in his sleep and becomes Sith Master. He trains Maul harshly and takes him to Malachor.

33 BBY - Testing Maul

Sidious rebukes Maul for his impatience and then tests his loyalty, setting him up to kill a Jedi Padawan in the Kellux system. He also has Maul kill the Bimm Voh, a former Jedi seneschal who had been passing him Jedi texts.

32 BBY - Invasion of Naboo

Sidious orders the Trade Federation to blockade and invade Naboo, and sends Maul after Queen Amidala. As Palpatine, he gets the Queen to call a vote of no confidence in Chancellor Valorum and is elected Supreme Chancellor. Maul is cut down by Obi-Wan Kenobi and presumed dead.

~32 BBY - The Clone Army

When he learns that Sifo-Dyas has ordered a clone army from Kamino, Sidious has Dooku kill him and take over the order.

22 BBY - Emergency Powers and the Clone Wars

During the Separatist Crisis, the Senate gives Palpatine emergency powers and he approves the Grand Army of the Republic. The Clone Wars begin at Geonosis, with Dooku, now Darth Tyranus, leading the Separatists.

22–19 BBY - Controlling Both Sides

Palpatine directs the war on both sides, piles up executive power, grooms Anakin Skywalker, and deals with the return of Maul and the Nightsisters.

19 BBY - Order 66 and the Empire

Palpatine lets Anakin kill Dooku, then reveals himself as a Sith. Mace Windu tries to arrest him and is killed, and Anakin becomes Darth Vader. Palpatine issues Order 66, declares himself Emperor, and fights Yoda to a standstill in the Senate chamber.

19 BBY–1 BBY - Imperial Reign

The Emperor rules largely unchallenged. He uses the Inquisitorius to hunt surviving Jedi and builds the Death Star.

1 BBY - Dissolution of the Senate

With the Death Star complete, the Emperor dissolves the Imperial Senate. The station is destroyed at the Battle of Yavin.

3 ABY - A New Target

The Emperor senses Luke Skywalker's power and orders Vader to turn the boy to the dark side or destroy him.

4 ABY - Death at Endor

On the second Death Star, the Emperor tries to replace Vader with Luke. Vader turns on him and throws him down a reactor shaft. His spirit passes into a clone body on Exegol.

5 ABY - The Contingency

His posthumous Contingency plan leads to the Battle of Jakku and the end of the Galactic Empire. Loyalists retreat to the Unknown Regions.

5 ABY–35 ABY - Rebuilding from Exegol

Kept alive by the Sith Eternal, Palpatine creates Snoke to lead the First Order and turn Ben Solo. He also builds the Final Order fleet of Xyston-class Star Destroyers.

35 ABY - Exegol Broadcast

Palpatine announces his return to the galaxy and destroys Kijimi to show the Final Order's power.

35 ABY - Final Death at Exegol

During the Battle of Exegol, he drains the life force of the dyad formed by Rey and Ben Solo to restore himself. Rey, backed by the voices of past Jedi, turns his lightning against him and destroys him for good.

birth.source: Wookieepedia 'Darth Sidious' infobox: born 84 BBY, Naboo; the biography says he was born 'eighty-four standard years before the Battle of Yavin'.

death.source: Wookieepedia 'Darth Sidious' infobox: died 4 ABY on Death Star II (original body) and 35 ABY on Exegol (clone body and spirit). His final death is 35 ABY in The Rise of Skywalker.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Asajj_V.description: Asajj Ventress is best known as Count Dooku's twin-bladed assassin during the Clone Wars, and later as one of the war's most unlikely redemption stories. Given away as an infant by her Nightsister clan, she grew up a slave on Rattatak until the stranded Jedi Knight Ky Narec rescued her and trained her as his Padawan. When pirates killed him, she turned to the dark side, took the planet from its warlords, and caught Dooku's eye. As his Sith acolyte she led Separatist forces, framed Obi-Wan Kenobi on Cato Neimoidia, killed Jedi Master Tholme, kidnapped Jabba's son Rotta, and fought Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker again and again. Dooku abandoned her on Darth Sidious's orders. She went home to Dathomir, helped Mother Talzin plot against him and trained Savage Opress, then watched Grievous slaughter her sisters. After that she drifted into bounty hunting and made uneasy alliances: she saved Kenobi from Maul and helped Ahsoka Tano clear her name. In 19 BBY she and Quinlan Vos tried to assassinate Dooku and fell in love along the way. When Vos slid to the dark side, she gave her life on Christophsis to save him, and that sacrifice brought him back. Talzin's magic later returned her to life. In the Imperial era she went back to bounty hunting, helped the clone Omega on Pabu, and then left her old life behind until the young Jedi Lyco Strata pulled her into new adventures.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Asajj_V.socialDesc: Asajj Ventress rose from Rattatak slave to Dooku's assassin, turned bounty hunter, died saving Quinlan Vos, and returned from death under the Empire.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Asajj_V.timeline:
50 BBY - Birth on Dathomir

Born into Mother Talzin's Nightsister clan.

~50 BBY - Given to Hal'Sted

To protect the clan, Talzin has Asajj's mother surrender the infant to the Siniteen criminal Hal'Sted, who takes her as a slave to Rattatak.

44 BBY - Found by Ky Narec

Hal'Sted dies during a pirate uprising. Asajj, now six, shows her Force power by hurling away a Weequay attacker, and the stranded Jedi Knight Ky Narec takes her on as his Padawan.

~34 BBY - Death of Ky Narec

After about ten years defending Rattatak together, Narec is shot dead by pirates. Asajj kills his attackers with his lightsaber and turns to the dark side.

~34 BBY - Conquest of Rattatak

She wages a war of vengeance against the warlords and takes the planet for herself, but her attempt on Osika Kirske fails and she is forced to fight as a gladiator.

23 BBY - Acolyte of Count Dooku

Dooku kills Kirske and recruits her. She pledges herself to him on Serenno, receives her curved red lightsabers, and becomes a Separatist commander.

~23 BBY - Killing of Jenza

On Dooku's orders she tracks down his sister Jenza, kills the Republic Intelligence officer Raz Fellidrone, and then kills Jenza herself.

22 BBY - Cato Neimoidia

Sent as the Separatist emissary, she frames Obi-Wan Kenobi for a bombing, manipulates the young guard Ketar Nor, and duels Anakin Skywalker while trying to lure away the initiate Mill Alibeth.

22 BBY - Execution of Tholme

She defeats Jedi Master Tholme in battle and executes him against Dooku's orders, then brings his lightsaber to the count as a trophy.

22 BBY - Battle of Christophsis

She commands the Separatist invasion, turns clone Sergeant Slick into a traitor, and duels Kenobi and Skywalker to cover the arrival of droid reinforcements.

22 BBY - Kidnapping of Rotta

She abducts Jabba's son and holds him on Teth to frame the Jedi, then loses to Skywalker at the monastery and again on Tatooine.

~22 BBY - Rescue of Nute Gunray

She frees the captured Viceroy from Republic custody aboard the Tranquility, fighting Luminara Unduli and Ahsoka Tano.

~21 BBY - Infiltration of Kamino

During the Separatist assault on the clone homeworld, she steals DNA data and fights Kenobi and Skywalker.

~21 BBY - Betrayed by Dooku

On Darth Sidious's orders, Dooku abandons her to die after a failed mission. She survives and goes back to the Nightsisters on Dathomir.

~21 BBY - Plots against Dooku

With Mother Talzin she tries to assassinate Dooku, then trains Savage Opress and plants him with Dooku as a Nightsister pawn.

~20 BBY - Massacre of the Nightsisters

Grievous's army wipes out her clan. Ventress survives and leaves Dathomir to wander the galaxy.

~20 BBY - Bounty hunter

She works as a bounty hunter, including a job with Boba Fett's crew. She also saves Kenobi from Maul and Savage Opress above Raydonia.

19 BBY - Helping Ahsoka Tano

She helps the fugitive Ahsoka Tano hunt for the real Jedi Temple bomber.

19 BBY - Quinlan Vos

The Jedi Order sends Quinlan Vos to work with her on killing Dooku. She teaches him the dark side and they fall in love, but the attempt on Raxus Secundus fails.

19 BBY - Rescue of Vos

She teams up with Kenobi and the Jedi Council to rescue Vos from Dooku, then sees that he has fallen to the dark side.

19 BBY - Death on Christophsis

During the second battle of Christophsis she takes a lightning attack from Dooku that was meant for Vos. She dies having embraced the light, and her death brings Vos back from the dark side.

19 BBY - Resurrection

Vos and Kenobi return her body to Dathomir. In the spirit world, Talzin's voice offers her life again at the cost of her heart's desire, and she accepts.

~18 BBY - Encounter on Pabu

Back to bounty hunting under the Empire, she briefly helps the clone Omega on Pabu and teaches her about the Force.

Imperial era - Security guard

She leaves her old life for a quiet job as a security guard on a remote asteroid.

Imperial era - Allied with Lyco Strata

She helps the young Jedi Lyco Strata escape stormtroopers and an Inquisitor, then goes on further missions with him.

birth.source: The Wookieepedia infobox gives her birth as 50 BBY on Dathomir, and the biography agrees: she was six when Hal'Sted died in 44 BBY.

death.source: Wookieepedia says she died in 19 BBY on Christophsis (Dark Disciple) but was resurrected (The Bad Batch, Tales of the Underworld). She is alive by the end of her canon appearances and has no final death recorded.

notes.current: The Clone Wars (TV series), The Bad Batch
notes.suggested: The Clone Wars (TV series), The Bad Batch, Tales of the Underworld
notes.detail: Ventress stars in the Tales of the Underworld anthology (2025). Those episodes show her resurrection and her missions with the Jedi Lyco Strata, which Wookieepedia's summary also covers.

notes.suggested: Note her 19 BBY death on Christophsis and her resurrection.
notes.detail: She died in 19 BBY (Dark Disciple) and was brought back by Talzin's magic. The open-ended endYear is correct, but the timeline could show this event, since readers of Dark Disciple may think she is still dead.
Wookieepedia lists her species as Zabrak, with Dathomirian as a clarification. That is fine as it stands, but adding the Dathomirian qualifier would be more precise.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rose_Ti.description: Rose Tico is best known as the Resistance mechanic who teamed up with Finn to try to stop the First Order from tracking the fleeing Resistance through hyperspace, and for her line that the war would be won by saving what they love, not fighting what they hate. She and her older sister Paige fought the First Order's exploitation of their mining homeworld and joined the Resistance after it. The First Order later wiped out their people. Rose worked on the ground crew as a quiet, book-smart engineer while Paige flew as a bomber gunner. After Paige died destroying a Dreadnought during the evacuation of D'Qar, Rose caught Finn trying to leave the Raddus, then went with him and BB-8 on a mission to Canto Bight to find a codebreaker. The slicer DJ betrayed them aboard the Supremacy, and they barely escaped execution. At Crait she wrecked her own ski speeder to stop Finn's suicide run, and was badly hurt doing it. Over the next year she helped rebuild the Resistance, including missions to Mon Cala and Minfar. Leia Organa promoted her to commander of the Engineering Corps, where she worked on ways to beat hyperspace tracking. During the final campaign against the returned Emperor she studied Star Destroyer specifications and joined the ground team that boarded the Steadfast at Exegol, and she was at the victory celebration on Ajan Kloss afterward.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rose_Ti.socialDesc: Rose Tico, Resistance mechanic who lost her sister at D'Qar, tried to disable the First Order's tracker with Finn, and fought on to victory at Exegol.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rose_Ti.timeline:
~11 ABY - Birth on Hays Minor

Rose is born to Hue and Thanya Tico on Hays Minor, a poor mining world in the Otomok system, a few years after her sister Paige.

~20 ABY - Childhood with Paige

The sisters grow up flying their grandmother Etta's Z-95 simulator and watching fathier races. Their mother tells them that whatever their world lacks, they will always have the sky.

~33 ABY - Resisting the First Order on Hays Minor

The First Order takes over the planet's mines. Rose blows up twelve OreDiggers and stops mining for three days. Her parents urge both daughters to go and find the Resistance.

~33 ABY - Joining the Resistance

Admirals Ackbar and Holdo welcome Rose and Paige into the Resistance, and they join Cobalt Squadron, Rose as a mechanic and Paige as a gunner. When they learn the First Order has wiped out their people, Leia Organa offers her condolences and the sisters commit themselves to the cause.

~34 ABY - Rose's trucks on D'Qar

Rose builds wheeled trucks from the D'Qar junk heap. On a test drive she rescues Paige from a ravine, and together they find valuable durasteel ore.

34 ABY - Atterra mission

Rose and Paige fly aboard the bomber Cobalt Hammer on a fact-finding mission to learn what the First Order is doing to the settlements in the Atterra system.

34 ABY - Freeing the Raddus hangar

After studying the Raddus's manuals, Rose finds a Calamarian reboot code that opens a jammed hangar door, so X-wings can launch to help Poe Dameron.

34 ABY - Battle of D'Qar and Paige's death

While the Resistance evacuates D'Qar, Paige gives her life to destroy the Dreadnought Fulminatrix. Rose is devastated.

34 ABY - Meeting Finn

While guarding the escape pods during the chase through the Oetchi system, Rose stuns Finn as he tries to leave. Together they work out a plan to disable the First Order's hyperspace tracker aboard the Supremacy.

34 ABY - Mission to Canto Bight

Rose, Finn and BB-8 look for the Master Codebreaker, are arrested, and escape with the help of the slicer DJ. They free the abused fathiers, and Rose gives her Resistance ring to the stable boy Temiri Blagg.

34 ABY - Captured aboard the Supremacy

DJ betrays the group once they are inside the flagship. Rose bites General Hux, and she and Finn are saved from execution when Holdo rams the fleet. They escape to Crait in a stolen shuttle.

34 ABY - Battle of Crait

Rose flies a ski speeder against the siege cannon and crashes into Finn's speeder to stop his suicide run. She kisses him before passing out, and escapes unconscious aboard the Millennium Falcon.

34 ABY - Recovery and the Attack on Ryloth

Rose recovers aboard the Falcon, and she and Finn agree to stay friends. When the Resistance's hideout on Ryloth is betrayed, she helps coordinate the escape.

34 ABY - Mission to Mon Cala

Rose repairs the Falcon with Leia and goes with her to Mon Cala. She intervenes in Rey's rite of challenge, chases down a Quarren saboteur, and sees the Mon Calamari join the fight.

34 ABY - Mission to Minfar

Rose names the Falcon's porgs. After a crash landing on Minfar, she helps free the Zixon from the First Order's Echo Horn.

~35 ABY - Commander of the Engineering Corps

Leia promotes Rose to lead the Engineering Corps, where she develops technology to counter hyperspace tracking and First Order jamming.

35 ABY - News of Palpatine's return

On Ajan Kloss, Rose hears the decoded spy message about Darth Sidious and the Final Order. She stays behind to study the specifications of old Imperial Star Destroyers.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

Rose serves on the landing team that boards the Steadfast, and reluctantly leaves Finn and Jannah behind to take down the ship's navigation transmitter.

35 ABY - Victory celebration

Rose celebrates the Resistance's victory on Ajan Kloss and gets a big hug from Chewbacca.

death.source: Wookieepedia gives no death date. She is alive at the Ajan Kloss victory celebration after the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Leia_Sk.description: The adopted princess of Alderaan who became one of the Rebellion's most important leaders, Leia spent her whole life fighting tyranny, from the Imperial Senate to the command bunkers of the Resistance. She and her twin, Luke, were the secret children of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala. They were separated at birth, and Leia was raised by Bail and Breha Organa as heir to Alderaan's throne. At ten she was kidnapped on an Inquisitor's orders and rescued by Obi-Wan Kenobi. As a teenager she became the youngest member of the Imperial Senate while quietly working for her father's rebel network. After she smuggled the Death Star plans out of Scarif, she was captured and tortured by Darth Vader and watched Alderaan's destruction. Once rescued, she helped bring about the Rebel victories at Yavin and Endor, where she learned that Vader was her father. She married Han Solo and briefly trained as a Jedi under her brother, but she set the lightsaber aside when she foresaw her son's fate. After Ben Solo was born, she became a senator of the New Republic. When the Senate learned whose daughter she was, her political career collapsed, and she founded the Resistance to oppose the rising First Order. She lost Han to their son, now Kylo Ren, and saw the New Republic destroyed, yet she kept the Resistance going through Crait and trained Rey. In 35 ABY she spent her last strength reaching out to Ben, a sacrifice that helped turn him back to the light.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Leia_Sk.socialDesc: Leia Organa: Alderaan's rebel princess, senator and Resistance general who defied the Empire and First Order and died reaching her son in 35 ABY.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Leia_Sk.timeline:
19 BBY - Birth on Polis Massa

Born as Leia Amidala Skywalker to Padmé Amidala two days after the Empire was proclaimed. Her twin brother, Luke, is born minutes earlier. Padmé dies shortly afterward, and the twins are separated to hide them from Vader and the Emperor.

19 BBY - Adopted by the House of Organa

Bail Organa and Queen Breha adopt her, and she is raised on Alderaan as Princess Leia Organa, heir to the throne.

10 BBY - Runs away from the palace

At nine, fearing an arranged marriage, she hides in the woods for a week and teaches herself to survive before the royal guards find her.

9 BBY - Kidnapped from Alderaan

Mercenaries hired by the Third Sister, Reva, abduct her to lure Obi-Wan Kenobi out of hiding. She is held on Daiyu.

9 BBY - Rescued by Obi-Wan Kenobi

Kenobi frees her on Daiyu. On the run through Mapuzo, she is recaptured by Reva and resists interrogation in the Fortress Inquisitorius until Kenobi and the Path rescue her.

9 BBY - Escape from Jabiim and return home

She crawls through the vents to restore the Path's escape ship and returns to Alderaan. Kenobi tells her he knew her birth parents.

~3 BBY - Challenges and the Apprentice Legislature

At sixteen she takes on the Challenges of the Mind, Body and Heart to be named heir, joins the Apprentice Legislature, and discovers her parents' secret involvement in the rebellion.

~2 BBY - Youngest Imperial Senator

She succeeds Bail as Alderaan's representative in the Imperial Senate. Under the cover of humanitarian missions, she supplies rebel cells, including delivering ships to the Lothal rebels.

1 BBY - The Death Star plans

After the Battle of Scarif, she escapes aboard the Tantive IV with the stolen plans. She hides them in R2-D2 before she is captured by Darth Vader.

1 BBY - Destruction of Alderaan

Grand Moff Tarkin destroys Alderaan in front of her after she is interrogated aboard the Death Star. Luke Skywalker, Han Solo and Obi-Wan Kenobi rescue her.

0 ABY - Battle of Yavin

The plans she protected let the Rebellion destroy the Death Star. She presents medals to the heroes of Yavin.

3 ABY - Hoth and Cloud City

She commands the evacuation of Echo Base and flees with Han Solo to Bespin, where she confesses her love before Han is frozen in carbonite.

4 ABY - Rescue of Han Solo

Disguised as the bounty hunter Boushh, she infiltrates Jabba's palace. After she is enslaved, she strangles Jabba during the escape at the Great Pit of Carkoon.

4 ABY - Battle of Endor

She fights alongside the Ewoks on Endor's forest moon and learns that Luke is her twin brother and that Vader is their father. The Emperor dies and the second Death Star is destroyed.

~4 ABY - Marries Han Solo

She weds Han Solo after the victory at Endor and begins Jedi training under Luke.

5 ABY - Birth of Ben Solo

Her son is born on the day the Empire signs the Galactic Concordance after the Battle of Jakku. She has already stepped away from her Jedi training after foreseeing her son's death.

~5 ABY - Senator of the New Republic

She helps build the New Republic and serves in its Senate, pushing for a stronger galactic defence.

28 ABY - Exposed as Vader's daughter

Her political rivals reveal her parentage in the Senate, which ends her career. She begins organizing the Resistance against the First Order.

~29 ABY - Ben falls to the dark side

Ben destroys Luke's Jedi temple and becomes Kylo Ren. Leia and Han grow apart.

34 ABY - Hosnian Cataclysm and Starkiller Base

The First Order destroys the New Republic's capital. Her Resistance destroys Starkiller Base, but Han is killed by their son.

34 ABY - Evacuation of D'Qar and Battle of Crait

She survives being thrown into space when her bridge is destroyed, saving herself with the Force. She then leads the remnant of the Resistance to Crait, where Luke dies buying them time.

35 ABY - Trains Rey on Ajan Kloss

She rebuilds the Resistance and continues Rey's Jedi training.

35 ABY - Death on Ajan Kloss

She uses the last of her strength to reach Ben through the Force and dies, becoming one with the Force. Her sacrifice helps turn Ben back to the light before the Battle of Exegol.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox: born two days after Empire Day, 19 BBY, Polis Massa (Revenge of the Sith).

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 35 ABY on Ajan Kloss (The Rise of Skywalker).

notes.detail: 'Skywalker Solo' is a fragment of her full name (Leia Skywalker Organa Solo), not a nickname or second identity. Use 'Princess Leia' or 'General Organa' instead, or the full name 'Leia Skywalker Organa Solo'.

I couldn't confirm that Leia appears on screen in Star Wars Resistance. She is referenced often, but the part of the article I had didn't include an appearances list. Check her Wookieepedia appearances list, and if she is only mentioned, remove the series from seenIn.
Leia is a recurring lead in the canon Forces of Destiny shorts. Add them if the timeline tracks that series.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/R5-D4.description: Nicknamed "Red" by Luke Skywalker, R5-D4 is the astromech whose sudden breakdown at the Lars homestead changed galactic history. The breakdown was deliberate. Held by Jawas after an earlier stint with the rebellion ended in a memory wipe, the droid was persuaded by R2-D2 that the fate of the galaxy depended on R2 being sold. When Owen Lars chose R5 instead, the droid blew its own head plate, so the Lars family bought R2-D2 and the Death Star plans reached Luke and Obi-Wan Kenobi. R5 then played dead while stormtroopers slaughtered its Jawa owners and set off to find the Rebellion. The historian Voren Na'al later bought and repaired it, and it served with Carson Teva's X-wing squadron until the Empire fell. After another memory wipe it drifted back to Mos Eisley, trained under EV-9D9 at Chalmun's Cantina, and ended up in Peli Motto's hangar, where it helped Din Djarin and was later reunited with R2-D2. Peli eventually sold the reluctant droid to Djarin for his quest to Mandalore. There R5 confirmed the planet's air was breathable, fetched Bo-Katan Kryze to rescue Djarin, and helped retake the homeworld by shutting down the shields of Moff Gideon's base. Afterward it joined the New Republic's Adelphi Rangers.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/R5-D4.socialDesc: R5-D4, the red astromech that blew its own motivator so R2-D2 could be sold to Luke, later flew with the Rebellion and joined Din Djarin on Mandalore.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/R5-D4.timeline:
22 BBY - Rolling Through Mos Espa

Serving a master in Mos Espa, R5-D4 is out in the streets when Anakin Skywalker returns to Tatooine to search for his mother.

~4 BBY - Memory Wiped by Jawas

After working with the early rebellion against the Empire, R5-D4 ends up with a Jawa clan. The Jawas wipe its memory, and it spends years stored in their sandcrawler hoping to be sold.

1 BBY - Meeting R2-D2

The Jawas capture R2-D2 and put him in the same sandcrawler. R2 starts sabotaging R5 to remove the competition, then stops and explains that the Rebellion needs him to be sold.

1 BBY - Sacrifice at the Lars Homestead

Owen Lars picks R5-D4 over R2-D2. R5 deliberately blows its head plate, faking a bad motivator, so Owen buys R2-D2 instead and the Death Star plans reach Luke Skywalker.

1 BBY - Surviving the Sandcrawler Massacre

R5 plays dead while stormtroopers kill the Jawas, then sets off along their trade route to look for a new owner and the Rebellion.

~0 ABY - Recruited by Voren Na'al

While researching Luke Skywalker's origins, the Alliance historian Voren Na'al finds R5-D4 on Tatooine, buys it cheaply, repairs its motivator and records its account of the droid sale.

~0–5 ABY - Service with the Rebellion

R5 is assigned to Carson Teva's X-wing squadron and takes part in several classified missions during the Galactic Civil War.

~5 ABY - Returned to Tatooine

After the Battle of Jakku, Na'al wipes R5's memory and returns it to Tatooine, where it wanders the dunes before reaching Mos Eisley.

~5–9 ABY - Trainee at Chalmun's Cantina

EV-9D9 finds R5 by the cantina's garbage masher and takes it on as a trainee bartender. When a Trandoshan patron kicks R5, EV-9D9 poisons his drink and leaves with the droid.

~9 ABY - Joining Peli Motto's Hangar

EV-9D9 brings R5 to Hangar 3-5, and Peli Motto takes it in. R5 projects a map of Tatooine that shows Din Djarin where Mos Pelgo is.

~9 ABY - Reunion with R2-D2

R5 is at Peli's hangar when R2-D2 arrives with Grogu in Luke Skywalker's X-wing.

~9 ABY - Sold to Din Djarin

Peli sells a reluctant R5 to Din Djarin at half price, and it joins his mission to the Living Waters of Mandalore.

~9 ABY - Mines of Mandalore

R5 goes into the ruins to take an air sample and confirms the atmosphere is breathable. After Djarin is captured, R5 and Grogu bring Bo-Katan Kryze from Kalevala to rescue him.

~9 ABY - Pirate Campaign and the Mandalorian Fleet

R5 passes the covert's location to Carson Teva, flies as co-pilot against Gorian Shard's pirates, and is with Bo-Katan when she finds the Mandalorian fleet on Plazir-15.

~9 ABY - Liberation of Mandalore

At Moff Gideon's base, R5 gets past its droids, sends the schematics to Djarin and shuts down four shields, then escapes on its rocket boosters before the base is destroyed.

~9 ABY - Joining the Adelphi Rangers

After Mandalore is liberated, R5 enters New Republic service at Adelphi Base.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's infobox has no build or activation date. The only anchor is that R5-D4 was already serving a master in Mos Espa in 22 BBY (Attack of the Clones), so it was built by 22 BBY at the latest. Our guess of 25 BBY is consistent with that.

death.source: Wookieepedia's infobox has no death date. R5-D4 is still active after the Liberation of Mandalore (~9 ABY), serving with the New Republic's Adelphi Rangers, and appears in Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu.
