https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/8D8.description: 8D8 is best known as the gaunt enforcer of Jabba the Hutt's droid torture chamber, the one who pressed hot irons to the feet of a power droid while EV-9D9 sorted newly arrived R2-D2 and C-3PO into the Hutt's service. Built by the Roche Hive as an industrial smelter droid for ore-extraction work, he was lobotomized and reprogrammed for cruelty. He devoted himself to EV-9D9 and carried out her orders, keeping the palace's droid pool terrified and submissive. After Jabba's death shortly before the Battle of Endor, the palace droids were shut down, but 8D8 got a second career when Boba Fett took the throne from Bib Fortuna around 9 ABY. Reactivated as the new Daimyo's majordomo, he announced visitors paying tribute, briefed Fett on the history and uneasy alliances of the Hutt territories, identified a captured Night Wind assassin, translated for Gamorrean guards and the Aqualish crime boss Garfalaquox, and passed on news from the evasive mayor of Mos Espa. He kept pushing old Tatooine habits, such as urging Fett to torture prisoners to project strength, and Fett kept turning him down. He stayed at Fett's side through the war against the Pyke Syndicate and was with the Daimyo's party in the Sanctuary ruins when Cad Bane arrived.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/8D8.socialDesc: 8D8 tortured droids for EV-9D9 in Jabba's palace, then was reactivated to serve as Boba Fett's outspoken majordomo and translator on Tatooine.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/8D8.timeline:
Unknown - Built as a smelter droid

Manufactured by the Roche Hive as an 8D-series smelter droid for simple labor in ore-extraction facilities.

Unknown - Reprogrammed for Jabba's palace

Lobotomized and reprogrammed for sadism, then put to work in the droid torture chamber of Jabba the Hutt's palace on Tatooine, where he served EV-9D9, the chief of Cyborg Operations.

1 BBY - Torturing droids during Bossk's visit

Tortured a power droid while EV-9D9 questioned the bounty hunter Bossk about 261, a rogue Imperial astromech droid that had escaped the palace droid pool.

4 ABY - Arrival of R2-D2 and C-3PO

Branded a GNK power droid's feet with a hot iron while EV-9D9 assigned R2-D2 and C-3PO their new duties in Jabba's service.

4 ABY - Deactivated after Jabba's death

After Jabba was killed at the Great Pit of Carkoon, the palace droid pool was shut down, 8D8 included.

~9 ABY - Majordomo to Boba Fett

Reactivated after Boba Fett and Fennec Shand overthrew Bib Fortuna, and put to work as the new Daimyo's majordomo and advisor.

~9 ABY - Tribute from Mos Espa

Announced guests and collected gifts from Garfalaquox and Dokk Strassi. Watched the mayor's majordomo demand tribute instead of offering it, then urged Fett to torture two captured Gamorreans. Fett spared the Gamorreans in exchange for their loyalty.

~9 ABY - Night Wind interrogation

Identified a captured assassin as a member of the Order of the Night Wind and insisted he would never talk. Shand's rancor-pit bluff made him name Mayor Mok Shaiz.

~9 ABY - Briefing the Daimyo and Lortha Peel's petition

Briefed Fett on the territories and alliances of Jabba and Fortuna. Translated for a Gamorrean guard and sharply cut off the water-monger Lortha Peel, whose complaint about the Mods led Fett to recruit that gang.

~9 ABY - The Hutt Twins and the mayor's evasion

Announced the Hutt Twins' arrival with a peace offering. He later interrupted Fett's rancor training to report that the mayor would be unavailable for twenty days, and Fett left at once for Mos Espa city hall.

~9 ABY - Translating at the crime families' banquet

Translated for Garfalaquox at Fett's banquet, where the Mos Espa crime families agreed to stay neutral in the conflict with the Pyke Syndicate.

~9 ABY - Battle for Mos Espa

Stood watch at the ruins of the Sanctuary with Fett, Shand, Din Djarin and the Twi'lek majordomo, announced Cad Bane's arrival, and watched the majordomo go out to negotiate with the Pyke forces. His fate after the battle is not recorded.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's infobox leaves the birth/manufacture date blank. The earliest dated appearance is 1 BBY (Bossk's visit to the palace), where he is already working in Jabba's droid pool, so he was built before 1 BBY.

death.source: No canon death. Wookieepedia's infobox leaves the death date blank. He is last seen active in The Book of Boba Fett Chapter 7 (~9 ABY).

notes.detail: Canon gives no build date. The guess is consistent with canon because he is attested working in Jabba's palace by 1 BBY, but any year before 1 BBY is equally defensible. Keeping the guess flag is correct.

Wookieepedia's infobox lists Tatooine, but he was built by the Roche Hive (Verpine) and only served on Tatooine. 'Homeworld' here means where he served, not where he was made. Optionally add a Manufacturer entry (Roche Hive) and a Model entry (8D-series smelter droid).

notes.suggested: Voiced by Matt Berry (The Book of Boba Fett)
notes.detail: Matt Berry voices 8D8 in The Book of Boba Fett. Pablo Hidalgo confirmed that 8D8 is a different character from UK2-B, which clears up a common credit mix-up.

Wookieepedia notes that some sources (e.g. Build R2-D2 issue 21) mislabel a different 8D-series smelter droid as 8D8, and that the StarWars.com Databank once used his image for an 'Astromech (in Jabba's Palace)' entry. Check that /images/8d8.png shows the correct droid.
Handled correctly. He is not dead in canon; his last appearance is BoBF Chapter 7, around 9 ABY.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rex.description: Captain Rex is the best-known clone trooper of the Clone Wars. He led the 501st Legion at Anakin Skywalker's side and was a steady mentor and close friend to Ahsoka Tano. His fighting took him from Christophsis and Teth to Ryloth, Geonosis and Saleucami. On Saleucami he let the deserter Cut Lawquane stay with his family, the first sign that Rex would think for himself. Serving under the treacherous Pong Krell on Umbara shook his blind trust in orders, and the death of his friend Fives, who had uncovered Order 66, led Rex to find the control chip in his own head. When the order came during the Siege of Mandalore, Ahsoka removed his chip and the two escaped the purge together. Rex then worked in secret to free other clones, retired to Seelos with Wolffe and Gregor, and returned to the fight to help the Spectres and the Rebel Alliance. He trained Ezra Bridger, fought on Lothal and at Atollon, and as a rebel commander lived to see the Empire beaten at Endor.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rex.socialDesc: Captain Rex led the 501st Legion beside Anakin Skywalker, defied Order 66 with Ahsoka Tano, then fought for the Rebel Alliance all the way to Endor.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rex.timeline:
32 BBY - Born on Kamino

Rex is grown as CT-7567, one of the first generation of clones made from Jango Fett's genetic template.

~22 BBY - Command and ARC training

He is singled out for leadership, receives command and ARC training, is made a clone captain and is given Torrent Company of the 501st.

22 BBY - First Battle of Geonosis

Rex fights in the battle that opens the Clone Wars. Afterward the 501st is expanded into a legion under Jedi General Anakin Skywalker.

22 BBY - Battle of Christophsis

Rex and Commander Cody catch the clone traitor Slick. Rex meets Skywalker's new Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, and is told to show her the ropes.

22 BBY - Battle of Teth

He holds the monastery against Asajj Ventress to protect Skywalker and Tano while they rescue Jabba the Hutt's son.

22 BBY - Rishi Moon

With Cody, Rex retakes Rishi Station from droid commandos. He brings the surviving rookies, Fives and Echo, into the 501st.

22 BBY - Bothawui and Skytop Station

Rex helps ambush General Grievous's fleet and destroy the Separatist listening post.

22 BBY - Stranded on Maridun

After crashing with Skywalker, Tano, Aayla Secura and Bly, Rex helps defend the Lurmen village against Lok Durd's defoliator.

22 BBY - Blue Shadow Virus and Ryloth

He is infected during the raid on Nuvo Vindi's lab on Naboo and survives. He then serves with Tano when she breaks the blockade of Ryloth.

~21 BBY - Felucia, Devaron and Malastare

Rex fights on Felucia, against Cad Bane above Devaron, and on Malastare and Coruscant during the Zillo Beast crisis.

~21 BBY - Second Battle of Geonosis

He supports the attack on Poggle the Lesser's droid foundry.

~21 BBY - Battle of Saleucami

Rex is wounded while hunting Grievous. He recovers on the farm of the deserter Cut Lawquane and decides to let him stay out of the war.

~20 BBY - Battle of Umbara

Rex serves under Jedi General Pong Krell, whose reckless orders kill many clones. He finally turns on Krell, who is revealed as a traitor.

~20 BBY - Onderon

He trains Saw Gerrera and the Onderon rebels in their fight against the Separatist-backed king.

19 BBY - Death of Fives

Fives uncovers the inhibitor chips and Order 66 and is killed before anyone will listen. His death leaves Rex doubting the Republic.

19 BBY - Ahsoka leaves the Order

Rex sees Tano framed for the Jedi Temple bombing and then walk away from the Jedi Order.

19 BBY - Siege of Mandalore

Rex, now a commander, leads 501st troops under Tano against Maul. When Order 66 is given, Tano removes his chip. They fake their deaths, bury the fallen clones, and part ways.

~19–18 BBY - Clone underground

Rex secretly helps other clones escape the Empire, working with Clone Force 99, Echo and Gregor.

~5 BBY - Retirement on Seelos

With his chip removed, Rex lives on a converted AT-TE on Seelos with fellow clones Wolffe and Gregor.

~4 BBY - Joins the rebellion

The Spectres find him, and Rex joins the Phoenix Cell, where he is reunited with Ahsoka Tano. He also makes peace with Kanan Jarrus.

~4 BBY - Mentor to Ezra Bridger

Rex trains Ezra Bridger in combat and becomes a regular ally of the Ghost crew.

2 BBY - Battle of Atollon

Rex, Wolffe and Gregor help defend Chopper Base against Grand Admiral Thrawn's forces.

1 BBY - Liberation of Lothal

Rex fights alongside the Spectres in the battle that frees Lothal from the Empire.

4 ABY - Battle of Endor

Now a commander in the Alliance, Rex fights at Endor, where the Emperor falls and the second Death Star is destroyed.

birth.source: Wookieepedia 'Rex' infobox: born 32 BBY, Kamino. He was one of the first generation of Jango Fett clones.

death.source: Wookieepedia 'Rex' infobox has no death date. His last confirmed canon activity is the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, and his later fate is unrevealed.

notes.current: The Clone Wars (movie), The Clone Wars (TV series), The Bad Batch, Star Wars Rebels
notes.suggested: Add Tales of the Jedi and Ahsoka
notes.detail: Rex appears in the Tales of the Jedi episode "Resolve". In the live-action Ahsoka (episode 5, "Shadow Warrior") he appears in the Clone Wars flashback, played by Temuera Morrison. Do not add Return of the Jedi: Rex being at Endor comes from Rebels and reference material, not from him appearing on screen in the film.

Wookieepedia flags a conflict between the novel Ahsoka and The Clone Wars Season Seven over what happened to Rex after Order 66. The novel has Ahsoka acting alone and believing the clones died, while Season 7 shows Rex surviving with her. Season 7, the later work, is treated as authoritative.
Rex is promoted to commander at the Siege of Mandalore and again in the Rebel Alliance. It may also be worth adding a "Donor: Jango Fett" fact.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Sabine_.description: Sabine Wren is the graffiti-slinging demolitions expert of the Ghost crew, whose painted starbird became the emblem of the Rebel Alliance. Raised in Clan Wren during the Empire's grip on Mandalore, she built the Arc Pulse Generator as an Imperial cadet. When she saw the weapon turned against her own people, she deserted, and the break left her estranged from her family. After a stint as a bounty hunter with Ketsu Onyo, she joined Hera Syndulla and Kanan Jarrus's rebel cell and harried the Empire across Lothal and beyond. In 2 BBY she found the Darksaber on Dathomir and learned to wield it. She used it to reconcile with her mother, Ursa, helped bring down Viceroy Gar Saxon, and rallied the clans against the Empire before giving the blade to Bo-Katan Kryze and destroying her own weapon for good. She fought in the liberation of Lothal, where she lost Kanan and saw Ezra Bridger vanish with Thrawn, then stayed behind to guard the planet. She later trained under Ahsoka Tano, but they drifted apart after the Empire's purge of Mandalore killed her family. In 9 ABY she crossed into another galaxy, found Ezra on Peridea, and was left stranded there as Thrawn escaped. On Peridea she began to reach the Force.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Sabine_.socialDesc: Sabine Wren: Mandalorian rebel artist of the Ghost crew who wielded the Darksaber, trained under Ahsoka Tano, and awakened to the Force on Peridea.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Sabine_.timeline:
21 BBY - Birth on Mandalore

Born into Clan Wren of House Vizsla near the end of the Clone Wars, while Mandalore is in turmoil. Her mother, Ursa, belongs to Death Watch. The family's ancestral home is Krownest.

~7 BBY - Imperial Academy of Mandalore

Enrolls as a cadet at the Imperial Academy on occupied Mandalore and designs the Arc Pulse Generator, nicknamed "the Duchess," which turns beskar armor against the person wearing it.

~6 BBY - Desertion from the Empire

Horrified to see her weapon used against Mandalorians, she speaks out, destroys the prototype and flees with Ketsu Onyo. The Empire and her own clan brand her a traitor.

~6 BBY - Bounty hunter

Works as a bounty hunter with Ketsu Onyo until Ketsu leaves her for dead and the partnership ends badly.

~5 BBY - Joins the Spectres

At about 16, she is recruited into Hera Syndulla and Kanan Jarrus's rebel cell aboard the Ghost and takes the call sign Spectre 5.

5 BBY - The Artist of Lothal

Paints the starbird on a TIE fighter at a Capital City airfield and escapes behind a paint bomb. She helps free enslaved Wookiees from Kessel and welcomes Ezra Bridger to the crew.

5 BBY - Missions across Lothal

Takes part in the Stygeon Prime rescue attempt, patches up her rift with Hera at Fort Anaxes, frees slaves on Oon, and joins the Empire Day sabotage and the operation to get Tseebo off Lothal.

5 BBY - Siege of Lothal and rebel fleet

Helps rescue Kanan from Mustafar. After the Siege of Lothal, the Spectres join Phoenix Squadron and the wider rebel movement.

~4 BBY - Mandalorian encounters

Reunites with Ketsu Onyo and helps her break from the Empire. She also clashes with the Mandalorian Protectors of Concord Dawn under Fenn Rau.

3 BBY - Imperial Super Commandos

Fights Gar Saxon's Imperial Super Commandos on Concord Dawn and learns her brother Tristan serves among them.

2 BBY - The Darksaber

Finds the Darksaber in Maul's lair on Dathomir. Kanan and Fenn Rau train her to use it.

2 BBY - Return to Krownest

Goes home to Krownest and wins over her family. She defeats Gar Saxon in a duel but spares him, and her mother kills him when he tries to shoot Sabine in the back.

2 BBY - Battle of Atollon

Leads Mandalorian reinforcements to help the rebels at Chopper Base during the Imperial assault.

1 BBY - Mandalorian Civil War

Rescues her father, frees Mandalore from Imperial control, destroys the Duchess weapon and all her research, and gives the Darksaber to Bo-Katan Kryze.

1 BBY - Liberation of Lothal

Returns to Lothal with the Ghost crew. She fights through Kanan's death and Grand Admiral Thrawn's occupation, and the planet is freed after Ezra disappears into hyperspace with the Chimaera.

After 1 BBY - Guardian of Lothal

Stays on Lothal to protect it, living in Ezra's old comm tower.

~4 ABY - Apprentice to Ahsoka Tano

After the Empire falls, she sets out with Ahsoka Tano to search for Ezra and trains as her apprentice. The two later part ways after Mandalore's purge kills Sabine's family.

9 ABY - Search for Ezra Bridger

Ahsoka recruits her again to decode a star map. Sabine is badly wounded by Shin Hati and then gives the map to Baylan Skoll in exchange for a chance to find Ezra.

9 ABY - Peridea

Travels to another galaxy with Morgan Elsbeth's forces, reunites with Ezra, and is left stranded on Peridea with Ahsoka when Thrawn escapes. There she begins to use the Force.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and biography: born 21 BBY on Mandalore. Also consistent with being about 16 when she joined the Spectres in 5 BBY.

death.source: Wookieepedia lists no death. She is alive and stranded on Peridea at the end of Ahsoka season 1 (9 ABY).

notes.detail: Wookieepedia's lead calls her a Force-sensitive human who later became a Jedi. In Ahsoka she begins to reach the Force (for example, pulling her lightsaber to her on Peridea). Her Force sensitivity is described as no stronger than average, but the answer is still yes.
Wookieepedia lists both homeworlds and says she was born on Mandalore. Krownest is her clan's ancestral home, which she also calls her homeworld.

notes.suggested: Add Affiliation (Clan Wren / Spectres / Rebel Alliance) and Master (Ahsoka Tano)
notes.detail: Her apprenticeship to Ahsoka and her time as an Imperial Academy defector are central to the character. We don't track either.

notes.suggested: Consider adding Star Wars Forces of Destiny if the timeline tracks it
notes.detail: Sabine appears in canon Forces of Destiny shorts. Rebels and Ahsoka are correct as listed.

Canon doesn't give exact years for her Imperial Academy years, her desertion, the start of her training under Ahsoka, or when they split up. The timeline marks these as estimates. Wookieepedia's update notice flags Star Wars: Timelines as not yet reflected in the article, so that book may pin some of them down.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Obi-Wan.description: Obi-Wan Kenobi is remembered as the Jedi who trained two generations of Skywalkers. He was the father Anakin rebelled against and the mentor who later set Luke on his path. As a rule-breaking youngling he was apprenticed to the unorthodox Qui-Gon Jinn, and together they took missions to Mandalore, where he fell for Duchess Satine Kryze, and to Teth and Pijal. At Naboo he watched Darth Maul kill his master, then cut the Sith in half, which made him a Jedi Knight. Keeping his promise to the dying Qui-Gon, he took the young Anakin as his Padawan. In the Clone Wars he served as a Jedi General and Council member, earned the nickname "the Negotiator," fought beside Commander Cody, and lost Satine to Maul's revenge. He ended the war by killing General Grievous on Utapau. After Order 66 he faced Anakin, by then Darth Vader, on Mustafar and left him broken. He then went into exile on Tatooine as the hermit Ben, watching over the infant Luke. He left the desert once to rescue a kidnapped young Leia, a mission that brought him face to face with Vader again. Years later he killed Maul for good. In 1 BBY he gave Luke his father's lightsaber and let Vader strike him down on the Death Star so the others could escape. After becoming one with the Force, he kept guiding Luke through the Galactic Civil War, and his voice was among those that helped Rey on Exegol.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Obi-Wan.socialDesc: Obi-Wan Kenobi, the Jedi who trained Anakin and Luke Skywalker, led clone armies in the Clone Wars and died on the Death Star so Luke could escape.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Obi-Wan.timeline:
57 BBY - Birth on Stewjon

Obi-Wan is born on Stewjon. Later in life he keeps only faint memories of his parents and of a baby he believes was his brother.

57 BBY - Taken to the Jedi Temple

Because he is Force-sensitive, he is brought to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant before he is six months old and raised in the Kybuck Clan of younglings.

54 BBY - First Force training

At three he begins learning basic Force techniques. Yoda teaches him, and Cin Drallig trains him in lightsaber forms. As a youngling he gets a reputation for breaking rules.

~44 BBY - Padawan of Qui-Gon Jinn

At thirteen he is chosen by Qui-Gon Jinn. The two find it hard to work together, and he builds his first lightsaber.

~41 BBY - Mission to Lenahra

Angry that his master has not shown up, the sixteen-year-old leaves for Lenahra alone. There he meets Dexter Jettster, who becomes a lifelong friend.

~41 BBY - Protecting Satine Kryze

He spends a year on Mandalore with Qui-Gon guarding Duchess Satine Kryze from insurgents and bounty hunters. He falls in love with her but stays loyal to the Jedi Code.

40 BBY - Incident on Teth

A mission to Teth goes wrong, and he is briefly taken hostage by Wanbo the Hutt's majordomo. Afterward he feels he has let his master down.

40 BBY - Crisis on Pijal

He and Qui-Gon uncover a plot by Princess Fanry. Standing in as the Republic's representative, he helps Pijal set up a democratic Assembly.

32 BBY - Invasion of Naboo

He survives the Trade Federation's attempt to kill him and Qui-Gon, helps rescue Queen Amidala, and first meets the young Anakin Skywalker on Tatooine.

32 BBY - Duel with Darth Maul

After Maul kills Qui-Gon in Theed, Obi-Wan cuts the Sith Lord in half and promises his dying master that he will train Anakin.

32 BBY - Knighted and takes Anakin as Padawan

The Jedi Council makes him a Knight and, with reluctance, lets him train Anakin Skywalker.

~30 BBY - Trials of a young master

He takes Anakin on missions such as the one to Dallenor and brings him to Ilum to build his first lightsaber.

22 BBY - Kamino and Geonosis

He finds the secret clone army on Kamino, is captured on Geonosis, and fights Count Dooku as the Clone Wars break out.

22 BBY - High Jedi General

He is given command of the Open Circle Fleet, the Third Systems Army, and the 7th Sky Corps, with Commander Cody as his second, and becomes a Jedi Master on the High Council.

~20 BBY - Death of Satine

Maul returns seeking revenge, takes over Mandalore, and kills Satine in front of Obi-Wan.

19 BBY - Battle of Utapau

He kills General Grievous, which effectively ends the Clone Wars.

19 BBY - Order 66 and Mustafar

He survives the clones' betrayal and learns that Anakin has become Darth Vader. On Mustafar he defeats his former apprentice and leaves him maimed.

19 BBY - Exile on Tatooine

He hands the infant Luke to the Lars family and settles in the desert as the hermit Ben Kenobi.

9 BBY - Rescue of Leia Organa

He comes out of exile to rescue the kidnapped young Leia. Inquisitors hunt him, and in two duels he confronts Vader.

~2 BBY - Final duel with Maul

When Maul tracks him down on Tatooine, Obi-Wan kills him to keep Luke safe.

1 BBY - Meeting Luke

He rescues Luke from Tusken Raiders, gives him Anakin's lightsaber, and hires Han Solo and Chewbacca to fly them to Alderaan.

1 BBY - Death aboard the Death Star

He switches off the tractor beam, then lets Vader strike him down so Luke and his friends can escape. He becomes one with the Force.

0 BBY - Voice at Yavin

His voice tells Luke to use the Force during the run on the Death Star's trench.

3 ABY - Guiding Luke to Dagobah

His Force spirit appears to a freezing Luke on Hoth and sends him to Yoda.

4 ABY - Reunion with Anakin

He tells Luke the truth about his family, and after Endor he appears beside Yoda and the redeemed Anakin.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

His voice joins the voices of the Jedi who give Rey strength against the returned Palpatine.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and Early life section: born 57 BBY on Stewjon.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 1 BBY on the DS-1 Death Star in the Alderaan system (A New Hope, dated 1 BBY under the Galactic Atlas convention).

notes.current: Episodes I–VI, Obi-Wan Kenobi, The Clone Wars (movie and series)
notes.detail: Obi-Wan appears in person in the Rebels episode "Twin Suns" (season 3), where he kills Maul on Tatooine. This is one of the key events in his life.
The article's update list includes "The Sith Lord," an episode of Tales of the Jedi in which Obi-Wan appears alongside Qui-Gon Jinn in the Dooku storyline.
In Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker he is heard as a voice at Exegol in 35 ABY but not seen. Add it only if seenIn counts voice-only appearances.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Phasma.description: Phasma was the chrome-armored enforcer of the First Order's stormtrooper corps, a survivor who treated loyalty as a tool and betrayal as a way to climb. She grew up on a ruined, radiation-scarred world and, as a teenager, became war leader of the Scyre clan alongside her brother Keldo, whom she had already crippled while arranging the deaths of their parents. When General Brendol Hux crash-landed near her people, she saw her way off-planet. She guided him across the wastes, abandoned her clan, and killed Keldo when he came after her. In the First Order she rose quickly to captain and took over training its adult recruits. She forged her armor from the plating of Palpatine's old yacht. Working with Armitage Hux, she poisoned her patron Brendol, silenced the young recruit Frey, and left her rival Cardinal for dead, which secured her a place beside Hux and Kylo Ren at the top of the Order. She led the massacre at Tuanul on Jakku that drove FN-2187 to defect. When he returned to Starkiller Base with Han Solo and Chewbacca, they forced her at gunpoint to lower the base's shields. She survived its destruction and framed another officer for the breach. Months later, aboard the crippled Supremacy, she faced the renegade again, now called Finn. He beat her, and she fell into the flames consuming the ship.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Phasma.socialDesc: Phasma was the chrome-armored First Order captain who betrayed her own clan to escape Parnassos, then fell to her death fighting Finn on the Supremacy.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Phasma.timeline:
6 ABY - Birth on Parnassos

Born into a small, struggling clan living around the Nautilus on the devastated world of Parnassos, with her older brother Keldo.

~22 ABY - Betrayal of Her Family

Conspires with the rival Scyre clan to have her parents and family killed. She stabs Keldo to keep him out of the fight, and the two siblings are taken into the Scyre.

~22 ABY - Co-Leader of the Scyre

At sixteen, defeats the usurper Porr in combat after the Scyre leader Egil is mortally wounded. She becomes the clan's military leader, while Keldo leads it politically.

~24 ABY - War with the Claws

Drives off a night raid by Balder's Claws. Keldo then pushes through a truce against her wishes, and the siblings become enemies.

~24 ABY - Meeting Brendol Hux

Finds the stranded First Order general Brendol Hux among the Claws, kills Balder, and offers to guide Hux back to his downed ship.

~24 ABY - Trek Across Parnassos

Steals her clan's supplies and crosses the wastes with Hux, his stormtroopers and her warriors. On the way they survive venomous beetles, forced labor at Terpsichore Station and the arena of the Arratu, where she kills the Arratu and his jailer Vrod.

~24 ABY - Killing Keldo

At Hux's ship in the irradiated dead lands, fights off Keldo's combined Scyre and Claw force, then shoots her brother dead. She takes the child Frey with her and leaves Siv behind.

~24 ABY - Joining the First Order

Picked up by Armitage Hux. From orbit, Brendol destroys her former home to show the First Order's power. She begins training aboard the Star Destroyer Absolution as Brendol's new protégé and bodyguard.

~25 ABY - Captain and Chrome Armor

Makes captain within a year and returns to Parnassos to strip chromium plating from Palpatine's old yacht, forging her signature armor at Cleo Station.

~34 ABY - Murder of Brendol Hux

Poisons her patron with a Parnassos beetle at Armitage Hux's direction. She also arranges the death of the cadet Frey to bury her past.

34 ABY - Duel with Cardinal

Her rival Cardinal learns her history from the captured spy Vi Moradi and attacks her. She defeats him and leaves him for dead, taking full control of stormtrooper training.

34 ABY - Handling Agent Terex

Directs Agent Terex's hunt for Poe Dameron and struggles to rein him in when he goes rogue.

34 ABY - Massacre at Tuanul

Leads stormtroopers in the attack on the Jakku village of Tuanul while searching for the map to Luke Skywalker. She notices FN-2187's hesitation.

34 ABY - Hosnian Cataclysm

Commands the troops at Starkiller Base as the superweapon destroys the Hosnian system.

34 ABY - Captured at Starkiller Base

Finn, Han Solo and Chewbacca ambush her and force her to lower the base's shields. She is dumped in a trash compactor but survives the base's destruction.

34 ABY - Framing Sol Rivas

Pins the shield failure on Lieutenant Sol Rivas and leads the hunt for him after he discovers the truth.

34 ABY - Death Aboard the Supremacy

After the Holdo maneuver wrecks the Supremacy, she duels Finn in the hangar. He defeats her, and she falls to her death in the fires consuming the ship.

birth.source: The Wookieepedia Phasma infobox and Early life section both say 'born in 6 ABY on Parnassos', sourced to the Star Wars: Timelines era references and the Captain Phasma comic material.

death.source: The Wookieepedia Phasma infobox gives death as 34 ABY aboard the Supremacy in the Crait system, during the events of Episode VIII: The Last Jedi.

notes.detail: Canon, films and merchandise almost always call her 'Captain Phasma'. It is also the title of her comic series. That makes it a useful search and display alias.

The Parnassos chronology (her time as co-leader at 16, the Claw war two years later, joining the First Order) is only dated relative to her age and to 'ten years after she joined' in the Phasma novel's frame story, so those years (~22–24 ABY) are estimates. Only her birth (6 ABY) and death (34 ABY) are stated outright.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jabba_D.description: Jabba is the most notorious gangster of the Outer Rim. For centuries he ran smuggling, spice, slavery, gambling and piracy from his desert palace on Tatooine, and he became one of the most powerful members of the Grand Hutt Council. During the High Republic he took part in a Hutt plot to wreck a treaty on Hynestia, and was captured and held for ransom for it. By the fall of the Republic he was hosting the Boonta Eve Classic, where a young slave named Anakin Skywalker won. When the Clone Wars began, Count Dooku and his uncle Ziro had his infant son Rotta kidnapped, hoping to turn the Hutts against the Republic. The plan failed when Anakin and Ahsoka Tano brought the child home, and Jabba opened his hyperspace lanes to the Republic. He later had Ziro killed, and Maul's Shadow Collective forced him into a short alliance. Under the Empire he kept his power by making deals with Darth Vader, and after Vader wiped out the rest of the Hutt Council he was left in sole control of the Hutt Clans. His long feud with the smuggler Han Solo ended with Solo frozen in carbonite and hung in his throne room. That trophy brought Luke Skywalker and his friends to Tatooine, and in 4 ABY, above the Great Pit of Carkoon, Leia Organa strangled Jabba with the chain he had used to keep her captive.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jabba_D.socialDesc: Jabba the Hutt ruled Tatooine's underworld for centuries, courted by Republic and Empire alike, until Leia Organa strangled him with her chains in 4 ABY.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jabba_D.timeline:
600 BBY - Birth on Nal Hutta

Jabba is born into the Desilijic clan. His grandparents are Mama and Papa the Hutts, and his uncles are Ziro and Ebor.

Centuries before the Galactic Civil War - Rise to crime lord

Jabba builds a criminal empire from his palace in Tatooine's Northern Dune Sea. Working with the Crymorah Syndicate wins him a seat on the Grand Hutt Council.

Before 232 BBY - The Hynestian treaty plot

Jabba and other Hutts try to spark a diplomatic incident at a treaty banquet on Hynestia. Jedi stop them, and Queen Nyla takes the Hutts captive and holds them for ransom.

32 BBY - Boonta Eve Classic

Jabba hosts the Boonta Eve Classic podrace in Mos Espa and dozes through the race that Anakin Skywalker wins.

22 BBY - Rotta's kidnapping

Jabba's son Rotta is kidnapped in a plot run by Count Dooku and Ziro. Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano bring the Huttlet back. After Padmé Amidala exposes Ziro, Jabba signs a treaty that opens Hutt hyperspace lanes to the Republic.

~21 BBY - The Papanoida affair

Jabba lets Baron Papanoida test the bounty hunter Greedo, which proves Greedo kidnapped the Pantoran chairman's daughters.

~21 BBY - Ziro eliminated

The Hutt Council has Cad Bane free Ziro from Republic custody. Jabba then hires Sy Snootles, who kills Ziro and brings Jabba his incriminating journal.

~20 BBY - Forced into the Shadow Collective

Maul's forces beat the Hutt Council and corner Jabba in his palace. Jabba is forced to supply the takeover of Mandalore.

Early Imperial Era - Water tax and Kenobi

During a drought, Jabba's thugs collect water taxes until a hidden Obi-Wan Kenobi stops them. Jabba hires Black Krrsantan to track down whoever interfered.

~10 BBY - Han Solo joins his payroll

Han Solo becomes Jabba's best smuggler. Later Solo dumps a cargo to escape Imperial inspectors and ends up deep in debt to Jabba.

1 BBY - Docking Bay 94

Han Solo kills Greedo. Jabba confronts Solo in Mos Eisley and gives him more time to pay, at fifteen percent interest. Solo joins the Rebellion instead, and Jabba puts a large bounty on him.

0 ABY - Deal with Darth Vader

After the Death Star is destroyed, Vader force-chokes Jabba into lending him Boba Fett and Black Krrsantan. Jabba then agrees to supply the Imperial war machine in return for being left to run his empire.

~3 ABY - Sole master of the Hutt Clans

Vader kills the rest of the Grand Hutt Council, which leaves Jabba the only surviving member and the most powerful Hutt in the galaxy.

~3 ABY - Solo delivered in carbonite

Boba Fett delivers the frozen Han Solo, and Jabba hangs him in his throne room as his favorite decoration. Around the same time he sends Kay Vess to find out who Zerek Besh has planted as a spy in his palace.

4 ABY - Death at the Great Pit of Carkoon

Jabba captures Luke Skywalker's rescue party and tries to feed them to the Sarlacc. During the fight, Leia Organa strangles him with her slave chain aboard his sail barge, the Khetanna, which is then destroyed.

birth.source: Wookieepedia, Jabba Desilijic Tiure: the infobox gives 'born 600 BBY, Nal Hutta', and the biography says he was born in 600 BBY.

death.source: Wookieepedia, Jabba Desilijic Tiure: the infobox gives 'died 4 ABY, Khetanna, Tatooine'. He is killed by Leia Organa in Return of the Jedi.

notes.current: Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back
notes.detail: Jabba does not appear on screen in The Empire Strikes Back. He is only mentioned, when Boba Fett is taking the frozen Han Solo to him. His film appearances are The Phantom Menace, A New Hope (Special Edition only) and Return of the Jedi.

Jabba appears in A New Hope only in the Docking Bay 94 scene restored for the 1997 Special Edition. Canon treats that scene as having happened, so the entry is valid. You may still want to note that it only applies to the Special Edition.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Yoda.description: For more than eight centuries, Yoda shaped the Jedi Order. He was its long-serving Grand Master, a teacher of younglings and Padawans, and the Jedi who outlived the Order's fall long enough to hand its legacy to Luke Skywalker. He was already a Grand Master in the High Republic era. In 382 BBY he helped end the Night of Sorrow on Dalna, and afterwards he chose to keep what the Jedi had learned about the Nameless creatures out of the Archives. Nearly 150 years later he stepped away from the Council to teach aboard the Star Hopper and fought the Nihil at Trymant IV and beyond. His apprentices over the centuries included Kantam Sy and Dooku, who later became a Sith Lord. In the last days of the Republic he doubted that Anakin Skywalker should be trained, and he sensed that a hidden Sith Master was still at work. He brought the clone army to Geonosis and commanded Republic forces through the Clone Wars. During the war the spirit of Qui-Gon Jinn taught him how to keep his identity after death. When Order 66 wiped out the Jedi, Yoda fought Darth Sidious in the Senate chamber, lost, and went into exile on Dagobah. Years later, after facing his own failures, he trained Luke Skywalker. He died of old age in 4 ABY and became one with the Force. Decades later he appeared to Luke on Ahch-To and helped his old student forgive himself.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Yoda.socialDesc: Yoda, the Jedi Grand Master who taught for eight centuries, led clone armies in the Clone Wars, survived Order 66 and trained Luke Skywalker on Dagobah.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Yoda.timeline:
896 BBY - Birth

Yoda is born. His species is ancient and mysterious, and he never reveals where he comes from.

~890s BBY - Youngling of the Jedi Order

Yoda joins the Order as a youngling. He finds his kyber crystal at the Gathering and builds his first lightsaber with Professor Huyang aboard the Crucible.

~880s BBY - Padawan years

He is paired with a Master younger than usual and travels to many worlds as a Padawan.

796 BBY - Becomes a Jedi Master

At about one hundred years old, Yoda begins the eight centuries he will spend training generations of Jedi.

~382 BBY - Grand Master of the High Republic

Yoda sits on the Jedi High Council and shares the title of Grand Master. He advises Chancellor Kyong Greylark during the crisis involving the Path of the Open Hand.

382 BBY - The Night of Sorrow

Yoda travels to Dalna with Greylark and joins the battle against the Path. With Yaddle, he rescues Gella Nattai and Axel Greylark from a collapsing sinkhole.

382 BBY - Keeping the Nameless secret

After the funeral for the fallen Jedi, Yoda and Creighton Sun agree to keep what they know about the Nameless creatures out of the Jedi Archives.

~230s BBY - Master of Kantam Sy

At the Endovar temple, Yoda lets his Padawan Kantam Sy leave the Order. When Sy returns, Yoda knights them so they can train Lula Talisola.

233 BBY - Assigning initiates

At the Grand Temple on Coruscant, Yoda sends younglings to outposts across the galaxy. He gives Kai Brightstar his own training saber.

232 BBY - Sabbatical aboard the Star Hopper

Yoda leaves the Council to teach Padawans aboard the Star Hopper and helps Avar Kriss's Force network during the Great Hyperspace Disaster.

232 BBY - Trymant IV

Yoda fights the Nihil during the Emergence at Trymant IV and finds a strange artifact aboard Marchion Ro's ship.

232 BBY - Starlight Beacon and the Nihil

Yoda attends the dedication of Starlight Beacon and takes Zeen Mrala in. He then hunts the Nihil, starting in the Bright Jewel system.

230 BBY - Return at Corellia

Yoda reappears after disappearing for more than a year. With Azlin Rell, he helps Kantam Sy and other Jedi fight the Nihil at the Corellian Shipyards.

~Late centuries BBY - Teacher of future Masters

Yoda trains Dooku and Cin Drallig as Padawans, and he also mentors Mace Windu, Ki-Adi-Mundi and Obi-Wan Kenobi.

32 BBY - The Chosen One

The Council turns down Qui-Gon Jinn's request to train Anakin Skywalker. After Qui-Gon dies on Naboo, the Council lets Anakin train anyway, over Yoda's objections, and Yoda senses that a Sith Master remains.

22 BBY - First Battle of Geonosis

Yoda brings the new clone army to Geonosis and rescues the surviving Jedi. He then duels Count Dooku, his former Padawan.

22–19 BBY - Clone Wars general

Yoda commands Republic forces and serves as a senior strategist throughout the war.

19 BBY - Lessons from Qui-Gon Jinn

Qui-Gon's spirit guides Yoda on a journey that teaches him how to keep his identity after death.

19 BBY - Order 66 and the duel with Sidious

Yoda survives the clone betrayal on Kashyyyk and faces Emperor Palpatine in the Senate chamber. He fails to defeat him.

19 BBY - Exile on Dagobah

Yoda helps hide the Skywalker twins and goes into hiding on Dagobah.

~2 BBY - Guiding Kanan and Ezra

From afar, Yoda speaks to Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger through the Force and guides them at the Lothal Jedi Temple.

1 BBY - Kenobi becomes one with the Force

After Obi-Wan's death, Yoda talks with his spirit. He faces his past in the Cave of Evil and agrees to train Luke.

3 ABY - Training Luke Skywalker

Yoda trains Luke on Dagobah until Luke leaves to rescue his friends at Cloud City.

4 ABY - Death on Dagobah

Weak with age, Yoda confirms that Vader is Luke's father and tells him about another Skywalker. He then dies and becomes one with the Force.

4 ABY - Spirit at Endor

Yoda's spirit appears with those of Obi-Wan and Anakin at the victory celebration.

34 ABY - Lesson on Ahch-To

Yoda appears to the exiled Luke, burns the ancient tree with lightning, and teaches him that failure is the greatest teacher.

birth.source: Wookieepedia Yoda infobox (born 896 BBY), which matches 'nine hundred years before the Battle of Endor' and Yoda's age of 900 at his death in Return of the Jedi.

death.source: Wookieepedia Yoda infobox (died 4 ABY, Dagobah); Yoda dies during Episode VI: Return of the Jedi.

notes.detail: Yoda does not appear in A New Hope and is not even mentioned in it. His first film appearance is The Empire Strikes Back.

The Wookieepedia text I was given doesn't list it (the article is cut off, so I couldn't check its full appearances list). Please confirm he actually appears, not just in a reference or a rumor, before keeping it.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/R2-D2.description: R2-D2 is the astromech who keeps turning up at the turning points of galactic history. He was never fully memory-wiped, and decades of unbroken memory made him stubborn, resourceful and fiercely loyal. He first proved himself in 32 BBY by repairing Queen Amidala's starship under fire during the Naboo blockade. That same year he flew beside a young Anakin Skywalker when Anakin destroyed the Droid Control Ship. He watched Anakin and Padmé marry, then served as Anakin's partner through the Clone Wars, helping to rescue Jabba's son, surviving capture by General Grievous and carrying a distress call from Vanqor that saved two Jedi. When the Republic fell he passed into Bail Organa's care. Years later Princess Leia hid the stolen Death Star plans inside him, and the mission that followed brought him to Luke Skywalker and led to the first Death Star's destruction. He stayed with Luke through Hoth, Cloud City, Jabba's palace and Endor, and later through Luke's failed attempt to rebuild the Jedi Order. After Luke vanished, R2-D2 went into a long low-power sleep with the Resistance. He woke after the Battle of Starkiller Base carrying the last piece of the map to Luke. He went on to guide Rey to Ahch-To and flew as Poe Dameron's copilot at the Battle of Exegol.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/R2-D2.socialDesc: R2-D2, the stubborn astromech who carried the Death Star plans, served Padmé, Anakin and Luke, and rolled through every era from Naboo to Exegol.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/R2-D2.timeline:
~32 BBY - Built by Industrial Automaton

The R2-series astromech is built by 32 BBY at the latest and joins the Royal House of Naboo, serving aboard Queen Amidala's royal starship.

32 BBY - Running the Blockade

He is the only one of four astromechs to survive a hull repair under fire. He restores the ship's shields so it can escape the Trade Federation blockade.

32 BBY - Meeting Anakin and C-3PO

On Tatooine he meets Anakin Skywalker and C-3PO, helps work on Anakin's podracer, and cheers him on at the Boonta Eve Classic.

32 BBY - Battle of Naboo

He rides in the N-1 starfighter that young Anakin launches by accident, and helps him destroy the Droid Control Ship.

28 BBY - Senator's Aide

He follows Padmé to Coruscant when she becomes a senator and works as her unobtrusive recorder and assistant.

22 BBY - Geonosis and a Secret Wedding

He protects Padmé on Naboo and Geonosis, saves her in the droid foundry, and puts C-3PO back together. With C-3PO he is the only witness to Anakin and Padmé's wedding, after which he passes into Anakin's service.

22 BBY - Christophsis and Teth

He exposes the clone traitor Slick on Christophsis, then helps Anakin and Ahsoka rescue Jabba's son Rotta.

22 BBY - Hunting the Malevolence

He helps Anakin and Obi-Wan board Grievous's flagship to rescue Padmé, and the ship is destroyed.

22 BBY - Captured by Grievous

Lost after the fighting at Bothawui, he is sold to General Grievous. Anakin rescues him from Skytop Station, and he defeats the spy droid R3-S6.

~21 BBY - Clone Wars Missions

He serves on Orto Plutonia, in the Blue Shadow Virus crisis, and in the liberation of Ryloth. He also helps hunt Cad Bane, who kidnaps him and wipes his memory to plan the Senate hostage crisis.

~21 BBY - The Vanqor Trap

When Boba Fett's trap leaves Anakin and Mace Windu pinned under wreckage, he fights off gundarks and bounty hunters and gets their distress call to Coruscant.

~21 BBY - Infiltrating the Citadel

He leads a squad of reprogrammed battle droids that carries the frozen strike team to Lola Sayu to rescue Even Piell.

19 BBY - Fall of the Republic

He flies with Anakin in the rescue of Chancellor Palpatine and is present as Anakin falls to the dark side. Afterward he is placed with Bail Organa, and C-3PO's memory is wiped while his own is left intact.

~5 BBY - Aiding the Rebellion

Now serving Bail Organa, he and C-3PO briefly cross paths with the Ghost crew on a mission to Lothal.

1 BBY - Carrier of the Death Star Plans

Aboard the Tantive IV, Princess Leia hides the stolen Death Star plans and her plea to Obi-Wan Kenobi inside him. He escapes to Tatooine, where he is sold to the Lars family and finds Luke Skywalker.

0 BBY - Battle of Yavin

He delivers the plans to the Rebel Alliance and flies as Luke's astromech in the attack that destroys the Death Star.

3 ABY - Hoth and Dagobah

He escapes the Battle of Hoth with Luke, goes with him to Dagobah to train with Yoda, and repairs the Millennium Falcon's hyperdrive as it flees Cloud City.

4 ABY - Jabba's Palace and Endor

He smuggles Luke's lightsaber into Jabba's sail barge, helps free Han Solo, and fights alongside the Ewoks at the Battle of Endor while the second Death Star is destroyed.

9 ABY - Arrival of Luke Skywalker

He goes with Luke to rescue Grogu from Moff Gideon's cruiser, then to Luke's Jedi school, where Grogu begins training.

28 ABY - Fall of Luke's Jedi Temple

Luke's new Jedi Order is destroyed. After Luke disappears, R2-D2 powers down into a long low-power sleep with the Resistance.

34 ABY - Reawakening

After the Battle of Starkiller Base he wakes up and completes the map to Luke. He then travels with Rey and Chewbacca to Ahch-To and reunites with Luke there.

34 ABY - Rekindling Luke's Hope

He plays Luke the old recording of Leia's plea, which helps persuade Luke to help Rey.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

He restores C-3PO's wiped memory and flies as Poe Dameron's copilot in the decisive battle against the Final Order.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Babu_Fr.description: Babu Frik is known for the droid job that helped decide the war against the Sith: he could reprogram almost any droid, however well protected. A tiny black-market droidsmith, he ran a workshop for the Spice Runners of Kijimi for decades. There he repaired the gang's droids, including EV-6B6 for a young Poe Dameron and Zorii Bliss, and he helped Poe slip away when Poe left the gang to join the New Republic. Babu lived through the First Order occupation of Kijimi. In 35 ABY Poe brought the Resistance heroes back to him, and Babu got past C-3PO's programming so the droid could read out the Sith inscription on the Blade of Ochi. The procedure wiped C-3PO's memory. Babu then alerted Jannah's band on Kef Bir to help the heroes, and he escaped with Zorii just before a Sith Eternal Star Destroyer destroyed Kijimi. The two joined Lando Calrissian's Citizens' Fleet and flew a Y-wing at the Battle of Exegol, where they helped destroy a Xyston-class Star Destroyer. Afterward they celebrated the victory on Ajan Kloss, and Babu formally joined the Resistance.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Babu_Fr.socialDesc: Babu Frik, the tiny Kijimi droidsmith who unlocked C-3PO's forbidden memory, then flew a Y-wing at Exegol after his home planet was destroyed.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Babu_Fr.timeline:
~50 BBY - Birth

Babu Frik is born around this year. Canon gives only an approximate date.

~18 ABY - Droidsmith for the Spice Runners

Babu works as the Spice Runners of Kijimi's droidsmith. Zorii Bliss asks after him during the gang's mission to rescue Tomasso on Quintil.

~18 ABY - Repairing EV-6B6

Once Poe Dameron and Zorii Bliss join the gang, Zorii brings Poe and their damaged droid EV-6B6 to Babu, and he fixes it.

~18 ABY - Helping Poe escape

When Poe leaves the Spice Runners to join the New Republic, Babu lets him take a holographic disguise matrix so he can get offworld unnoticed.

~34 ABY - Occupation of Kijimi

At some point after the Battle of Crait, the First Order occupies Kijimi, making life harder for Babu and the spice runners.

35 ABY - Translating the Sith dagger

Poe brings Rey, Finn, BB-8 and C-3PO to Babu's workshop. Babu gets around C-3PO's programming so he can read out the Sith inscription on the Blade of Ochi, which erases the droid's memory.

35 ABY - Contacting Kef Bir

After the Resistance group leaves, Babu contacts Jannah and Company 77 on Kef Bir so they can help the heroes find the Emperor's wayfinder.

35 ABY - Destruction of Kijimi

Babu escapes with Zorii Bliss, leaving behind a battle droid he was working on, just before a Xyston-class Star Destroyer destroys Kijimi with its superlaser.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

Babu and Zorii join Lando Calrissian's Citizens' Fleet and fly a Y-wing against the Sith Eternal, helping destroy one of the Xyston-class Star Destroyers.

35 ABY - Victory and joining the Resistance

Babu celebrates the Emperor's defeat on Ajan Kloss and later joins the Resistance.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's infobox lists birth as 'c. 50 BBY', and the biography says 'Born around 50 BBY'. It is an approximate canon date, not an exact one.

death.source: No death is recorded. Babu survives the destruction of Kijimi and the Battle of Exegol (35 ABY) and later joins the Resistance.

notes.current: Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ben_Sol.description: Heir to both the Skywalker legacy and the Solo name, Ben Solo is best known as Kylo Ren, the masked "Jedi Killer" who turned against his family and rose to rule the First Order. The son of Han Solo and Leia Organa, he was born on the day the Galactic Civil War formally ended. He grew up lonely while his parents were busy with their careers, and from childhood Snoke whispered to him in his mind, a voice that was secretly a tool of the resurrected Darth Sidious. At about ten he became his uncle Luke Skywalker's first and most gifted Padawan, and Luke expected him to help lead a new Jedi Order. In 28 ABY he learned from a public news broadcast that his grandfather was Darth Vader. Soon after, Luke briefly considered killing him in his sleep. Ben brought the temple down, abandoned the Jedi, killed the leader of the Knights of Ren to take his place, and became Snoke's enforcer. When the First Order went to war in 34 ABY, he killed his father on Starkiller Base, formed a Force bond with Rey, murdered Snoke to become Supreme Leader, and faced Luke on Crait. A year later Sidious offered to make him the new Emperor if he killed Rey. Instead, his mother's final act and the memory of his father drew him back to the light. As Ben Solo he fought beside Rey on Exegol and gave his life to bring her back, ending the Skywalker bloodline and becoming one with the Force.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ben_Sol.socialDesc: Ben Solo, son of Han and Leia, fell to the dark side as Kylo Ren and ruled the First Order as Supreme Leader before dying redeemed to save Rey on Exegol.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ben_Sol.timeline:
5 ABY - Birth on Chandrila

Born in Hanna City to Leia Organa and Han Solo, one year and four days after the Battle of Endor, on the same day the Galactic Concordance ended the Galactic Civil War. Han named him after "Ben" Kenobi.

~7 ABY - A Near Miss in the Nursery

When he was a toddler, the family's culinary droid BX-778 was corrupted by a virus and nearly killed him. Han stopped it by destroying the Phylanx Redux Transmitter.

~5–15 ABY - A Troubled Childhood

His Force powers surfaced early, often in bursts of anger. With his parents frequently away he grew lonely, and Snoke's voice, secretly an instrument of Darth Sidious, began whispering to him.

15 ABY - Padawan of Luke Skywalker

Shortly before his tenth birthday he began Jedi training under his uncle Luke and became the first student of the new Jedi Order.

~16 ABY - The New Jedi Temple

Other students, including Voe, Hennix and Tai, joined him at Luke's temple on Ossus. Ben outpaced them all in the Force and with the lightsaber, and he built a blue-bladed lightsaber of his own.

~19 ABY - Mission to Elphrona

He went with Luke and Lor San Tekka to an ancient Jedi outpost, where they clashed with the Knights of Ren. Their leader, Ren, sensed the darkness in Ben and invited him to seek the Knights out.

21 ABY - Senior Student

By now one of Luke's senior pupils, he supervised the younger students' lightsaber training while Luke travelled with Lor San Tekka.

28 ABY - The Vader Revelation

At twenty-three he learned from a public broadcast that Darth Vader was his grandfather. He felt betrayed by his family's secrecy, and Snoke used that anger against him.

28 ABY - Fall of the Jedi Temple

Sensing Snoke's hold on his nephew, Luke briefly ignited his lightsaber over Ben as he slept. Ben fought back and brought the temple down, then fled with several students as the temple was destroyed.

~28 ABY - Becoming Kylo Ren

He killed Ren on Mimban to take command of the Knights of Ren, took the name Kylo Ren, and became Snoke's apprentice and the First Order's enforcer.

34 ABY - Massacre at Tuanul

He hunted for the map to Luke Skywalker on Jakku, killed Lor San Tekka, and captured Poe Dameron.

34 ABY - Takodana and Starkiller Base

He captured Rey at Maz Kanata's castle and killed his father, Han Solo, on Starkiller Base. Rey then defeated and scarred him in a lightsaber duel.

34 ABY - The Force Bond

Snoke opened a Force connection between Ben and Rey. Through it, Ben learned the truth about the night Luke's temple fell.

34 ABY - Supreme Leader

Aboard the Supremacy he cut Snoke in half and fought beside Rey against the Praetorian Guard. He then took the title of Supreme Leader of the First Order.

34 ABY - Battle of Crait

He led the assault on the Resistance's last base and dueled Luke, only to discover he was fighting a Force projection while the Resistance escaped.

35 ABY - Summoned to Exegol

Hunting the source of the Emperor's broadcast, he found Sidious's wayfinder on Mustafar and travelled to Exegol. Sidious promised him an empire if he killed Rey. He had his broken helmet reforged and hunted her across Pasaana and Kijimi.

35 ABY - Redemption on Kef Bir

He dueled Rey in the wreckage of the second Death Star. Leia reached him with her last strength through the Force, and Rey healed his wound. A memory of his father then led him to cast his lightsaber away and become Ben Solo again.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol and Death

With Luke's lightsaber he fought beside Rey against the Knights of Ren and Sidious. After Sidious was destroyed, he gave his life force to bring Rey back to life, shared a kiss with her, and became one with the Force.
