https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cassian.description:
"

Cassian Andor spent his whole short life fighting, first as a boy fighter on a stripped mining world, then as one of the Rebellion's most trusted spies and killers, and finally as the man who got the Death Star plans off Scarif. Scavengers Clem and Maarva Andor took him from the wreck of a crashed Republic ship, renamed the boy Kassa, gave him papers saying he was born on Fest, and raised him on Ferrix. There he watched the Empire hang his adoptive father. He grew into a drifter and petty thief who only cared about getting by, until an accidental double killing on Morlana One put him in the path of Luthen Rael. For the money, he flew the escape ship in the Aldhani payroll heist. Soon after he was swept up by the Empire's harsher sentencing laws and sent to the Narkina 5 prison factory, where he helped lead the uprising that let the inmates break out. Maarva's funeral set off a riot on Ferrix, and after it he offered himself to Rael's cause. Over the next years he stole a prototype TIE Avenger, took the reprogrammed security droid K-2SO as his partner, witnessed the Empire's crimes on Ghorman, and helped Mon Mothma escape Coruscant. By then he had become a captain in Alliance Intelligence. Sent to kill Galen Erso on Eadu, he could not pull the trigger. He then gathered volunteers to back Jyn Erso's unauthorized raid on Scarif. The team, called Rogue One, sent the Death Star plans to the rebel fleet, and he died alongside Jyn when the battle station destroyed the base.

"
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cassian.socialDesc: Cassian Andor went from Ferrix thief and Narkina 5 escapee to rebel spy and captain, and gave his life on Scarif to get the Death Star plans out.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cassian.timeline:
"

33 BBY - Birth on Kenari

Born on Kenari as Kassa. He loses his mother while still young and grows up among a tribe of children left behind after mining poisoned the planet.

~27 BBY - A Fighter at Six

By his own account, he starts fighting as a revolutionary at the age of six.

~24 BBY - Rescued from Kenari

A Republic transport crashes near his village, and a scouting trip to the wreck ends with the tribe's leader dead. Maarva and Clem Andor, scavenging the ship with their droid B2EMO, find Kassa and take him off Kenari. His little sister Kerri is left behind.

~24 BBY - A New Name on Ferrix

He settles on Ferrix as Cassian Jeron Andor. Forged records say he was born on Fest.

19 BBY - Clem Andor's Execution

Clone stormtroopers arrive to bring Ferrix under Imperial control. Clem is wrongly taken for a protester and hanged on Rix Road, and the boy's attack on the troopers who did it begins a long record of trouble with the authorities.

~20 BBY - Youth Detention on Sipo

Starting at thirteen, he spends three years in a youth center on Sipo, one of several detention centers he passes through as a boy.

~17 BBY - Brief Service on Mimban

He later claims he was made to fight for the Empire on Mimban after prison. Luthen Rael says he was actually a cook there for six months and then deserted.

5 BBY - Killings on Morlana One

Looking for his sister on Morlana One, he is shaken down by two Pre-Mor security officers and kills both of them. Corporate investigators follow the trail back to Ferrix.

5 BBY - Meeting Luthen Rael

He tries to sell a stolen Imperial Starpath unit to Luthen Rael. Pre-Mor forces attack the meeting, and Rael gets him off Ferrix.

5 BBY - The Aldhani Heist

Using his adoptive father's name, Clem, he joins Vel Sartha's crew and flies the escape freighter through the Eye of Aldhani with an Imperial sector's payroll aboard. Afterward he shoots Arvel Skeen when Skeen proposes betraying the rest of the crew.

5 BBY - Arrest on Niamos

He hides out on Niamos as a tourist named Keef Girgo, but is picked up on a false charge and given six years under the Public Order Resentencing Directive.

5 BBY - Narkina 5 Escape

He works in the Narkina 5 prison factory until he and floor manager Kino Loy lead a mass uprising. He escapes with Ruescott Melshi.

5 BBY - Maarva's Funeral and the Ferrix Riot

He learns that Maarva has died and goes back to Ferrix, where he frees Bix Caleen from Imperial custody while her funeral turns into a riot. Then he goes to Luthen Rael and offers either to die or to join the fight.

4 BBY - Stealing the TIE Avenger

For Rael's network, he steals a prototype TIE Avenger from Sienar Test Facility 73. On Yavin 4 he is taken prisoner by the warring Maya Pei Brigade and escapes in the fighter.

4 BBY - Mina-Rau

He hurries to Mina-Rau as the Empire moves in, rescues Bix and his Ferrix friends, and gets them off the planet.

~2 BBY - Ghorman and K-2SO

He takes the reprogrammed Imperial security droid K-2SO as his partner. On Ghorman he witnesses the Empire's crackdown, including the massacre.

~2 BBY - Mon Mothma's Escape

After Mon Mothma denounces the Emperor in the Senate, he gets her off Coruscant and she joins the Rebellion openly.

1 BBY - Losing Luthen and Bix

After Luthen Rael dies, he helps Kleya Marki escape and brings back Rael's intelligence on the Empire's superweapon. Bix leaves him for his own safety, carrying their child, though he never knows about it.

1 BBY - Operation Fracture

Now a captain in Alliance Intelligence, he and K-2SO free Jyn Erso and take her to Jedha to find Saw Gerrera. They get away as the Death Star destroys Jedha City.

1 BBY - Mission to Eadu

General Draven orders him to kill Galen Erso, but he does not fire. Galen dies anyway when rebel ships bomb the facility.

1 BBY - Forming Rogue One

After Alliance High Command turns down Jyn's plan, he gathers volunteers to raid the Imperial archive on Scarif without authorization.

1 BBY - Death on Scarif

He and Jyn take the Death Star plans from the Citadel Tower and transmit them to the rebel fleet. The two die together on the beach when the Death Star destroys the base.

"

birth.source: Wookieepedia, Cassian Jeron Andor infobox: born 33 BBY on Kenari. This matches his being about nine when the Andors took him off Kenari around 24 BBY.

death.source: Wookieepedia, Cassian Jeron Andor infobox: died 1 BBY on Scarif, killed when the Death Star fired on the Imperial base during the Battle of Scarif (Rogue One).

notes.detail: Kassa is his Kenari birth name, and Andor Season 1 prominently shows him as young Kassa. It is the obvious second identity. He also used aliases such as Clem, Keef Girgo, Willix and Fulcrum.
Kenari is right. The Wookieepedia infobox also lists Ferrix as his adoptive homeworld, and he was raised there from about 24 BBY. His official records falsely say he was born on Fest.

Wookieepedia flags a conflict between Andor Season 2 and the Rogue One - Cassian & K-2SO Special comic. The comic tells an earlier version of how Cassian met K-2SO, and Season 2 now has priority. Neither date we show is affected, but any K-2SO origin text should follow Season 2.

His early background comes from his Rebel Alliance file, which in-universe is described as being of questionable accuracy. That includes the claims that his birth father died at Carida, that he was a child soldier in a Separatist-backed cell, and that he served on Mimban. Treat these as possibly unreliable, not as settled fact.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Beru_Wh.description: Beru Whitesun Lars is best remembered as the warm, steady aunt who raised Luke Skywalker as her own son on a remote moisture farm. As a young woman she dreamed of opening a café in Anchorhead, helped locate and deprogram the tracking chips of freed slaves, and introduced Shmi Skywalker to Cliegg Lars, whose son Owen she later married. She served blue milk at Shmi's funeral during Anakin's visit on the eve of the Clone Wars. When Obi-Wan Kenobi brought the infant Luke to the homestead at the end of the war, Beru insisted they raise him. Over the next nineteen years she often took Luke's side against her overprotective husband. In 9 BBY she took up a blaster rifle to defend the farm from the Inquisitor Reva Sevander, holding her off long enough for Luke to escape. As Luke grew restless, Beru pressed Owen to let him leave for the Academy, reminding him that the boy had too much of his father in him. In 1 BBY the family bought the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO, and stormtroopers tracing the stolen Death Star plans killed Beru and Owen and burned their home. Their deaths pushed Luke to leave Tatooine with Kenobi, and he went on to destroy the Death Star.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Beru_Wh.socialDesc: Beru Lars, Luke Skywalker's aunt, raised him on a Tatooine moisture farm, stood up for his dreams, and was killed by stormtroopers hunting R2-D2.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Beru_Wh.timeline:
Date unknown - Early Life on Tatooine

Beru Whitesun grows up on Tatooine. A cooking instructor praises her blue-milk cheese, and she starts dreaming of opening her own café in Anchorhead.

Before 22 BBY - Meeting Shmi Skywalker

While getting her portable nav computer repaired at Watto's shop in Mos Espa, Beru meets Shmi Skywalker, who is enslaved there. She later introduces Shmi to Cliegg Lars, who frees and marries her.

Before 22 BBY - Working with the White Suns

Beru helps Shmi find and deprogram the chips in freed slaves using her scanner, and she supports others on Tatooine who work to free enslaved people.

Before 22 BBY - Courting Owen Lars

Beru falls in love with Cliegg's son, Owen Lars, and the two begin dating.

22 BBY - Anakin Comes to the Homestead

Tusken Raiders abduct Shmi. Beru is at the Lars farm when Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala arrive, and she serves blue milk and cheese at Shmi's funeral.

Between 22 and 19 BBY - Marriage to Owen

Beru marries Owen and takes the Lars name. After Cliegg dies, the couple struggles with infertility while trying to start a family.

19 BBY - Receiving Luke

At the end of the Clone Wars, Obi-Wan Kenobi brings the infant Luke Skywalker to the homestead. Beru declares that she and Owen will raise him as their own.

9 BBY - Watching Over Young Luke

Beru laughs when she finds a young Luke on the homestead roof pretending to podrace. From a distance, Kenobi watches the family.

9 BBY - Defending the Homestead from Reva

Beru refuses to abandon her home when the former Inquisitor Reva Sevander hunts for Luke. She arms herself and Owen with blaster rifles and holds Reva off long enough for Luke to flee. Afterward she sees Reva carry the boy back unharmed.

Between 9 and 2 BBY - Owen's Abduction

A year after the Great Drought, the bounty hunter Krrsantan seizes Owen over water taxes owed to Jabba the Hutt. Beru goes after her husband with a rifle and tells Luke to stay safe inside.

2 BBY - Kenobi's Distant Vigil

After his clash with Maul, Kenobi watches from afar as Beru calls a seventeen-year-old Luke home at sunset.

1 BBY - Arguing for Luke's Future

Beru persuades Owen to let Luke apply to the Academy after one more season. Over dinner she warns her husband that Luke is not a farmer and has too much of his father in him.

1 BBY - Death at the Homestead

Stormtroopers trace R2-D2 and C-3PO, who carry the stolen Death Star plans, to the Lars farm. They kill Beru and Owen and burn the homestead, and their deaths lead Luke to leave Tatooine with Kenobi.

0 ABY - Legacy

Luke finally grieves for his aunt and uncle after Nakari Kelen dies. Darth Vader and Doctor Aphra later visit the ruined homestead while tracking the pilot who destroyed the Death Star.

birth.source: The birth field in Beru's Wookieepedia infobox is blank, and no canon source gives her a birth year. We only know she was a young adult and dating Owen in 22 BBY (Attack of the Clones). Bonnie Piesse was about 16–17 when she filmed the role.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 1 BBY on Tatooine. Stormtroopers killed her during A New Hope, before the Battle of Yavin.

notes.detail: Canon gives Beru no birth year, so the guess flag is correct. 48 BBY would make her about 26 in Attack of the Clones, where she is shown as a young woman still dating Owen. A somewhat later year (roughly 42–40 BBY) would match that portrayal better, but any value here is non-canon. Keep the guess flag either way.
Beru has a voice appearance in the Rebels episode 'Twin Suns', when Kenobi hears her calling Luke home at sunset (2 BBY). Add it only if voice-only appearances count for the timeline.
Her maiden name is Beru Whitesun, and Wookieepedia's article title is Beru Whitesun Lars. Adding it as the altTitle would help search.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/C1-10P.description: Chopper is the rebellion's most ill-tempered astromech. He is a battered, patched-together droid who has run for decades past his expiration date and is fiercely loyal to Hera Syndulla. He began as a navigation droid in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. When his Y-wing was shot down over Ryloth, a young Hera pulled him from the wreck and rebuilt him, and he never flew in a Y-wing again. He stayed with her through the Imperial occupation of her homeworld and followed her into space. There he became the only droid who could work the Ghost's systems, which he had rewired himself. As a member of the Spectres he pranked his crewmates, argued with everyone, and saved them again and again. He posed as Imperial droids to get into an academy and a communications ship, found out where Kanan Jarrus was being held, and gunned down TIE fighters when no one else could. He also befriended the defecting droid AP-5, and together they found the rebels a new base on Atollon, which was named Chopper Base after him. He fought through the Liberation of Lothal and stayed with Hera through the Galactic Civil War, including the rebel strikes at Scarif. He then served with her in the New Republic, where he helped in the search for Ezra Bridger and was there when Ezra finally came home.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/C1-10P.socialDesc: Chopper, the cranky patched-up astromech Hera Syndulla saved on Ryloth, kept the Ghost flying through the rebellion and into the New Republic era.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/C1-10P.timeline:
Unknown - Manufactured on Lasan

Industrial Automaton builds the C1-series astromech C1-10P on Lasan. He later keeps running for decades past his expiration date.

Clone Wars - Service in the Republic Navy

He serves as a navigation astromech in the Republic Navy and takes part in the fight for Ryloth.

Clone Wars - Shot down over Ryloth

His Y-wing is shot down. The young Hera Syndulla pulls him from the wreck and repairs him, and he refuses to ride in a Y-wing ever again.

~19 BBY - Spying on the Empire

With Hera, he watches the Imperial forces occupying Ryloth after the Republic becomes the Empire.

~19 BBY - Rescue on Ryloth

He helps Hera and Clone Force 99 rescue her parents, Cham and Eleni Syndulla, from Imperial custody.

~Early Imperial era - Leaving Ryloth

He follows Hera when she leaves Ryloth to fight the Empire. He becomes the Ghost's maintenance droid and rewires the ship so thoroughly that only he can work its computer.

11 BBY - Gorse Conflict

He waits on the Ghost while Hera meets Kanan Jarrus, who then joins the crew.

5 BBY - Convoy ambush

When the crew's attack on an Imperial convoy turns out to be a trap, he takes over the Phantom's guns and destroys the last TIE fighter.

5 BBY - Ezra joins the crew

He meets Ezra Bridger with open hostility and plays pranks on him and Zeb aboard the Ghost.

5 BBY - Encounter with R2-D2 and C-3PO

During the theft of T-7 ion disruptors, he clashes with Bail Organa's droids and helps overload the weapons before they can reach the Empire.

5 BBY - Lost in a sabacc game

Zeb bets him in a sabacc game and loses him to Lando Calrissian. The crew earns him back by helping Lando with a smuggling run.

5 BBY - Infiltrating the Imperial Academy

With black paint as a disguise, he gets into Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials to support Ezra and contact Zare Leonis.

5 BBY - Lothal communications tower

He uploads a data spike into the tower's computer so Ezra can broadcast a message of rebellion. Kanan is captured during the escape.

5 BBY - Posing as a courier droid

Disguised as the Imperial courier droid 264, he gets aboard an Imperial communications ship and learns that Kanan is being held on Tarkin's Star Destroyer.

5 BBY - Rescue at Mustafar

He brings a rebel fleet out of hyperspace to wipe out the TIE fighters chasing the Spectres after they rescue Kanan.

4 BBY - Joining Phoenix Cell

The Spectres join the wider rebellion. He escapes the Siege of Lothal and Darth Vader's attack on the Phoenix fleet.

3 BBY - Friendship with AP-5

He befriends the Imperial protocol droid AP-5. Together they find the new rebel base on Atollon, which is named Chopper Base in his honor.

2 BBY - Briefly reprogrammed

Imperials take control of him and turn him against his crew for a short time before he is restored.

2 BBY - Battle of Atollon

He escapes with the rebels when the Empire destroys Chopper Base.

1 BBY - Battle of Scarif

He goes with Hera and the Ghost as part of the Alliance fleet at Scarif.

1 BBY - Liberation of Lothal

He fights with the Spectres to free Lothal from the Empire.

Galactic Civil War - At Hera's side

He stays with General Hera Syndulla for the rest of the war against the Empire.

~9 ABY - Quest to find Ezra Bridger

Now serving the New Republic, he helps Hera and Ahsoka Tano search for the missing Ezra. He is there when Ezra returns home.

birth.source: Wookieepedia C1-10P: the birth field in the infobox is empty. The article says only that he was manufactured on Lasan and 'existed for a few decades past his expiration date', and that he served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.

death.source: Wookieepedia C1-10P: the death field in the infobox is empty. He is still active in the New Republic era (Ahsoka, ~9 ABY).

notes.detail: Canon gives no manufacture date. -30 is a reasonable guess because it comes before his Clone Wars service. However, the line that he 'existed for a few decades past his expiration date' suggests he may be older. Keeping the guess flag is correct.

Lasan is where Industrial Automaton manufactured him, according to the Wookieepedia infobox. The story ties him more closely to Ryloth, where Hera recovered him. Lasan is still the canon homeworld value.
The entry could track his model and manufacturer, and his affiliations: Republic Navy, Spectres/Phoenix Cell, Rebel Alliance, New Republic.

notes.current: The Bad Batch, Star Wars Rebels, Rogue One, Ahsoka
notes.suggested: Consider adding Star Wars: Squadrons if games are tracked
notes.detail: Wookieepedia lists Star Wars: Squadrons, the novel Alphabet Squadron and the Star Wars: Kanan comic among his appearances. All four of the current seenIn titles are correct.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Fennec_.description: Fennec Shand is an elite mercenary and Master Assassin who went from a young newcomer in the bounty-hunting trade to Boba Fett's most trusted partner. She broke into the business just after the Clone Wars. One of her first big jobs was a secret commission from the Kaminoan scientist Nala Se to recover the clone girl Omega. That hunt pitted her against Clone Force 99 on Pantora and against the veteran hunter Cad Bane at Bora Vio, where she outfought him. Over the Imperial years she built a reputation as one of the most feared and expensive guns for hire in the underworld, working for syndicates including the Hutts. After the Empire fell, the New Republic jailed many of her employers and she went on the run with a price on her head. In 9 ABY, Din Djarin and the rookie Toro Calican caught her in the Tatooine desert, and Calican shot her and left her to die. Boba Fett found her, paid to have her rebuilt with cybernetic organs, and won her loyalty. She helped him reclaim Slave I, recover his armor on Tython, and rescue Grogu from Moff Gideon's cruiser. She then stood beside him as he took Jabba's old palace and became daimyo of Mos Espa, acting as his enforcer, strategist and right hand through the war against the Pyke Syndicate.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Fennec_.socialDesc: Fennec Shand, the elite assassin who hunted Omega after the Clone Wars, was left for dead on Tatooine and saved by Boba Fett to become his right hand.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Fennec_.timeline:
19 BBY - Enters the Bounty Hunting Trade

With the Clone Wars just over, Shand begins working as a bounty hunter and gun for hire. She quickly earns a reputation for cunning and ruthlessness, and even Cad Bane takes notice.

19 BBY - Hired to Capture Omega

The Kaminoan scientist Nala Se secretly commissions Shand to bring in the clone girl Omega, who has fled Kamino with Clone Force 99, so that Omega stays out of Lama Su's hands.

19 BBY - Chase on Pantora

Acting on a tip from Raspar Six, Shand tracks Omega to Ro Station, wins the girl's trust and then fights Hunter and Wrecker. A skyway chase ends with her stolen airspeeder destroyed and Omega getting away.

19 BBY - Showdown with Cad Bane at Bora Vio

Shand kills Taun We to stop Bane's handoff of Omega. She fights Bane through the abandoned cloning facility, knocks him over a balcony and sabotages his ship, while the Bad Batch rescues Omega. Nala Se pays her for the job.

~18 BBY - Hunt for Sylar Saris

In exchange for information, Hunter and Wrecker help Shand pursue the fugitive bounty hunter Sylar Saris through the swamps of Veelo.

Imperial Era - Master Assassin

Shand becomes one of the galaxy's most feared and expensive mercenaries, working for the top crime syndicates, including the Hutt Clan, and becomes wanted by the Imperial Security Bureau.

3 ABY - Too Expensive to Hire

After the Battle of Hoth, the bondsman Syphacc hires the pit fighter Tasu Leech instead of Shand to hunt Beilert Valance, because she costs more.

~5 ABY - On the Run

After the Empire's defeat at Jakku, the New Republic imprisons many of her employers. Shand becomes a fugitive with a 10,000-credit bounty on her head.

9 ABY - Captured Beyond the Dune Sea

Hiding on Tatooine, Shand kills a pursuing hunter, then holds off Din Djarin and Toro Calican until a night assault forces her to surrender.

9 ABY - Shot by Toro Calican

Shand talks Calican into turning on Djarin, but the rookie shoots her in the stomach and leaves her for dead.

9 ABY - Saved by Boba Fett

Boba Fett finds her dying, has a Mos Eisley mod artist replace her ruined organs with cybernetics, and brings her back to health. Shand pledges herself to his service.

9 ABY - Reclaiming Slave I

Shand helps Fett infiltrate Jabba's palace to take back Slave I from Bib Fortuna. They then search the Sarlacc pit for his armor, and she kills the Sarlacc with a seismic charge.

9 ABY - Confrontation on Tython

With Fett, Shand confronts Din Djarin at the Force-henge to reclaim Fett's armor. The three fight off Moff Gideon's stormtroopers, but Dark Troopers carry Grogu away.

9 ABY - Raid on Morak

Shand provides sniper cover alongside Cara Dune while Djarin and Migs Mayfeld infiltrate the Imperial refinery to find Gideon's cruiser.

9 ABY - Rescue of Grogu

Shand joins Bo-Katan Kryze, Koska Reeves and Cara Dune in storming Gideon's light cruiser and taking the bridge. Luke Skywalker arrives and leaves with Grogu.

9 ABY - Taking Jabba's Palace

Back on Tatooine, Shand stands beside Fett as he kills Bib Fortuna and claims the throne. She becomes his chief lieutenant as he takes over as daimyo of Mos Espa.

9 ABY - Defending the Daimyo

Shand fights off the Night Wind assassins who ambush Fett in Mos Espa. She advises him through his dealings with the Hutt twins, Black Krrsantan and Mayor Mok Shaiz.

9 ABY - Recruiting the Mods

Shand brings a gang of cybernetically modified youths into Fett's service as enforcers.

9 ABY - War with the Pyke Syndicate

During the fight for Mos Espa, Shand kills the mayor and the crime bosses who betrayed Fett, then fights alongside Fett, Din Djarin and the Mods until the Pykes are defeated.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's infobox leaves the birth field blank. Canon only says she was a newcomer to the bounty-hunting scene in 19 BBY (The Bad Batch, "Cornered"), so she was probably an adult by then. There is no canon year.

death.source: Wookieepedia's infobox leaves the death field blank. She is alive at the end of The Book of Boba Fett (9 ABY), and no canon source records her death.

notes.detail: Wookieepedia's infobox gives her homeworld as the Mid Rim Territories, and The Book of Boba Fett Chapter 4 has Fett identify her as coming from the Mid Rim. The planet itself is never named.
No canon birth year exists. In 19 BBY she is described as 'new to the scene', which puts a 39 BBY guess (age about 20) within reason. Keep the guess flag on.

notes.detail: Both are recorded on Wookieepedia and are central to her characterization in The Mandalorian and The Book of Boba Fett.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mon_Mot.description: Mon Mothma is the political architect of the Rebellion: a senator who spent nearly two decades inside the Imperial system while secretly building the movement that would bring it down. She was one of the youngest senators in Republic history, and during the Clone Wars she led the loyalist opposition to the war. Alongside Bail Organa, Padmé Amidala and Onaconda Farr, she fought expanded military spending and the Chancellor's growing emergency powers, and she watched Farr die of poison in the middle of that fight. After Palpatine declared the Empire she survived the arrests of dissenting senators and tried to limit his rule by law with the Imperial Rebirth Act. When that failed, she and Organa quietly met Saw Gerrera and set up the network that became the Alliance. For years she led a double life, moving money to Luthen Rael's rebels behind the front of a society hostess. Her marriage grew cold, and she paid for her cover by promising her daughter to a gangster's son. Her lifelong friend Tay Kolma was killed to protect that secret. After the Ghorman Massacre she denounced Palpatine as a genocidal monster on the Senate floor and fled. Her resignation led to the formal founding of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, with Mothma as its Chancellor. She approved the mission that stole the Death Star plans, helped plan the attack at Endor, and after victory became the first Chancellor of the New Republic. There she signed the Galactic Concordance and pushed to disarm the galaxy, a policy tested by the threat of Thrawn's return.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mon_Mot.socialDesc: Mon Mothma, the senator who led a double life bankrolling rebels, denounced Palpatine, and steered the Rebel Alliance to victory as its Chancellor.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mon_Mot.timeline:
~48 BBY - Birth on Chandrila

Born into a political family. Her father is a Republic arbiter-general and her mother, Tanis, is a governor on Chandrila.

~33 BBY - A Teenage Rebellion and Marriage

At fifteen she briefly turns away from politics to become a historian and tours the ruins of Phothrell. Following Chandrilan custom, she marries Perrin Fertha.

~32 BBY - Youngest Senator

At sixteen she joins the Galactic Senate as Chandrila's senator, one of the youngest ever, and moves to Coruscant with Perrin.

28 BBY - Meeting Padmé Amidala

She speaks at the first Senate session Padmé Amidala attends. At first she doubts the new senator, but later becomes her ally and mentor alongside Bail Organa and Onaconda Farr.

~22 BBY - Loyalist Committee

As a member of Palpatine's Loyalist Committee, she works to stop the Separatist Crisis from turning into war. War breaks out anyway.

22–19 BBY - Voice for Peace in the Clone Wars

She opposes bank deregulation and the bill for more clone troopers, and speaks against wider emergency powers. She attends the Alderaan refugee conference and represents the Republic at peace talks on Mandalore.

~21 BBY - Murder of Onaconda Farr

Farr is poisoned at a gathering of the anti-war senators, and Mothma is present. The military spending bill passes despite their efforts.

~19 BBY - Trial of Ahsoka Tano

She attends the funeral for the victims of the Jedi Temple bombing and sits in on Ahsoka Tano's trial, where Barriss Offee confesses.

19 BBY - Seeds of Rebellion

She meets in secret with Organa and other concerned senators. They agree to take a petition to the Chancellor rather than turn to the Jedi.

19 BBY - Rise of the Empire

Palpatine declares the Galactic Empire. Mothma attends Padmé's funeral on Naboo. She is arrested with other dissenting senators and freed after publicly declaring her loyalty.

19 BBY - The Imperial Rebirth Act

She drafts a bill to limit the Emperor's power. To stop an assassination plot that would have ruined it, she sets off Soujen Vak-Nhalis's hidden self-destruct device and is wounded herself. Palpatine vetoes the bill's key limits.

19 BBY - Pact on Phothrell

With Organa, she meets Saw Gerrera in the ruins of Phothrell. She agrees to be the political heart of their underground resistance.

18 BBY - Building "the Alliance"

She begins gathering military and intelligence assets into her own network.

5 BBY - A Double Life

Still a senator in the Imperial Senate, she secretly funds Luthen Rael's rebel network. She hides the money with help from her childhood friend Tay Kolma, while her marriage and her relationship with her daughter Leida fall apart.

~4 BBY - Leida's Wedding

To cover her rebel finances, she arranges Leida's marriage to Stekan Sculdun. During the wedding festivities, Tay Kolma is killed to protect her secret.

2 BBY - Denouncing Palpatine

After the Ghorman Massacre, she condemns the Emperor on the Senate floor and escapes Coruscant as a fugitive.

2 BBY - Founding of the Rebel Alliance

Her break with the Senate unites the rebel cells as the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and she leads it as Chancellor.

1 BBY - The Death Star Plans

She approves recruiting Jyn Erso. The Rogue One mission then steals the Death Star plans at Scarif.

0 BBY–4 ABY - Leading the Galactic Civil War

She leads the Alliance through the years after the Battle of Yavin and mentors Leia Organa.

4 ABY - Briefing for Endor

She briefs the rebel fleet on the second Death Star and the plan to attack it at Endor.

4–5 ABY - Chancellor of the New Republic

She is elected the first Chancellor of the New Republic, with its Senate seated on Chandrila. She plans to give up wartime powers and to cut the fleet by ninety percent.

5 ABY - Galactic Concordance

She signs the peace treaty with the Empire after the Battle of Jakku. The Military Disarmament Act follows.

9 ABY - The Thrawn Question

She presides over the Senate while Hera Syndulla is questioned over her warnings that Thrawn is returning.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox gives birth as "c. 48 BBY" (circa). This matches her being fifteen around 33 BBY and a sixteen-year-old senator around 32 BBY, as sourced to Queen's Shadow and The Mask of Fear.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox has no death date. She is alive in her latest dated appearance, Ahsoka (9 ABY).

notes.current: absent (48 BBY shown as a known date)
notes.detail: Wookieepedia gives only "c. 48 BBY". The year is inferred from her age at events around 33–32 BBY, and the article has a Conflicting-sources warning covering Queen's Shadow, The Rebel Files and The Mask of Fear. 48 BBY is the right value, but presenting it as a hard fact overstates it.

Wookieepedia flags Queen's Shadow, Star Wars: The Rebel Files and Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear as conflicting with each other on parts of her early life, such as her age at marriage and when she entered the Senate. The broad timeline (senator around 32 BBY) still fits c. 48 BBY.
Wookieepedia records "Double-M" as an affectionate nickname. This is optional.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Bail_Pr.description: Bail Organa led the loyal opposition in the Senate for decades and quietly helped found the Rebel Alliance. He was born Bail Prestor and gave up his family name to marry Breha Organa, heir to Alderaan's throne. After the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY he replaced Bail Antilles in the Galactic Senate, where he became known for his honesty and his strong defense of democracy. He worked alongside Mon Mothma, Onaconda Farr and Padmé Amidala, and was one of the Jedi Order's closest political friends. During the Clone Wars he pushed for relief missions, refugee aid and peace efforts, but hawkish rivals kept blocking him. He signed the Petition of 2,000 against Palpatine's growing power, only to watch the Republic become the Empire. In the chaos after Order 66 he helped Yoda and Obi-Wan Kenobi escape, and he and Breha adopted Padmé's infant daughter Leia, hiding her from her father, Darth Vader. Publicly he stayed in the Imperial Senate. In secret he used Alderaan's wealth to fund resistance cells, recruited Ahsoka Tano to coordinate them, and helped merge them into the Alliance to Restore the Republic in 2 BBY. On the eve of Scarif he sent Leia to find Kenobi and went home to warn his people that war was coming. He died days later when the Death Star destroyed Alderaan, and the rebellion he helped build remembered him as one of its great martyrs.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Bail_Pr.socialDesc: Bail Organa, Alderaan's senator and quiet architect of the Rebel Alliance, raised Leia as his daughter and died when the Death Star destroyed his world.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Bail_Pr.timeline:
Date unknown - Birth as Bail Prestor

Born on Alderaan into House Prestor, one of the Elder Houses. As a boy he dreamed of chasing purrgil beyond Kathou, and he looked up to the Jedi Thraymus Argent, who investigated an incident in his family.

Date unknown - Marriage to Breha Organa

Married Alderaan's crown princess and took the Organa name. When Breha became queen he took on the consort's titles, including Viceroy, along with the roles of First Chairman and Governor of Alderaan.

~40–34 BBY - Rescue on Planet WG4587

While serving as junior senator, his corvette crashed on a world full of kaiju-like creatures called kaijura. Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi came to his rescue.

32 BBY - Senator of Alderaan

After the Invasion of Naboo he succeeded Bail Antilles in the Galactic Senate and resigned as governor. He befriended the newly elected Mon Mothma and advised Chancellor Palpatine.

28 BBY - Allying with Padmé Amidala

Led a progressive faction with Mothma and Onaconda Farr. He saved Amidala's double from a plot set in a condemned part of the Senate building, brought Amidala into his faction, and hosted her on Alderaan during the Senate recess.

28 BBY - The Bromlarch crisis

Urged Amidala to join the survey team sent to Bromlarch. The relief package that followed, the Mid Rim Cooperation Motion, was named after one of his own remarks.

24 BBY - Loyalist Committee

Joined Palpatine's Loyalist Committee during the Separatist Crisis while opposing both the Emergency Powers Act and the Military Creation Act.

22 BBY - Start of the Clone Wars

Heard Kenobi's report from Geonosis and argued that the Senate would not approve the clone army before a Separatist attack. He then watched the Grand Army of the Republic launch.

22–20 BBY - Humanitarian efforts

Led relief efforts for Christophsis and Ryloth, organized the Alderaan Refugee Conference, and pushed for peace. His faction's attempt to cut military spending ended with Onaconda Farr's murder.

19 BBY - Petition of 2,000

Joined the Delegation of 2,000 in calling on Palpatine to give up his emergency powers, then witnessed the Jedi being declared traitors and the Galactic Empire proclaimed.

19 BBY - Adoption of Leia

Rescued Yoda after Order 66, sheltered Kenobi, and adopted Padmé's daughter Leia with Breha. He also took Kenobi's newborn nephew Luke's safety into his circle of secrets.

~18 BBY - Recruiting Ahsoka Tano

After a run-in with the Inquisitorius, he brought Ahsoka Tano into his growing resistance movement.

9 BBY - Leia's kidnapping

When Leia was kidnapped, he called Obi-Wan Kenobi out of exile to bring her home.

~5–3 BBY - Coordinating rebel cells

Worked secretly with Ahsoka Tano and the Phoenix cell, including the Lothal ship deal that exposed Leia to the rebellion, while carefully keeping up his public role in the Imperial Senate.

2 BBY - Birth of the Rebel Alliance

After Mon Mothma denounced the Empire and fled the Senate, the scattered rebel cells joined together as the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Bail stayed in the Senate and later handed his seat to Leia.

1 BBY - Scarif and the Death Star

Sat on Alliance High Command during the Scarif crisis. He sent Leia to Tatooine to find Kenobi and went home to warn Alderaan that there would be no peace.

1 BBY - Death on Alderaan

Killed along with Breha and the rest of Alderaan's people when the Death Star destroyed the planet.

birth.source: The Wookieepedia infobox leaves the birth field blank. No canon source gives Bail Organa's birth year.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 1 BBY, Alderaan (destroyed by the Death Star a few days after the Battle of Scarif).

notes.detail: Canon gives no birth year; the Wookieepedia infobox is blank. 67 BBY is Bail's old Legends birth year. Keeping the guess flag is right. Just don't present it as canon.
Bail appears in the Tales of the Jedi episode "Resolve". His article even carries a conflicting-sources notice comparing that episode with the Ahsoka novel.
I believe Bail appears in The Bad Batch season 2, in the Senate scenes of "Truth and Consequences". Please check before adding.
His death happens during the events of A New Hope, when Alderaan is destroyed, but he never appears on screen in that film. His last on-screen appearance is Rogue One.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jar_Jar.description: Jar Jar Binks is best remembered as the clumsy, good-hearted outcast whose actions helped save his world and then, without his meaning to, helped end the Republic. Boss Nass had banished him from Otoh Gunga for wrecking a heyblibber submarine. During the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY, Qui-Gon Jinn saved his life and he attached himself to the Jedi. He guided them through the planet's core, travelled with Queen Amidala to Tatooine and Coruscant, and then pointed her to the Gungan Grand Army. That tip led to the alliance between Gungans and Naboo that won the Battle of Naboo, and Jar Jar himself fought in it as a newly promoted Bombad General. He later became a Junior Representative in the Galactic Senate. In 22 BBY, while filling in for Senator Amidala, he proposed that Chancellor Palpatine be given emergency powers to raise a clone army. That motion started the Clone Wars. During the war he flew diplomatic and field missions: he helped secure supplies from Toydaria, saved Padmé on Rodia, took command after a shuttle crash on Florrum, brought the Gungan army to Mon Cala, and posed as Boss Lyonie to capture General Grievous. He also rescued Queen Julia of Bardotta alongside Mace Windu. After Padmé's funeral and the rise of the Empire, his own people shunned him for his part in Palpatine's rise. By 5 ABY he was a street clown in Theed, disliked by adults but loved by children. There he befriended the burned refugee orphan Mapo and took him on as his clowning apprentice.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jar_Jar.socialDesc: Jar Jar Binks, the clumsy Gungan exile turned general and senator whose motion gave Palpatine emergency powers, ended up a scorned street clown in Theed.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jar_Jar.timeline:
32 BBY - Banished from Otoh Gunga

Boss Nass exiles Jar Jar from the underwater city for crashing his personal heyblibber submarine.

32 BBY - Meeting Qui-Gon Jinn

While Jar Jar is foraging, he runs into the Trade Federation's invasion force. Qui-Gon Jinn saves his life, and Jar Jar declares a life debt and leads the Jedi to Otoh Gunga.

32 BBY - Through the Planet Core

Jar Jar guides Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan Kenobi by bongo submarine to Theed. They survive an opee sea killer and a colo claw fish on the way.

32 BBY - Journey to Tatooine

Jar Jar escapes Naboo with Queen Amidala, the first time he has left his world. In Mos Espa he gets into trouble with Sebulba and meets Anakin Skywalker.

32 BBY - The Gungan Grand Army

The Senate fails to help Naboo on Coruscant. Jar Jar tells Amidala about the Gungan Grand Army and leads her to the Gungans' Sacred Place, where the two peoples agree to an alliance.

32 BBY - Battle of Naboo

Boss Nass promotes Jar Jar to Bombad General, and he leads Gungan forces on the Great Grass Plains. Anakin then destroys the Droid Control Ship. Jar Jar attends Qui-Gon's funeral and the victory celebrations.

~32 BBY - Hunt for the Blobball

Jar Jar and Queen Amidala follow a map from Boss Nass to a supposed Gungan relic. It turns out to be an old delicacy.

~32–22 BBY - Junior Representative

Padmé brings Jar Jar into the Naboo delegation to the Galactic Senate as a Junior Representative.

22 BBY - Emergency Powers

While standing in for Senator Amidala, who has gone into hiding, Jar Jar proposes that Chancellor Palpatine receive emergency powers. The motion passes and the Grand Army of the Republic is created.

22 BBY - Mission to Toydaria

Jar Jar distracts Senator Lott Dod at a banquet so that Bail Organa can load relief supplies for Ryloth.

22 BBY - Mission to Rodia

Separatist droids take Jar Jar for a Jedi. He befriends the Kwazel Maw Bogey and helps rescue Padmé and C-3PO from Nute Gunray.

22 BBY - Ransom on Florrum

Senator Kharrus dies in a shuttle crash, leaving Jar Jar in charge of the surviving clones. He defeats Turk Falso's pirates, and the power blackout he causes helps free Kenobi and Anakin.

22 BBY - Blue Shadow Virus

Jar Jar helps expose Dr. Nuvo Vindi's secret laboratory on Naboo and helps keep the virus from escaping.

~21 BBY - Battle of Mimban

After Jedi Master Laan Tik is killed, Jar Jar takes command and uses Tik's lightsaber to save Captain Rex.

~21 BBY - War on Mon Cala

Jar Jar persuades the Gungan High Council to send the Grand Army to Mon Cala. When Riff Tamson cracks Padmé's helmet, Jar Jar seals it with his spit.

~20 BBY - Capturing Grievous

Jar Jar impersonates the mind-controlled Boss Lyonie to call off a Gungan attack on Theed, and helps capture General Grievous. Roos Tarpals is killed in the fight, and Grievous is later traded for Anakin.

~20 BBY - Mission to Bardotta

Jar Jar and Mace Windu rescue Queen Julia from the Frangawl Cult and Mother Talzin on Zardossa Stix.

19 BBY - Birth of the Empire

Jar Jar welcomes Palpatine back after the Battle of Coruscant and is in the Senate chamber when the Republic becomes the Galactic Empire.

19 BBY - Padmé's Funeral

Jar Jar walks with Boss Nass among the chief mourners at Padmé Amidala's funeral on Naboo.

~19 BBY–4 ABY - Second Exile

Gungans and Naboo shun Jar Jar again for his part in Palpatine's rise to power.

5 ABY - Street Clown of Theed

Jar Jar now performs in Theed's Plaza of the Catalan. There he befriends Mapo, a burned refugee orphan, and agrees to teach him to be a clown.

birth.source: The Wookieepedia infobox leaves the birth field empty, and no canon source gives a birth year or an age for Jar Jar. Our 60 BBY value is a placement guess, which is how the startYearUnknown flag already labels it.

death.source: The Wookieepedia infobox leaves the death field empty. He is last seen alive as a street performer in Theed in 5 ABY (Aftermath: Empire's End), and canon never records his death.

notes.detail: Canon shows Jar Jar alive in 5 ABY, performing as a clown in Theed and befriending the orphan Mapo (Aftermath: Empire's End, in the Battle of Jakku era). Ending his column at 8 BBY cuts off 13 years of known life. The column should run to at least 5 ABY.

Canon gives no birth year. Legends dated his birth to 52 BBY, but that is not canon. The 60 BBY guess is fine as long as it stays flagged as a guess, and 52 BBY would also be a reasonable placement. Either way, don't present a birth year as canon fact.

notes.suggested: Track his post-Empire exile and clown career (5 ABY, Aftermath: Empire's End); the Jar Jar 1 comic and Queen's Peril/Queen's Hope may also be worth checking
notes.detail: Our entry says nothing about his life after the Empire rose, even though it is a canon story point: his people exiled him a second time for proposing the emergency powers.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Luke_Sk.description: Luke Skywalker is the farm boy who became the galaxy's most famous Jedi, the hero whose single torpedo shot destroyed the first Death Star and whose faith in his father brought Darth Vader back to the light. Born in secret in 19 BBY to Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala and separated from his twin sister Leia at birth, he grew up on his aunt and uncle's moisture farm, watched from a distance by Obi-Wan Kenobi. When two droids carrying stolen Death Star plans came into his life, he lost his family to the Empire, joined the Rebel Alliance, and began training in the Force, first under Kenobi and then with Yoda on Dagobah. On Cloud City he lost his hand and learned that Vader was his father. At Endor he refused to kill him, and Anakin turned on the Emperor to save his son. After the war he searched the galaxy for lost Jedi knowledge, trained Leia, briefly taught the foundling Grogu, and founded a new academy. It ended in disaster when his nephew Ben Solo fell to the dark side and destroyed his temple. Consumed by guilt, Luke went into exile on Ahch-To until Rey found him. After giving her a reluctant final lesson, he projected himself across the galaxy to face Kylo Ren on Crait, bought the Resistance time to escape, and became one with the Force. As a spirit, he later urged Rey to confront the resurrected Palpatine.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Luke_Sk.socialDesc: Luke Skywalker, farm boy turned Jedi Master, destroyed the first Death Star, redeemed Darth Vader, and died shielding the Resistance at Crait.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Luke_Sk.timeline:
19 BBY - Birth on Polis Massa

Born minutes before his twin sister Leia, two days after the Empire is proclaimed. His dying mother Padmé names him before she dies.

19 BBY - Hidden on Tatooine

Obi-Wan Kenobi carries the infant to Owen and Beru Lars, who raise him on their moisture farm and keep his father's identity from him.

16 BBY - Marauders at the Homestead

At age three, Luke throws his toy starfighter to distract a Gamorrean raider while Kenobi and Owen fight off an attack on the farm.

9 BBY - Hunted by Reva

The former Inquisitor Reva Sevander tracks Luke to Tatooine and chases him into the desert, but she spares him. Afterward, Owen lets Kenobi meet the boy.

7 BBY - Lost in a Sandstorm

At twelve, Luke and his friend Windy are caught in a sandstorm in the desert. Kenobi rescues them and introduces himself as an old friend of Luke's father.

~5 BBY - Rescuing Uncle Owen

Luke repairs his grounded T-16 skyhopper and catches Owen in midair after the bounty hunter Krrsantan throws him from a cliff.

1 BBY - The Droids and the Message

Owen buys R2-D2 and C-3PO. Luke finds Princess Leia's plea for help and follows R2 to Ben Kenobi, who gives him his father's lightsaber.

1 BBY - Leaving Tatooine

Stormtroopers murder Owen and Beru. Luke leaves with Kenobi and hires Han Solo and Chewbacca in Mos Eisley.

1 BBY - Rescue from the Death Star

Luke helps free Leia from the battle station and watches Kenobi fall to Darth Vader.

0 BBY - Battle of Yavin

Flying as Red Five, Luke trusts the Force, destroys the Death Star with one shot, and is awarded the Medal of Bravery.

3 ABY - Battle of Hoth

Luke survives a wampa attack, leads Rogue Group's snowspeeders against Imperial walkers, and escapes the planet.

3 ABY - Training on Dagobah

Guided by Kenobi's spirit, Luke finds Yoda and begins his training. He leaves early to help his friends.

3 ABY - Duel on Cloud City

Luke loses his right hand to Darth Vader, learns that Vader is his father, and is rescued by Leia.

4 ABY - Rescue from Jabba's Palace

Luke, now a Jedi Knight in all but name, frees Han Solo and defeats Jabba's forces at the Great Pit of Carkoon.

4 ABY - Yoda's Death

The dying Yoda confirms Vader is Luke's father. Kenobi's spirit reveals that Leia is his twin.

4 ABY - Battle of Endor

Luke surrenders to Vader and refuses to kill him before the Emperor. Anakin turns on Palpatine to save his son and dies redeemed.

4 ABY - Training Leia

Luke teaches his sister in the Jedi arts on Ajan Kloss. She later sets her training aside.

5 ABY - Battle of Jakku

Luke helps the New Republic in its final campaigns against the Imperial holdouts, including self-proclaimed Grand Moff Adelhard.

~6 ABY - Liberation of the Nagai

Luke works to free the Nagai people and their homeworld from their enslavers.

9 ABY - Rescuing Grogu

Luke answers Grogu's call through the Force and destroys Moff Gideon's dark troopers aboard his cruiser.

9 ABY - Grogu's Choice

While training Grogu at his new temple site, Luke hosts Ahsoka Tano. He lets the child choose, and Grogu goes back to Din Djarin instead of taking Yoda's lightsaber.

~15 ABY - Journey to Elphrona

Luke, his apprentice and nephew Ben Solo, and Lor San Tekka search for Jedi lore and first encounter the Knights of Ren.

21 ABY - Quest for Exegol

Troubled by dark visions, Luke searches for the Sith world. He faces wraiths on Tython with Anakin's spirit at his side, but the trail goes cold when he fails to track down the assassin Ochi.

28 ABY - Fall of the Jedi Temple

Luke briefly considers killing Ben Solo to stop the darkness he senses. Ben turns, destroys the temple, and kills his students.

28 ABY - Exile on Ahch-To

Convinced the Jedi should end, Luke hides on the first Jedi Temple's island and cuts himself off from the Force.

34 ABY - Rey Arrives

Rey brings Luke his old lightsaber. He reluctantly gives her three lessons, and Yoda's spirit helps him let go of his failure.

34 ABY - Battle of Crait and Death

Luke projects himself across the galaxy to face Kylo Ren, buys the Resistance time to escape, and becomes one with the Force on Ahch-To.

35 ABY - Spirit Counsel

Luke's spirit stops Rey from exiling herself and urges her to face Palpatine. He later watches over her on Tatooine.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox: born two days after Empire Day, 19 BBY, Polis Massa (Revenge of the Sith).

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 34 ABY on Ahch-To, at the Battle of Crait (The Last Jedi).

notes.current: Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker
notes.detail: Luke dies on Ahch-To in 34 ABY after projecting himself to Crait, during The Last Jedi. In The Rise of Skywalker (35 ABY) he appears only as a Force spirit.
Tatooine is correct as his homeworld, but he was born on Polis Massa. If we track birthplaces anywhere, add it here.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ki-Adi-.description: Ki-Adi-Mundi is best remembered as one of the steady, sometimes skeptical voices of the Jedi High Council in the Republic's last years, and as a Jedi whose career spanned more than a century. In 132 BBY, during the High Republic, he was a newly made Master who sat on the tactical council Vernestra Rwoh called to discuss the assassin Mae. Decades later he held a Council seat of his own. There he taught younglings alongside Yarael Poof, pushed back on Qui-Gon Jinn's calls for more outreach, and in 32 BBY famously insisted that the Sith had been extinct for a millennium. He survived the arena battle on Geonosis that began the Clone Wars and became a Jedi General. He took scars from an early clash with General Grievous and led the northern assault in the Second Battle of Geonosis, where he topped Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano with 65 kills. On the Council he took a hard line, arguing against intervening on neutral Mandalore and personally telling Ahsoka Tano she had been expelled after the Temple bombing. In 19 BBY, while commanding the 21st Nova Corps in the Mygeeto campaign, he was gunned down by his own clone troopers when Order 66 was issued. His lightsaber survived him and ended up with the collector Dok-Ondar.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ki-Adi-.socialDesc: Ki-Adi-Mundi, a Jedi Master since the High Republic era, sat on the Council and led Clone Wars troops until Order 66 killed him on Mygeeto.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ki-Adi-.timeline:
~172 BBY - Birth on Cerea

Ki-Adi-Mundi is born on Cerea. Canon gives no birth year, so this is an estimate based on his being a newly raised Jedi Master by 132 BBY. He trains in the Order under Yoda.

132 BBY - Council on the Mae-ho Aniseya threat

As a newly elevated Jedi Master, he joins Vernestra Rwoh's tactical council, reviews footage of Mae fighting Master Sol, and warns that she could become a major threat.

Unknown - Funeral of Master Katri

He gives the eulogy at Master Katri's funeral at the Jedi Temple after she is killed on Raxus Secundus.

33 BBY - Teaching with Yarael Poof and the Kwenn outreach

Now a Council member, he teaches younglings alongside Yarael Poof, hears Qui-Gon Jinn's proposal to engage more with the galaxy, dismisses it as extreme, and later takes part in the outreach mission to Kwenn.

32 BBY - Return of the Sith

He tells Qui-Gon Jinn that the Sith have been extinct for a millennium, sits on the Council that evaluates young Anakin Skywalker, and attends Qui-Gon's funeral on Naboo.

29 BBY - Rescue at Carnelion IV

He travels with a Republic task force that rescues Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker and ends the Open-Closed War.

22 BBY - Separatist Crisis

He meets with Chancellor Palpatine about the Military Creation Act and dismisses Count Dooku as a political idealist rather than a murderer.

22 BBY - First Battle of Geonosis

He joins Mace Windu's strike team in the Petranaki Arena, is one of the few Jedi to survive the fighting, and escapes on Yoda's gunships as the Clone Wars begin.

22 BBY - Early war and the trial of Prosset Dibs

He shares a toast with his old friend Mace Windu, sits in judgment on the traitor Prosset Dibs, and is scarred by General Grievous in an early encounter.

~22 BBY - Second Battle of Geonosis

He leads the northern prong of the assault on the ray shield generator, survives a gunship crash, fights his way through a cave full of Geonosians, and finishes with 65 kills before being treated in a bacta tank.

~22 BBY - Poggle the Lesser and the brain worms

He helps hunt Poggle, then escorts him to Coruscant as the brain worm crisis unfolds on Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee's ship.

~21 BBY - Council crises

He watches Grievous's transmission showing the captured Eeth Koth, Maul's massacre on Raydonia, and other emergencies, and attends Obi-Wan Kenobi's staged funeral.

19 BBY - Mandalore refused

He argues that the Jedi cannot help Duchess Satine Kryze, because intervening on neutral Mandalore would be treated as an act of war.

19 BBY - Temple bombing and Ahsoka Tano's expulsion

After the Jedi Temple hangar bombing, he votes against protecting Tano and formally tells her she has been expelled. He later invites her back after she is cleared, but she refuses.

19 BBY - Doubting Yoda's visions

He is skeptical when Yoda claims Qui-Gon Jinn's spirit has contacted him, and suspects a Sith attack instead.

19 BBY - Quinlan Vos affair

He takes part in the Council's decision to rescue Quinlan Vos, who had turned to the dark side under Dooku as "Admiral Enigma."

19 BBY - Death on Mygeeto

While leading the 21st Nova Corps in the Mygeeto campaign during the Outer Rim Sieges, he is shot down by his own clone troopers when Order 66 is issued.

~34 ABY - Lightsaber in Dok-Ondar's collection

His lightsaber ends up with the collector Dok-Ondar on Batuu, who tells part of its history to a First Order sergeant.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's Ki-Adi-Mundi infobox leaves the birth field blank. The Acolyte shows him as a newly elevated Jedi Master in 132 BBY, so he must have been born well before that, but canon gives no year. Our 172 BBY guess (about 40 at his promotion) is reasonable as a placeholder.

death.source: Wookieepedia's Ki-Adi-Mundi infobox gives his death as 19 BBY on Mygeeto: he was killed by his clone troops during Order 66 in Revenge of the Sith.

notes.detail: The guess is fine and should stay flagged. Canon gives no birth year. The only fixed point is The Acolyte, where he is already a newly made Jedi Master in 132 BBY, so any birth year after about 150 BBY would contradict canon. Legends' 92 BBY is incompatible with that appearance, so don't bring it back.
The Wookieepedia infobox lists Yoda as his master. It is worth tracking if we record masters or apprentices elsewhere.

notes.suggested: Note the Mygeeto death location and the 21st Nova Corps command
notes.detail: The infobox and lead say he died on Mygeeto while commanding the 21st Nova Corps (Galactic Marines). This is useful context for the Revenge of the Sith endYearEvent.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Qi%27ra.description: Qi'ra is best known as Han Solo's first love, who clawed her way from the gutters of Coronet City to the head of the Crimson Dawn syndicate. As a scrumrat of Lady Proxima's White Worms she grew close to Han and rose to Head Girl, but their attempt to escape Corellia together failed at the spaceport gate. Han got through and she was dragged back. Proxima sold her to the slaver Sarkin Enneb, and she ended up with Dryden Vos. He trained her in Teräs Käsi and made her his top lieutenant once she had killed Enneb. In 10 BBY she met Han again and joined the Kessel coaxium heist, then killed Vos to protect Han. Instead of leaving with him, she took Vos's place as the public face of Crimson Dawn under its true master, Maul. Maul taught her that Palpatine and Vader were Sith and that the Empire was their instrument, and that knowledge shaped the rest of her life. After Maul's death she rebuilt the syndicate in secret. Around 3 ABY she stole the carbon-frozen Han from Boba Fett and auctioned him off to draw the galaxy's powers into conflict. She dueled Darth Vader, supplied the Rebel Alliance, and started a Syndicate War. Her campaign against the Sith ended when the Knights of Ren betrayed her at the Amaxine station trap and Crimson Dawn fell apart. Qi'ra left what remained of its resources to the young Cadeliah and disappeared, watching the Empire's end from hiding.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Qi%27ra.socialDesc: Qi'ra, Han Solo's first love from the Corellian streets, rose to rule Crimson Dawn and waged a secret war to destroy Palpatine and Darth Vader.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Qi%27ra.timeline:
31 BBY - Birth on Corellia

Qi'ra is born on Corellia and grows up in the Bottoms of Coronet City.

~20s BBY - Taken in by the White Worms

She is caught trying to pickpocket Moloch, brought before Lady Proxima, and made a scrumrat of the White Worms. There she meets Han, and they go from rivals to friends and then to lovers.

~13 BBY - Head Girl

At about eighteen, Proxima names her Head Girl of the White Worms.

~13 BBY - Failed escape from Corellia

Han steals a vial of coaxium and the two flee Proxima together. At the Coronet Spaceport gate the White Worms recapture Qi'ra while Han gets through, promising to come back for her.

~13 BBY - Sold into slavery

Proxima sells her to the slaver Sarkin Enneb, who later sells her on to Dryden Vos of Crimson Dawn.

~12 BBY - Joins Crimson Dawn

After a year of failed escape attempts, Vos offers her a place in Crimson Dawn in exchange for lifelong loyalty. She kills Enneb, is branded with the syndicate's mark, and is trained by Vos in Teräs Käsi.

~12–10 BBY - Vos's lieutenant

She becomes Vos's enforcer and trusted lieutenant. On one assignment on Ord Mantell she turns IG-88 and Hondo Ohnaka against each other and captures them both.

10 BBY - Reunion with Han Solo

On the yacht First Light she meets Han again, now working with Tobias Beckett. Vos sends her with the crew on a plan to steal unrefined coaxium from Kessel.

10 BBY - The Kessel Run

She brings Lando Calrissian and the Millennium Falcon into the job and rekindles her romance with Han. On Kessel she poses as a slaver to get the crew inside the Pyke mines.

10 BBY - Kills Dryden Vos

On Savareen, Vos uncovers Han's double-cross and Qi'ra kills Vos to save Han. She then contacts Maul, Crimson Dawn's true leader, and goes to Dathomir instead of leaving with Han.

~10 BBY onward - Maul's pupil

She becomes the public face of Crimson Dawn. Maul teaches her the truth about the Sith, Palpatine and Vader, and trains her to fight them.

~2 BBY - Crimson Dawn in decline

After Maul dies on Tatooine, most of the galaxy believes Crimson Dawn is destroyed. Qi'ra quietly takes control of what remains.

~1 BBY–3 ABY - Preparing a war on the Sith

She builds the Dawn Fleet and recruits the Archivist Madelin Sun, Ochi of Bestoon, Deathstick and the Knights of Ren. She also sends Sun to search for Yoda.

3 ABY - Claims the frozen Han Solo

Her agents take the carbon-frozen Han from Boba Fett on Nar Shaddaa. She then announces Crimson Dawn's return to the galaxy's crime lords.

3 ABY - Auction on the Vermillion

At Jekara she auctions Han to the syndicates. When Darth Vader arrives to claim him, she duels Vader, and the auction ends in open conflict between the Empire and the Hutts.

3 ABY - Meets Leia Organa

She stops the Millennium Falcon, tells Leia that Han is alive at Jabba's Palace, and offers the Rebellion her help.

3–4 ABY - Crimson Reign

She starts a Syndicate War among the crime families. She reveals to her followers that her goal is to kill Sidious and Vader, and she arranges the assassination of the Emperor's Royal Guard.

3–4 ABY - Aids the Rebel Alliance

She gives Leia the location of the Rebels' last surviving fleet division and hands over Ellian Zahra's hunter fleet. She also offers to manage the Alliance's supply chain.

3–4 ABY - Takes Cadeliah

Deathstick brings her the child Cadeliah, heir to the Mourner's Wail Syndicate and the Unbroken Clan, and Qi'ra takes her in.

4 ABY - Hidden Empire and the fall of Crimson Dawn

She lures Palpatine and Vader into a trap built around the Fermata Cage at the Amaxine Space Station. The Knights of Ren betray her and free the Sith Lords, and Crimson Dawn collapses.

4 ABY - Into hiding

She leaves her remaining resources to Cadeliah, goes into hiding, and watches the Empire fall from obscurity.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and Early life section: born 31 BBY on Corellia.

death.source: No death is recorded in canon. After the collapse of Crimson Dawn (~4 ABY) she goes into hiding and her later fate is unknown.

notes.detail: Canon does not show Qi'ra as Force-sensitive. During the duel on the Vermillion (Star Wars 2020 / War of the Bounty Hunters), Vader tells her she does not have the Force and that her training will not save her. She fights using Teräs Käsi and anti-Sith training from Maul. Her reliance on Force users such as Yoda, the Knights of Ren and the Archivist also shows she is not one herself.

notes.suggested: Add Star Wars Outlaws, if games are tracked
notes.detail: Qi'ra is a major character in Star Wars Outlaws (set around 3 ABY) as the leader of Crimson Dawn. She is also central to the Marvel comic events War of the Bounty Hunters, Crimson Reign and Hidden Empire (3–4 ABY).

notes.suggested: Consider ending the column at ~4 ABY with endYearUnknown true
notes.detail: Her last known activity is going into hiding after Crimson Dawn collapses at the end of Hidden Empire (~4 ABY). Nothing in canon places her later than that, so extending the column to 50 ABY suggests she is known to be active that late.
Her membership in these groups is central to the character and is listed in the Wookieepedia infobox.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Finn.description: Finn is the stormtrooper who walked away. Taken from his family as a toddler and raised as FN-2187, a model cadet in Captain Phasma's FN Corps, he broke on his first combat mission when he refused to fire during the massacre at Tuanul on Jakku. He freed the captured pilot Poe Dameron, who gave him the name Finn, and escaped. Stranded on Jakku, he fell in with Rey and BB-8, fled aboard the Millennium Falcon and ended up at the side of Han Solo and Chewbacca. For a while he wanted only to run from the war. Even so, his inside knowledge helped the Resistance destroy Starkiller Base, and he took up the Skywalker lightsaber against Kylo Ren there and nearly died. After waking from a coma, he joined Rose Tico on a desperate mission to Canto Bight and the Supremacy, where he defeated Phasma. By the Battle of Crait he was ready to give his life for the cause. A year later he joined Rey's search for the Sith wayfinder. He began to feel the Force, led a rising of ex-stormtroopers on Kef Bir, and, newly promoted to general alongside Poe after Leia's death, led the ground assault at the Battle of Exegol that helped end the Final Order.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Finn.socialDesc: Finn, the stormtrooper FN-2187 who deserted the First Order on Jakku, became a Resistance hero and led its ground forces at Exegol as a general.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Finn.timeline:
1 BBY - An Echo Beyond Time

Years before Finn is born, Ezra Bridger hears Rey's voice in the World Between Worlds promising Finn that they will meet again.

11 ABY - Birth

The boy who will become Finn is born during the New Republic era. He never learns who his family were.

~14 ABY - Taken by the First Order

At about three years old he is taken from his family, given the designation FN-2187 and raised to be a stormtrooper.

~14–34 ABY - Cadet in the FN Corps

He trains with Batch Eight and then the FN Corps under Captain Phasma alongside Nines, Zeroes and Slip. He scores top marks, but officers notice he keeps going back for weaker squadmates. He also pulls sanitation duty on Starkiller Base and aboard Star Destroyers.

34 ABY - Pressy's Tumble

Sent to break a miners' strike in the Pressylla system, he cannot bring himself to execute a captive negotiator. Afterwards his unit is made full stormtroopers.

34 ABY - Massacre at Tuanul

On his first combat mission on Jakku, he watches his friend Slip die and refuses Kylo Ren's order to fire on the villagers.

34 ABY - Desertion and a New Name

Facing reconditioning, he frees Poe Dameron and they escape the Finalizer in a stolen TIE fighter. Poe names him Finn before they crash in the Goazon Badlands.

34 ABY - Rey, BB-8 and the Falcon

At Niima Outpost he meets Rey and BB-8, pretends to be with the Resistance, and escapes Jakku with them aboard the Millennium Falcon. Han Solo and Chewbacca then take them aboard, and they survive the rathtars on the Eravana.

34 ABY - Battle of Takodana

At Maz Kanata's castle he confesses his past and plans to run with Sidon Ithano's pirates. Then he sees the Hosnian Cataclysm, picks up the Skywalker lightsaber, fights his former squadmate Nines, and watches Kylo Ren take Rey away.

34 ABY - Battle of Starkiller Base

He helps plan the attack on the base, forces Phasma to lower its shields, and reunites with Rey. Then he sees Han killed and duels Kylo Ren with the lightsaber, suffering terrible wounds that leave him in a coma.

34 ABY - Awakening on the Raddus

He wakes during the evacuation of D'Qar and tries to slip away to protect Rey, but Rose Tico catches him. Together they plan to disable the First Order's hyperspace tracker.

34 ABY - Mission to Canto Bight

On Cantonica he sees how war profiteers live and is changed by it. He and Rose free the fathiers and recruit DJ to get them aboard the Supremacy.

34 ABY - Duel with Phasma

Betrayed by DJ and nearly executed, he escapes when the Supremacy is rammed, then defeats Captain Phasma in the hangar.

34 ABY - Battle of Crait

He leads the ski speeder attack on the siege cannon and tries to sacrifice himself, but Rose saves him. He escapes with the Resistance survivors on the Falcon.

35 ABY - Quest for the Wayfinder

After Palpatine's return is announced, he joins Rey, Poe, Chewbacca, BB-8 and C-3PO in the search for the Sith wayfinder across Pasaana, Kijimi and the Death Star wreck on Kef Bir. He starts sensing the Force.

35 ABY - Meeting Jannah

On Kef Bir he meets Jannah and her band of ex-stormtroopers, who, like him, deserted rather than kill.

35 ABY - Promoted to General

After Leia's death, Poe makes Finn a general alongside himself.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

He leads the ground forces against the Sith fleet's navigation tower, destroys a Xyston-class Star Destroyer from its deck, and helps secure victory over the Final Order.

35 ABY - Victory Celebration

He reunites with Rey, Poe and their allies on Ajan Kloss as the galaxy rises up against the First Order.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox (birth=11 ABY) and article body: 'Born in 11 ABY during the New Republic Era'. This matches his stated age of 23 in 34 ABY.

death.source: Wookieepedia lists no death. Finn is alive at the end of The Rise of Skywalker (35 ABY), and canon does not record his death.

notes.detail: Finn appears in the Disney park attraction Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance at Galaxy's Edge (filmed footage). He is not a character in Marvel's Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge comic series. If 'Galaxy's Edge' means the comic, remove it; if it means the park/ride, it is valid but should be labelled as the attraction.

notes.suggested: Affiliation: First Order (FN Corps), Resistance; Rank: General (35 ABY)
notes.detail: The infobox lists First Order (Batch Eight, FN Trooper Corps), Sidon Ithano's pirate crew and the Resistance. He was promoted to general in 35 ABY.

notes.suggested: Star Wars Resistance / Forces of Destiny (optional)
notes.detail: Finn also appears in the Star Wars Forces of Destiny shorts and in tie-in novels and comics (e.g. Before the Awakening, the Finn comic, Choose Your Destiny: A Finn & Poe Adventure), if the timeline tracks non-film media.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Poe_Dam.description:
"

Poe Dameron is best known as the Resistance's top starfighter pilot. He flew the black X-wing Black One and eventually took over from Leia Organa as the movement's commander. He was born just after the Battle of Yavin to two Rebel veterans, the A-wing pilot Shara Bey and the Pathfinder Kes Dameron. His mother taught him to fly in her lap and died when he was eight. As a restless teenager he ran off with the Spice Runners of Kijimi, where he met Zorii Bliss, but he walked away from the criminal life after its violence nearly killed him. He later became a New Republic pilot, trained under Wedge Antilles and led Rapier Squadron. Frustrated that the Republic ignored the First Order's growing aggression, he joined Leia Organa's Resistance and became one of her most trusted agents. He founded Black Squadron and went looking for Lor San Tekka's clue to where Luke Skywalker was. On Jakku he was captured and tortured by Kylo Ren, then escaped with the defecting stormtrooper he named Finn. He fired the shots that destroyed Starkiller Base's weapon. His recklessness at D'Qar got him demoted, and his mutiny against Vice Admiral Holdo backfired, but he learned from both and led the survivors out of Crait. After Leia died he became acting general alongside Finn. At Exegol he rallied a galaxy-wide citizens' fleet that broke the Sith Eternal armada and helped end the First Order.

"
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Poe_Dam.socialDesc: Poe Dameron, hotshot X-wing ace of the Resistance, destroyed Starkiller Base's weapon, led a mutiny against Holdo and rallied the fleet at Exegol.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Poe_Dam.timeline:
"

1 BBY - A Voice in the World Between Worlds

Years before he is born, Poe's voice is among the echoes Ezra Bridger hears in the World Between Worlds.

2 ABY - Birth on Yavin 4

Born to Rebel pilot Shara Bey and Pathfinder Kes Dameron. While his parents fight the Empire, his maternal grandfather looks after him.

~5 ABY - Family Reunited

Six months after Endor, his parents leave Rebel service and settle on Yavin 4. They plant a Force-sensitive tree next to their homestead.

8 ABY - First Flights

At age six, Poe learns to fly sitting in his mother's lap in her old RZ-1 A-wing.

~10 ABY - Death of Shara Bey

His mother dies unexpectedly when he is eight. Family friend L'ulo L'ampar helps raise him.

18 ABY - Joining the Spice Runners

After wrecking his mother's A-wing on a joyride and arguing with his father, Poe agrees to fly for Zorii Wynn's crew. They turn out to be the Spice Runners of Kijimi. He learns hyperspace skipping from Tomasso.

~19 ABY - Breaking with the Spice Runners

Poe wrecks Zeva Bliss's plot at the Kijimi summit and is badly wounded. He turns down Zorii's offer to rule the gang with her and makes his way home.

~20s ABY - New Republic Pilot

Joins the New Republic Defense Fleet, trains under Wedge Antilles, becomes a commander and leads Rapier Squadron with BB-8.

~32 ABY - Suraz Engagement

Rapier Squadron answers a distress call from the Yissira Zyde and finds First Order TIE fighters attacking it. Poe then scouts a First Order staging point on his own.

~32 ABY - Joining the Resistance

Leia Organa recruits Poe, Karé Kun and Iolo Arana into the Resistance. He goes on to lead its starfighter squadrons as Black Leader in Black One.

~33 ABY - Operation: Sabre Strike

Steals navicomputer data from Senator Erudo Ro-Kiintor's ship. The data reveals that the First Order is hunting Lor San Tekka.

34 ABY - Black Squadron and the Hunt for Tekka

Forms Black Squadron and trades blows with Agent Terex on Ovanis, Megalox Beta and Kaddak. He eventually exposes Oddy Muva as the squadron's mole.

34 ABY - Assignments with Kazuda Xiono

Recruits Kazuda Xiono as a Resistance spy on the Colossus and checks in on his missions.

34 ABY - Captured on Jakku

Receives part of the map to Luke Skywalker from Lor San Tekka and hides it in BB-8. Kylo Ren captures him and pulls the information from his mind.

34 ABY - Escape with Finn

Escapes the Finalizer with a defecting stormtrooper he names Finn. They crash on Jakku, and Poe makes his own way back to D'Qar.

34 ABY - Takodana and Starkiller Base

Leads the Resistance air strike at Takodana. At Starkiller Base he fires the shots that destroy the superweapon.

34 ABY - Battle of D'Qar and Demotion

Disobeys orders to destroy the dreadnought Fulminatrix. The victory costs the bomber fleet, and Leia demotes him to captain.

34 ABY - Mutiny Against Holdo

Sends Finn and Rose Tico to disable the hyperspace tracker and leads a mutiny against Vice Admiral Holdo. Leia stuns him to end it.

34 ABY - Battle of Crait

Leads the failed ski-speeder counterattack. He then realizes Luke is buying them time and guides the survivors to the Millennium Falcon.

34 ABY - Restored to Commander

Promoted back to commander. He rebuilds the Resistance and recruits new allies across the galaxy.

35 ABY - Hunt for the Wayfinder

Brings word of Palpatine's return. He searches for the Sith wayfinder with Rey, Finn and Chewbacca on Pasaana, Kijimi, the Steadfast and Kef Bir, and reunites with Zorii Bliss along the way.

35 ABY - Acting General

After Leia dies he becomes acting general of the Resistance, with Leia's blessing, and names Finn co-general.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

Leads the attack on the Final Order. Lando Calrissian arrives with the Citizens' Fleet, and together they destroy the Sith fleet and spark a galaxy-wide uprising against the First Order.

35 ABY - Victory Celebration

Celebrates the victory on Ajan Kloss with Finn, Rey, Zorii and the surviving Resistance.

"

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox: 'birth=2 ABY, Yavin 4'. The biography adds the tenth day of the fifth month, 2 ABY, making him one of the 'victory kid' generation.

death.source: Wookieepedia has no death field. Poe survives the Battle of Exegol (35 ABY), and no canon source records his death.

notes.detail: Wookieepedia flags a conflict between Poe Dameron: Flight Log and the comic Poe Dameron: Legend Found about parts of his early career. The Spice Runner years (18–19 ABY, from the novel Poe Dameron: Free Fall) and when he joined the New Republic and then the Resistance (~32 ABY, from Before the Awakening) are only approximate, so the Resistance-era dates in the timeline are marked with ~.

notes.suggested: Affiliation: Spice Runners of Kijimi, New Republic (Rapier Squadron), Resistance (Black Squadron)
notes.detail: His affiliations are a big part of his arc and are not tracked yet. It could also be worth adding his parents, Shara Bey and Kes Dameron.
In the Rebels episode 'A World Between Worlds' (1 BBY), Ezra hears Poe's voice among the echoes. It is only a voice cameo, so add it only if the timeline plots voice appearances.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ahsoka_.description: Best known as Anakin Skywalker's headstrong Padawan during the Clone Wars and later as the rebel spymaster "Fulcrum," Ahsoka Tano grew from an overeager teenager into one of the galaxy's most principled warriors. Found by Plo Koon as a toddler and raised at the Jedi Temple, she was placed with Skywalker at fourteen. Anakin nicknamed her "Snips," and she fought beside him and Captain Rex of the 501st from Christophsis and Teth to Ryloth, Geonosis, and Onderon. On Mortis she died and was brought back to life by the Daughter. When she was framed for the bombing of the Temple hangar, the Order expelled her. Anakin exposed Barriss Offee as the real bomber, but Ahsoka declined to return. She came back to lead the Siege of Mandalore against Maul, survived Order 66 with Rex, and faked her death. Under the Empire she lived in hiding and then ran Bail Organa's intelligence network, guiding cells like the Ghost crew. She faced her former master, now Darth Vader, on Malachor and was pulled to safety through the World Between Worlds by Ezra Bridger. After the Empire fell, she searched for Ezra with Sabine Wren, helped Din Djarin free Calodan, and went after Grand Admiral Thrawn. Decades later, her voice was among the Jedi who helped Rey defeat Sidious.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ahsoka_.socialDesc: Ahsoka Tano, Anakin Skywalker's Padawan turned rebel spymaster Fulcrum, walked away from the Jedi Order and kept fighting the Empire on her own terms.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ahsoka_.timeline:
36 BBY - Birth on Shili

Born to Pav-ti and Nak-il Tano. As a small child she rides a raxshir, and the elder Gantika sees that she is Force-sensitive.

33 BBY - Discovered by Plo Koon

At age three she escapes a false Jedi who tries to take her. Jedi Master Plo Koon finds her and brings her to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

~30 BBY - Gathering on Ilum

As an initiate she finds her kyber crystal in the Ilum cave by following Yoda's advice, then builds her lightsaber under Huyang's guidance.

22 BBY - Padawan to Anakin Skywalker

Yoda assigns the fourteen-year-old to Anakin Skywalker. She joins him at the Battle of Christophsis, where he nicknames her "Snips," and meets Captain Rex.

22 BBY - Rescue of Rotta

With Anakin she rescues Jabba's son from Teth, fights Asajj Ventress, and brings the Huttlet home, which secures the Republic's treaty with the Hutts.

22 BBY - The Malevolence Campaign

She rescues Plo Koon's survivors and serves as Anakin's gunner in the attack that cripples Grievous's flagship.

22 BBY - Hunt for R2-D2

She duels General Grievous at the Separatist listening post near Ruusan while Anakin recovers R2-D2.

22 BBY - Battle of Ryloth

In her first command she disobeys orders and loses Blue Squadron, then recovers to help win the battle.

21 BBY - Second Battle of Geonosis
