With Barriss Offee she destroys the droid foundry and survives being trapped in the rubble.

20 BBY - Death and Resurrection on Mortis

The Son kills her on Mortis, and the Daughter gives up her own life to revive her.

20 BBY - Wasskah and Kadavo

Captured by Trandoshan hunters, she leads the captive younglings in a revolt. She then helps free a Togruta colony from the Zygerrian slavers.

20 BBY - Onderon Rebellion

She advises Lux Bonteri and the Onderon rebels as they free their world from the Separatists.

19 BBY - Framed and Leaves the Order

Accused of bombing the Temple hangar, she escapes into the Underworld and gets help from Ventress, but she is caught and expelled. Anakin exposes Barriss Offee as the bomber, and Ahsoka turns down the Council's offer to take her back.

19 BBY - Siege of Mandalore

She returns to lead the 332nd alongside Bo-Katan and captures Maul.

19 BBY - Order 66

She frees Rex from his inhibitor chip, escapes the Tribunal as it crashes, and fakes her death.

~18 BBY - Hiding as Ashla

Under the name Ashla she lives on Thabeska and Raada. She helps the Raada uprising and defeats the Sixth Brother.

~18 BBY - Becomes Fulcrum

She joins Bail Organa's resistance and runs its intelligence network under the codename Fulcrum.

4 BBY - Meets the Ghost Crew and Vader

After revealing herself to the Spectres, she senses that Darth Vader is Anakin and fights the Inquisitors.

3 BBY - Duel on Malachor

She reunites with Rex, then faces Vader in the Sith temple and is believed to have died there.

Unknown - World Between Worlds

A future Ezra Bridger pulls her into the World Between Worlds. She helps him escape Sidious and returns to her own time.

~5 ABY - Search for Ezra

After the Empire falls she joins Sabine Wren to look for the missing Ezra and trains Sabine for a time.

9 ABY - Liberation of Calodan

With Din Djarin she frees Calodan from Morgan Elsbeth. She declines to train Grogu and sends Djarin to Tython.

9 ABY - Visits Luke's Academy

She stops at Luke Skywalker's new temple and watches Grogu's training.

~11 ABY - Pursuit of Thrawn

She brings Sabine back into the search, follows Elsbeth to Peridea, and helps free Ezra, although she and Sabine are left stranded there.

35 ABY - Voice at Exegol

Hers is one of the Jedi voices that strengthen Rey against Sidious.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and Childhood section: born 36 BBY on Shili. This matches her being fourteen at the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.

death.source: Wookieepedia lists her death as 20 BBY on Mortis, but she was resurrected. She is alive in the Ahsoka series (~9–11 ABY), and her voice is heard at the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY. Canon does not give a final death.

notes.current: The Clone Wars (movie), The Clone Wars (TV series), Ahsoka, The Mandalorian, The Book of Boba Fett
notes.suggested: Add Star Wars Rebels, Tales of the Jedi, and The Rise of Skywalker (voice only)
notes.detail: Ahsoka has a major role in Rebels seasons 2 and 4, and Tales of the Jedi covers her birth, childhood and Order 66. Her voice is among the Jedi who speak to Rey at Exegol in The Rise of Skywalker.
She used the codename Fulcrum as Bail Organa's intelligence chief. She was also nicknamed "Snips" and used the alias "Ashla" while in hiding.

Her last on-screen appearance (the Ahsoka series) is around 9–11 ABY, and she is heard in 35 ABY in The Rise of Skywalker. The 20 ABY bound works as long as endYearUnknown stays true. You could extend it to 35 if you want the column to include the Exegol voice cameo. Wookieepedia's infobox records a 20 BBY death on Mortis, but she was resurrected, so do not add that as a death.

Wookieepedia flags conflicting sources on details of her backstory: the Ahsoka novel and Clone Wars Season 7 disagree with the Databank and some reference books. These conflicts don't touch her 36 BBY birth year, which is consistent across sources.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hunter.description: Hunter led Clone Force 99, the genetically modified commando squad the rest of the clone army called the Bad Batch, and his defining choice was to protect his squad and a lost child instead of obeying the Empire. His mutation gave him heightened senses, letting him track movement and electromagnetic signals no ordinary trooper could detect. As a sergeant in the last year of the Clone Wars, he and his men helped Captain Rex and Anakin Skywalker retake Anaxes and rescue the long-lost ARC trooper Echo from the Techno Union on Skako Minor, and Echo then joined the squad. Because of their mutations, most of the Batch were unaffected by the inhibitor chips, and when Order 66 came on Kaller, Hunter let the Padawan Caleb Dume escape. Back on Kamino, he refused an Imperial order to wipe out civilians on Onderon and rescued the young clone Omega, which led the squad to desert. Crosshair, whose chip still worked, stayed loyal to the Empire. Hunter spent the next years on the run with Omega, taking mercenary work from Cid, losing Tech, and finally storming the secret Imperial facility on Mount Tantiss to free her and the other captive clones. Afterward he settled on the island of Pabu as Omega's father figure, and he lived to see her grow up and leave to join the rebellion.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hunter.socialDesc: Hunter, sergeant of Clone Force 99, defied Order 66, fled the Empire with the young clone Omega and later settled with her as a father figure on Pabu.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hunter.timeline:
~32 BBY - Created on Kamino

Grown in Tipoca City from Jango Fett's genetic template and designated CT-9901. As part of the experimental unit Clone Force 99 he was given a deliberate mutation that heightened his senses.

22–19 BBY - Leading the Bad Batch

Serves as sergeant of Clone Force 99 alongside Wrecker, Tech and Crosshair. The squad keeps a perfect mission record but has a reputation for unorthodox methods, which includes the mission against Doctor Krail's modified droids on Hylanth.

19 BBY - Battle of Anaxes

Commander Cody recalls the squad from an insurrection on Yalbec Prime. Hunter leads the raid on the Separatist Cyber Center with Captain Rex, and the raid reveals that Echo is alive and being used by the Separatists.

19 BBY - Rescue of Echo on Skako Minor

Hunter joins Rex and Anakin Skywalker, wins over the Poletecs and helps free Echo from Wat Tambor's tower in Purkoll.

19 BBY - Anaxes liberated

The squad infiltrates Admiral Trench's flagship so that Echo can shut down the droid army. Afterward Hunter invites Echo to join the Bad Batch.

19 BBY - Order 66 on Kaller

The squad reinforces Depa Billaba's troops. When the clones turn on the Jedi, Hunter is unaffected, lets Caleb Dume escape and tells Crosshair the Padawan fell into a ravine.

19 BBY - Rise of the Empire

On Kamino, Hunter witnesses the Proclamation of the New Order and meets Omega. After refusing to attack civilians on Onderon, he returns to rescue her. The squad escapes Imperial custody without Crosshair, and the Batch deserts.

19 BBY - Mercenaries for Cid

From their base on Ord Mantell, Hunter leads the squad on jobs for the broker Cid while evading the Empire and Crosshair. That year Tipoca City is destroyed, and Hunter and Crosshair nearly die with it.

18 BBY - Loss of Tech

During a raid on an Imperial train over Eriadu, Tech is killed and Omega is captured and taken to Mount Tantiss.

18 BBY - Refuge on Pabu

Hunter and Wrecker hide on Pabu and search for Omega. He is captured, and the Empire's clone experiments come to light.

18 BBY - Assault on Mount Tantiss

Reunited with Crosshair and Omega, Hunter helps free the captive clones and children and brings down the facility.

After 18 BBY - Life on Pabu

Hunter settles on the island with Wrecker, Crosshair and Omega, where he raises her as a father figure and his hair turns grey.

Before 4 ABY - Omega departs

An older Hunter sees the grown Omega off when she leaves Pabu to join the rebellion.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's infobox leaves the birth field blank, and no canon source dates when Clone Force 99 was decanted. Our 32 BBY guess, the approximate start of clone production, is reasonable as a placeholder.

death.source: Wookieepedia's infobox leaves the death field blank. Hunter survives The Bad Batch, and the series epilogue shows him alive and grey-haired on Pabu, which the infobox captions as 'By 4 ABY'.

notes.detail: Wookieepedia gives Hunter's operating number as CT-9901. Other clone entries use altTitle for a second identity, so this would fit there.

The last time we see Hunter alive is the series finale epilogue, which Wookieepedia's infobox captions 'By 4 ABY'. Canon records no death. Drawing the column to 30 ABY suggests he was still around then, which no source confirms. If you want the column to end at his last confirmed appearance, consider ending it around 4 ABY.
No canon birth year exists. Keep this flagged as a guess.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/BB-8.description: BB-8 is the rolling astromech whose flight across the Jakku desert, carrying a fragment of the map to Luke Skywalker, set the war between the Resistance and the First Order in motion. Built in 29 ABY, he became Poe Dameron's copilot and friend in Rapier Squadron, then followed Poe into Leia Organa's Resistance, flying with Black Squadron in the hunt for Lor San Tekka and repeatedly outsmarting the First Order agent Terex. Poe lent him to Kazuda Xiono during Kaz's spy work on the Colossus, where BB-8 kept the inexperienced pilot alive through pirate raids and First Order schemes. After the attack on Tuanul, he escaped alone with the map, met Rey and Finn, and helped bring it to the Resistance, which led to the destruction of Starkiller Base. During the evacuation of D'Qar he flew with Poe, then went with Finn and Rose Tico to Canto Bight and rescued them aboard the Supremacy by commandeering an AT-ST walker. He stayed with the survivors from Crait as they rebuilt, joined the search for the Sith wayfinder, and was at the final battle on Exegol, where the Sith Eternal were defeated.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/BB-8.socialDesc: BB-8, Poe Dameron's loyal astromech, carried the map to Luke Skywalker across Jakku and rolled through the Resistance's war against the First Order.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/BB-8.timeline:
29 ABY - Built

BB-8 is built as a BB-series astromech droid and later becomes Poe Dameron's companion.

~33 ABY - Suraz Engagement

BB-8 flies with Poe and Rapier Squadron when they answer the hijacked freighter Yissira Zyde's distress call, and they fail to stop the First Order from taking it.

~33 ABY - Skirmish in OR-Kappa-2722

Against orders, BB-8 and Poe track the freighter to a hidden First Order fleet. Back at base, Poe is disciplined, and BB-8 follows him when he leaves the New Republic to join the Resistance.

34 ABY - Black Squadron's Hunt for Lor San Tekka

BB-8 flies with Black Squadron to Ovanis and finds a First Order tracker on Poe's X-wing. He stuns Agent Terex and, on Megalox Beta, disables the prison's gravity field so the squadron can escape with Grakkus.

34 ABY - Mission to Kaddak

BB-8 helps Poe and C-3PO recover the spy droid N1-ZX. On a desert world he stops Terex from executing Poe, and Terex is handed over to the First Order.

34 ABY - Lent to Kazuda Xiono

About six months before the Battle of Starkiller Base, Poe assigns BB-8 to help Kaz spy on the Colossus refueling station on Castilon.

34 ABY - Adventures on the Colossus

BB-8 saves Kaz during pirate raids, helps him infiltrate Doza Tower twice, and joins Poe and Kaz on the mission to Station Theta Black, where he uncovers the First Order's weapons build-up.

34 ABY - Mission to the Dassal System

BB-8 helps discover that the First Order destroyed the Dassal system, then goes back to Poe while CB-23 stays with Kaz.

34 ABY - Attack on Tuanul

After Poe is captured on Jakku, BB-8 escapes with the map fragment that points to Luke Skywalker.

34 ABY - Meeting Rey

Rey frees BB-8 from Teedo's net. The two escape bandits and Unkar Plutt's thugs, meet Finn, and flee Jakku aboard the Millennium Falcon.

34 ABY - Takodana and D'Qar

BB-8 survives the First Order attack on Maz Kanata's castle and delivers the map to the Resistance on D'Qar, where he is reunited with Poe.

34 ABY - Battle of Starkiller Base

BB-8 flies with Poe in the attack that destroys Starkiller Base. When R2-D2 reawakens, the full map to Luke Skywalker is assembled.

34 ABY - Evacuation of D'Qar

BB-8 flies with Poe during the attack on the First Order dreadnought and repairs Black One's systems in the middle of the fight.

34 ABY - Canto Bight and the Supremacy

BB-8 goes with Finn and Rose Tico to find the master codebreaker. Aboard the Supremacy, he rescues them by taking control of an AT-ST walker.

34 ABY - Battle of Crait

BB-8 is with the Resistance survivors who escape Crait aboard the Millennium Falcon.

35 ABY - Rebuilding the Resistance

BB-8 goes on missions with Poe and his friends as the Resistance looks for new allies and resources after Crait.

35 ABY - Search for the Wayfinder

BB-8 goes with Rey, Finn, Poe and Chewbacca to Pasaana, Kijimi and Kef Bir in search of the Sith wayfinder, and meets the droid D-O.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

BB-8 takes part in the final battle against the Sith Eternal and Palpatine's Final Order, then celebrates the victory with the Resistance on Ajan Kloss.

birth.source: Wookieepedia BB-8 infobox (birth=29 ABY). The biography says he was 'built in 29 ABY'.

death.source: No death is recorded in canon. BB-8 is still operational after the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY.

notes.current: Star Wars Resistance, Episode VII, Episode VIII, Galaxy's Edge, Episode IX
notes.suggested: Add Star Wars: Forces of Destiny if that series is plotted on the timeline
notes.detail: BB-8 appears alongside Rey in several Forces of Destiny shorts set on Jakku. He also has major roles in the Poe Dameron comic series and the Before the Awakening / Resistance Reborn prose, if those works are tracked.
29 ABY is correct and matches the Wookieepedia infobox. For a droid, this is a manufacture date rather than a birth, so a 'Built' label may fit better than 'Born' if the app supports one.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jacen_S.description: Jacen Syndulla is the son Kanan Jarrus never met. The Jedi died saving Hera Syndulla and the Spectres shortly before Lothal was liberated, and Jacen was born later that same year. He grew up during the last years of the Galactic Civil War. By the fall of the Empire he was already part of the Ghost's crew, with the callsign Spectre 7 and the ornery astromech Chopper as his constant companion and partner in mischief. He was a natural pilot like his mother and Force-sensitive like his father, and he openly wanted to become a Jedi, just as his "Aunt Sabine" was doing under Ahsoka Tano. In the New Republic era he flew with his mother to Seatos to help Sabine and Ahsoka, and pulled the Ghost's hyperdrive lever himself on the way. There his connection to the Force let him sense Ahsoka, adrift in the World Between Worlds and dueling the memory of her old master. Jacen led the rescuers to her, then watched in wonder as she and Huyang left with a pod of purrgil.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jacen_S.socialDesc: Jacen Syndulla, son of Hera Syndulla and the late Jedi Kanan Jarrus, grew up as Spectre 7 on the Ghost and used the Force to help rescue Ahsoka Tano.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jacen_S.timeline:
1 BBY - Death of His Father

Before Jacen is born, the Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus dies on Lothal saving Hera Syndulla and the Spectres from the Empire, shortly before the planet is liberated.

1 BBY - Birth on Lothal

Jacen is born on Lothal to Rebel general Hera Syndulla. He is the son of Kanan Jarrus and the grandson of the Twi'lek freedom fighter Cham Syndulla.

~4 ABY - Spectre 7

By the time the Empire is broken at Endor, the young Jacen is counted as a member of the Ghost's crew with the callsign Spectre 7. The droid Chopper becomes his close and constant companion.

5 ABY - Apart from His Mother

Jacen and Hera are separated while she fights in the last campaigns of the Galactic Civil War. At the Battle of Jakku, facing what she believes is her death, Hera thinks of her son.

~9 ABY - Wanting to Be a Jedi

Jacen goes with his mother to her hearing before a New Republic Senate committee. Chopper tells him that Sabine Wren is training under Ahsoka Tano, and afterward Jacen tells Hera he wants to be a Jedi too.

~9 ABY - Flight to Seatos

Huyang calls for help, and Jacen joins Hera and Chopper aboard the Ghost. He pulls the hyperdrive lever to send her small task force to Seatos.

~9 ABY - Finding Ahsoka

On Seatos, Jacen senses Ahsoka through the Force and hears lightsabers clashing while she is lost in the World Between Worlds. He helps Hera and Huyang pull her from the sea.

~9 ABY - Reunion and Departure

Jacen shares a warm reunion with the recovered Ahsoka. From the Ghost, he watches in awe as she and Huyang leave with a pod of purrgil to chase the Eye of Sion.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox: born 1 BBY on Lothal. This fits the Liberation of Lothal (1 BBY), with Kanan dying before Jacen was born.

notes.detail: The column starts in 4 BBY, but the confirmed birth year is 1 BBY. The clamping rule for very long-lived characters doesn't explain a start before birth. Unless the earlier start is deliberate (for example, to cover his conception around the time of 'Kindred', which is only a writer's comment and not canon), startYear should be -1 and the separate birthYear field can be dropped.
His parentage is the core of the character and is confirmed in canon. Other entries use the Creator and Clone fields, so a similar Parents field would fit here.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/C-3PO.description: C-3PO is the anxious, fussy protocol droid who spent more than half a century close to the most important moments in galactic history, usually complaining about it. He speaks over six million forms of communication, later more than seven million. A slave boy named Anakin Skywalker rebuilt him from scrap in Mos Espa to help his mother Shmi, and he first met his lifelong partner R2-D2 around the Boonta Eve race. He stayed with Shmi on the Lars moisture farm, then followed Anakin into the first battle of the Clone Wars on Geonosis and was there when Anakin married Padmé Amidala. Given gold plating, he served Padmé as her aide through the war. After the Republic fell, his memory was wiped and he joined Bail Organa's household aboard the Tantive IV, while R2-D2 kept the secrets he had lost. Nineteen years later, Leia Organa's mission with the Death Star plans pulled the two droids into the rebellion. They ended up with Luke Skywalker and Han Solo, and 3PO survived the Death Star and Cloud City, where he was blasted apart and rebuilt. On Endor the Ewoks took him for a god, and he talked them into joining the fight. Decades later he was still at Leia's side in the Resistance. To find the path to Exegol he let his memory be wiped so he could translate a forbidden Sith inscription, and R2-D2's backup later brought his memories back once Palpatine was defeated.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/C-3PO.socialDesc: C-3PO, the worrying protocol droid Anakin Skywalker built from scrap, who survived the Clone Wars, the rebellion and the First Order at R2-D2's side.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/C-3PO.timeline:
Unknown - Early Service

In an earlier life as a 3PO-series unit, he serves as protocol droid to the chief negotiator of the Manakron system. He is later badly damaged, and his parts end up on a Tatooine junk pile.

~34 BBY - Rebuilt by Anakin Skywalker

Young slave Anakin Skywalker starts rebuilding the droid from scrap in Mos Espa to help his mother Shmi. He has no plating, so his wiring is exposed.

32 BBY - Meeting R2-D2

Anakin fits him with a photoreceptor, and he sees for the first time. He meets R2-D2 and Padmé Amidala, and the two droids help prepare Anakin's podracer.

32 BBY - Boonta Eve Classic

He carries Anakin's flag in the opening parade and watches him win his freedom. Anakin leaves Tatooine and says goodbye to him, the job still unfinished.

~32 BBY - The Lars Homestead

He goes with Shmi when Cliegg Lars frees and marries her. Shmi gives him grey plating, and he works on the moisture farm.

22 BBY - Reunion with Anakin

He greets Anakin and Padmé when they arrive looking for the kidnapped Shmi. He attends her funeral and leaves Tatooine with them.

22 BBY - First Battle of Geonosis

In the droid foundry his head ends up on a battle droid's body, and he is dragged into the opening battle of the Clone Wars. R2-D2 later reattaches his head to his own body.

22 BBY - Anakin and Padmé's Wedding

He witnesses Anakin and Padmé's secret wedding in Naboo's Lake Country.

22 BBY - Aide to Senator Amidala

With new gold plating, he serves Padmé through the Clone Wars. That includes calling in the Coruscant Guard to rescue her from Ziro the Hutt and escaping the Malevolence.

22–21 BBY - Clone Wars Missions

He survives the Separatist ambush on Rodia and helps negotiate the Pantoran–Talz truce on Orto Plutonia. On Naboo he questions a tactical droid during the Blue Shadow Virus crisis.

~21 BBY - Senate Hostage Crisis

Cad Bane kidnaps him, scans his memory and wipes it. He is later held hostage with Padmé when Bane takes over the Senate Building.

~21–20 BBY - Adventures with R2-D2

He calms the earthquakes on Aleen, lives through the Zillo Beast's rampage on Coruscant, and wanders between Patitite Pattuna, Balnab and a Weequay pirate ship before Plo Koon's fleet rescues him.

19 BBY - Fall of the Republic

He goes with Padmé to Mustafar and is there when she dies. Bail Organa has his memory wiped, and he joins the crew of the Tantive IV.

9 BBY - Alderaan

He works at the Organa court while young Leia is growing up.

~5 BBY - Mission with the Ghost Crew

On a mission for Bail Organa, he and R2-D2 cross paths with the rebels of the Ghost.

1 BBY - Battle of Scarif

He is aboard the Tantive IV when the stolen Death Star plans come to Leia at Scarif.

1 BBY - The Death Star Plans

He escapes to Tatooine with R2-D2 and is sold to the Lars family. He meets Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, then helps rescue Leia from the Death Star.

0 ABY - Destroyed and Rebuilt

He is destroyed on Vrogas Vas during a rebel mission and then rebuilt.

3 ABY - Hoth and Cloud City

He escapes Hoth on the Millennium Falcon. On Bespin, stormtroopers blast him apart, and Chewbacca later puts him back together.

4 ABY - Jabba's Palace

He is given to Jabba the Hutt as part of the rescue of Han Solo and is forced to serve as the Hutt's translator.

4 ABY - Battle of Endor

The Ewoks worship him as a golden god, and he convinces the Bright Tree tribe to fight alongside the Rebel Alliance.

~9 ABY - New Republic Service

As an aide to Senator Leia Organa, he brings the message that saves Hera Syndulla from a court-martial.

~34 ABY - Red Arm

After a crash, he wears a red replacement arm for a short time.

34 ABY - The Resistance

He serves General Leia Organa's Resistance, running its spy droid network, and is at the Battle of Crait.

35 ABY - Translating the Sith Dagger

On Kijimi he lets his memory be wiped so he can translate a Sith inscription that leads to Exegol.

35 ABY - Memory Restored

After the Battle of Exegol, R2-D2 uses his backup to restore C-3PO's memories.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox gives birth as 'Between 34 BBY and 32 BBY'. The biography says Anakin began rebuilding him in 34 BBY. The droid also had an earlier, undated incarnation (the Manakron system).

death.source: Wookieepedia lists destructions at Vrogas Vas (0 ABY) and Bespin (3 ABY), but he was rebuilt both times. He is still active after the Battle of Exegol (35 ABY), and no final death is recorded.

notes.detail: Keeping -34 flagged as a guess is right. Wookieepedia's birth field is a range, 'Between 34 BBY and 32 BBY'. The body text says Anakin started rebuilding him in 34 BBY, and that is only a reconstruction: C-3PO had an earlier incarnation (protocol droid to the Manakron system's chief negotiator) with no date. The 34 BBY start could be labelled as the Anakin rebuild rather than a birth.

The Wookieepedia infobox has 'death' entries for 0 ABY (Vrogas Vas) and 3 ABY (Bespin). Both are destructions he was rebuilt from, not deaths. The open-ended column is correct; just make sure no automated import reads those infobox entries as a death year.
Wookieepedia lists Cybot Galactica as manufacturer and the 3PO-series as model, alongside Anakin as creator/rebuilder. We only track the Creator field.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Omega.description: Omega is best known as the youngest and most determined member of Clone Force 99, the renegade squad nicknamed the Bad Batch. She was one of only two unaltered copies of Jango Fett's genetic template, the other being Boba Fett, and she grew up quietly in Tipoca City as a medical assistant to the Kaminoan scientist Nala Se. When the Clone Wars ended and the Empire rose in 19 BBY, she befriended the Bad Batch and escaped Kamino with them, leaving behind the only home she had known. As she travelled with Hunter, Wrecker, Tech and Echo, she learned to fight with a Zygerrian energy bow, took on jobs for the information broker Cid, and was chased by bounty hunters including Fennec Shand and Cad Bane. She saw Tipoca City destroyed, grieved when Tech was killed on Eriadu, and was later taken to Mount Tantiss because her unusually high M-count made her vital to Doctor Royce Hemlock's cloning research. She escaped with Crosshair and brought him back into the family. After she gave herself up to protect the people of Pabu, she helped free the Force-sensitive children held at Tantiss before her brothers rescued her and Hemlock was killed. She then spent peaceful years on Pabu before leaving as a young adult to fly for the Rebel Alliance.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Omega.socialDesc: Omega, the female Jango Fett clone who fled Kamino with the Bad Batch, survived Imperial capture at Mount Tantiss and grew up to fly for the Rebellion.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Omega.timeline:
Date unknown - Created on Kamino

Nala Se creates Omega in her private laboratory in Tipoca City as an unmodified female copy of Jango Fett's template. Only Omega and Boba Fett are pure copies of that template.

Clone Wars era - Nala Se's assistant

Omega works as Nala Se's medical assistant. She is present when Clone Force 99 is created, then follows the squad's wartime exploits from Kamino without ever meeting them.

19 BBY - Meets the Bad Batch

After Order 66 and the proclamation of the Empire, Omega introduces herself to the Bad Batch and stands up for them in the mess hall. She also warns Hunter that Tarkin does not trust clones.

19 BBY - Escape from Kamino

Omega is imprisoned for snooping in the squad's barracks. She helps the Bad Batch break out, fires a blaster for the first time against Crosshair, who is now loyal to the Empire, and flees Kamino aboard the Marauder.

19 BBY - First steps offworld on Saleucami

Omega sees dirt and sunlight for the first time at Cut Lawquane's farm. She delivers forged chain codes so the family can escape, but refuses to leave with them and returns to the squad instead.

19 BBY - Ordo Moon

Omega crawls into a moon dragon's den to recover the Marauder's stolen power capacitor. Wrecker gives her a room of her own, and Hunter tells her she is part of the squad.

19 BBY - Hunted by Fennec Shand

During a supply run on Pantora, bounty hunter Fennec Shand, hired by Nala Se, tries to take Omega. The squad rescues her.

19 BBY - Working for Cid

On Ord Mantell, Omega frees her captured squad by releasing the rancor Muchi and picks up a Zygerrian energy bow. On Corellia, the squad teams up with Trace and Rafa Martez to steal a tactical droid head.

19 BBY - Bracca and capture by Cad Bane

Omega goes with Rex and the squad to Bracca, where the clones' inhibitor chips are removed. Cad Bane then kidnaps her, but she escapes him at the Bora Vio cloning facility and the Bad Batch rescues her.

19 BBY - Fall of Tipoca City

Omega helps rescue Hunter on Kamino as Imperial Star Destroyers level Tipoca City. She leads the group to safety through the tube system and nearly drowns trying to save AZI-3, but Crosshair pulls her out. Crosshair then chooses to stay with the Empire.

19–18 BBY - Adventures across the galaxy

Omega goes on jobs and missions with the squad on Serenno, Serolonis, Skara Nal, Kashyyyk and other worlds.

18 BBY - Coruscant and Echo's departure

The squad helps Senator Riyo Chuchi expose the Empire's destruction of Tipoca City. Echo then leaves to join Rex's Clone Underground, and Omega says a tearful goodbye.

18 BBY - Pabu

After breaking with Cid, the squad works with the pirate Phee Genoa and finds the island haven of Pabu, where Hunter hopes Omega can have a peaceful life.

18 BBY - Loss of Tech

The squad's attempt on Eriadu to find Crosshair through Doctor Hemlock goes wrong, and Tech dies making sure the others escape.

18 BBY - Captured and taken to Tantiss

Cid betrays the Bad Batch, and Omega is taken to Mount Tantiss. There she is made to work alongside Emerie Karr and Nala Se, and her blood tests reveal a high M-count that Project Necromancer needs.

18 BBY - Escape with Crosshair

With help from Nala Se, Omega frees the imprisoned Crosshair. The two escape Tantiss together and rejoin the Bad Batch.

18 BBY - Hiding on Pabu

Omega learns that CX troopers are hunting her because of her M-count and lies low on Pabu. Asajj Ventress tests whether she can use the Force, but the results are inconclusive.

18 BBY - Surrender to protect Pabu

When Imperial forces raid Pabu, Omega gives herself up to CX-2. She is taken back to Tantiss and meets the Force-sensitive children held in the vault.

18 BBY - Liberation of Tantiss

Omega leads the children and imprisoned clones in a breakout while her brothers attack the base. Hemlock is killed as Hunter and Crosshair rescue her.

After 18 BBY - Life on Pabu

Omega and the surviving members of Clone Force 99 settle on Pabu and live there for many years.

Date unknown - Joins the Rebel Alliance

As a young adult, Omega leaves Pabu to become a pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's Omega article leaves the infobox birth field blank. Canon gives no creation year and no exact age for her. All it establishes is that she was already alive, and working as Nala Se's assistant, when Clone Force 99 was created, which was before the Clone Wars (22–19 BBY).

death.source: Wookieepedia's infobox has no death date. She is alive at the end of The Bad Batch, which ends with an epilogue of her as an adult joining the Rebel Alliance as a pilot.

notes.detail: Canon gives no creation year or exact age for Omega, and Wookieepedia's birth field is empty. Keeping -32 with startYearUnknown: true is reasonable: she had to exist before Clone Force 99 was created, and she looks like an early teen in 19 BBY. Keep it flagged as a guess.

In Season 3 the Empire targets Omega because of her high M-count (midi-chlorian level). Asajj Ventress tests her for Force sensitivity and the results are inconclusive. Canon never says she is not Force-sensitive, so a flat 'No' overstates what we know.

notes.suggested: Affiliation: Clone Force 99; Alliance to Restore the Republic
notes.detail: The series finale epilogue shows adult Omega joining the Rebel Alliance as a pilot. That is a notable later milestone our entry doesn't mention.

Omega is alive at the end of canon. Her last appearance, the adult epilogue in 'The Cavalry Has Arrived', has no stated year; it is set some years after 18 BBY during the rebellion era. Leaving endYearUnknown: true is correct.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ezra_Br.description: Ezra Bridger is remembered as the street-smart orphan who became a Jedi Padawan and one of the early rebellion's most important young leaders. He was born on the first Empire Day. His parents were arrested for their anti-Imperial broadcasts, and from about the age of seven he lived alone as a thief and con artist. In 5 BBY he fell in with the rebel crew of the Ghost, and Kanan Jarrus took him on as an apprentice. He built his own lightsaber from a kyber crystal he received in the Lothal Jedi Temple, and his broadcast of defiance helped bring scattered rebel cells together. Learning that his parents had died in an Imperial prison pushed him toward the dark side, which peaked on Malachor, where he opened a Sith holocron alongside Maul and Kanan was blinded. He came back from the edge, went on to lead missions of his own, helped Rex's droid veterans end their war, and set out to find Obi-Wan Kenobi. After Kanan died, Ezra led the liberation of Lothal in 1 BBY. He called a pod of purrgil to drag Grand Admiral Thrawn's fleet into hyperspace, and he was carried off with it. For almost a decade he was stranded on Peridea in another galaxy. There Sabine Wren and Ahsoka Tano found him, and he got home aboard Thrawn's own flagship.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ezra_Br.socialDesc: Ezra Bridger, street orphan turned Jedi Padawan, rallied the early rebellion, freed Lothal from Thrawn, and escaped a decade of exile in another galaxy.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ezra_Br.timeline:
19 BBY - Birth on Empire Day

Born on Lothal to Ephraim and Mira Bridger on the day the Galactic Empire was proclaimed.

~18 BBY - The Graf Children

As an infant, meets Milo and Lina Graf, whom his parents shelter after the Empire abducts the Grafs' parents.

14 BBY - Parents Speak Out

His parents begin illegal public broadcasts criticizing Imperial rule on Lothal.

12 BBY - Orphaned

The Empire arrests Ephraim and Mira. The seven-year-old Ezra is left to survive alone on the streets as a thief and con artist, and eventually makes his home in an abandoned comm tower.

~5 BBY - Gladiator Night

Guides the bounty hunter Bossk through Capital City and helps expose a corrupt Imperial officer after his mentor, the pawnbroker Ferpil Wallaway, is killed.

5 BBY - Joins the Spectres

Runs into the crew of the Ghost during a heist in Capital City and helps free Wookiee slaves from Kessel. He then accepts Kanan Jarrus's offer to become his Padawan.

5 BBY - Stygeon Prime

Joins Kanan's attempt to rescue Luminara Unduli and learns it was a trap set by the Grand Inquisitor.

5 BBY - Undercover at the Imperial Academy

Infiltrates Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials as cadet "Dev Morgan," steals a decoder, and helps Jai Kell escape the Inquisitor with Zare Leonis's help.

5 BBY - Empire Day

On his fifteenth birthday, helps rescue his parents' friend Tseebo. At Fort Anaxes he briefly taps the dark side to command a giant fyrnock against the Inquisitor.

5 BBY - Lothal Jedi Temple

Passes a trial in the Jedi Temple on Lothal, where Yoda guides him and gives him a kyber crystal. He uses it to build his own lightsaber.

5 BBY - A Message of Hope

Broadcasts a call for resistance across the Lothal sector, which helps unite rebel cells.

5 BBY - Mustafar

Helps rescue Kanan from Grand Moff Tarkin and sees the Grand Inquisitor die. Afterwards the Spectres join Phoenix Cell.

4 BBY - Parents' Fate

Learns that his parents died leading a prison revolt they had been inspired to start by his own broadcast.

4 BBY - Malachor

Allies with Maul in a Sith temple and uses the dark side to open a Sith holocron. Kanan is blinded and Ahsoka Tano faces Darth Vader.

3 BBY - Under Maul's Shadow

Struggles with the holocron's influence while fighting Grand Admiral Thrawn. He destroys the holocron with Kanan's help and Maul's attempts to claim him fail.

2 BBY - Agamar

Helps Rex and a band of leftover Separatist battle droids make peace, giving them closure on the Clone Wars.

2 BBY - Twin Suns

Goes to Tatooine to find Obi-Wan Kenobi and witnesses Kenobi's final duel with Maul.

2 BBY - Battle of Atollon

Survives Thrawn's attack on Chopper Base with the help of Kanan and the Force-wielder known as the Bendu.

1 BBY - Return to Lothal

Rejoins the Lothal resistance with Ryder Azadi and uncovers the Empire's TIE Defender program. Kanan sacrifices himself to save the crew.

1 BBY - The World Between Worlds

Guided by the white Loth-wolf, enters a realm outside time through the Lothal Jedi Temple and pulls Ahsoka Tano out of her duel with Darth Vader. He refuses Emperor Palpatine's temptation to bring Kanan back.

1 BBY - Liberation of Lothal

Calls a pod of purrgil to drag Thrawn's fleet into hyperspace, taking himself and Thrawn with it. His friends destroy the Imperial dome and free Lothal.

~5 ABY - The Search Begins

After the Empire falls, Sabine Wren and Ahsoka Tano set out to find him.

9 ABY - Exile on Peridea

After almost a decade stranded on the planet Peridea in another galaxy, he is reunited with Sabine and Ahsoka.

9 ABY - Homecoming

When Thrawn escapes Peridea aboard the Chimaera, Ezra stows away on the Star Destroyer and returns to the main galaxy, leaving Sabine and Ahsoka behind.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox: born on Empire Day, 19 BBY, Lothal (3258 LY). This matches his fifteenth birthday falling in 5 BBY in Star Wars Rebels "Empire Day".

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox gives no death date. He is alive at the end of Ahsoka Season 1 (9 ABY), when he leaves Peridea aboard the Chimaera.

notes.detail: Kanan Jarrus trained him as a Jedi. Adding his master would match how other Jedi entries are presented.

Wookieepedia marks the article as conflicting between Adventures in Wild Space: The Steal and Star Wars: Galactic Atlas. This is probably about when in his childhood his parents were taken. The article uses 14 BBY for the broadcasts and 'by 12 BBY' for the arrest, which fits Ezra saying he was on his own from age seven. The birth year of 19 BBY is not affected.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Armitag.description: Armitage Hux is best known as the young, venomous First Order general who ordered Starkiller Base to fire on the Hosnian system, wiping out the New Republic's capital and fleet in a single shot. He was born illegitimate to the Imperial academy commandant Brendol Hux and grew up scorned and beaten by his father. As the Empire collapsed he was carried into the Unknown Regions alongside Grand Admiral Rae Sloane and a band of child soldiers placed under his command, and he came of age inside the Imperial remnant that became the First Order. Driven by ambition and resentment, he quietly had his father poisoned with Captain Phasma's help, took over the program that raised stormtroopers from infancy, and became the youngest general in the First Order's High Command. His bitter rivalry with Kylo Ren shaped his career: he commanded the Finalizer during the hunt for Luke Skywalker, oversaw the destruction of the Hosnian worlds and the loss of Starkiller, then pushed the hyperspace tracking that let the fleet chase the Resistance from D'Qar toward Crait aboard the Supremacy. After Snoke's death, Ren became Supreme Leader and Hux lost most of his standing. Sidelined under Allegiant General Enric Pryde, he secretly began feeding intelligence to the Resistance, less out of conscience than a wish to see Ren lose. He even helped captured Resistance fighters escape from the Steadfast over Kijimi, until Pryde exposed him and shot him for treason.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Armitag.socialDesc: Armitage Hux fired Starkiller Base on the Hosnian system, feuded with Kylo Ren for power, then spied for the Resistance and was executed as a traitor.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Armitag.timeline:
1 BBY - Birth on Arkanis

Born on Arkanis as the illegitimate son of Commandant Brendol Hux and a kitchen worker. He never knew his mother and grew up friendless, mocked by Imperial officers and abused by his father.

5 ABY - Flight from Arkanis

As the New Republic besieges Arkanis, the bounty hunter Mercurial Swift, hired at Gallius Rax's request, pulls Armitage and Brendol off the planet before they can be captured.

5 ABY - Rax's Gift on Jakku

On Jakku, Counselor Gallius Rax places the child soldiers trained by Brendol under the boy's command and names him his father's future successor.

5 ABY - Escape into the Unknown Regions

After Rae Sloane kills Rax during the Battle of Jakku, Hux, his father and Sloane flee into uncharted space aboard the Imperialis. Sloane shields the boy from Brendol's abuse and orders his father to educate him as a proper heir.

New Republic Era - Rise to General

Grows up within the Imperial remnant that becomes the First Order and becomes the youngest general in its High Command, carrying on his father's methods of training soldiers from birth.

Cold War - Retrieval from Parnassos

Answers his father's distress call from Parnassos and brings Brendol, Phasma and Frey back to the First Order. On the way to the Absolution, he watches Brendol bombard the planet from orbit.

Cold War - Death of Brendol Hux

Conspires with Phasma to kill his father. She uses a Parnassos beetle toxin that can't be traced. Hux then takes Brendol's place, pushes aside Brendol's loyalist Captain Cardinal, and leads Project Resurrection with Phasma.

Cold War - Marooned with Kylo Ren

Survives a sabotaged shuttle crash on a forest world with his rival Kylo Ren. He tricks the old Alderaanian guard Bylsma into calling for a rescue, then marks the planet for Starkiller target practice.

Cold War - Execution of Admiral Brooks

Holds Admiral Brooks responsible for the sabotage and shoots him, paying back a lifetime of humiliation and admitting that he had his own father killed.

34 ABY - Hunt for the Map to Skywalker

Commands the Finalizer during the attack on Tuanul and the search for BB-8. Poe Dameron and the defecting FN-2187 escape from his ship.

34 ABY - Hosnian Cataclysm

Gives a fiery speech to the assembled troops on Starkiller Base and orders the superweapon to fire, destroying the Hosnian system and the New Republic's leadership.

34 ABY - Fall of Starkiller Base

Evacuates as the Resistance destroys Starkiller Base and follows Snoke's order to bring back the wounded Kylo Ren.

34 ABY - Battle of D'Qar

Leads the fleet against the Resistance base on D'Qar but loses a Siege Dreadnought to Poe Dameron and the Resistance bombers. Snoke punishes him through the Force, and Hux answers with his plan for hyperspace tracking.

34 ABY - Pursuit of the Resistance Fleet

From the Supremacy, directs the slow chase of the Resistance fleet and captures Finn and Rose Tico. The Holdo maneuver cripples the Supremacy, and Snoke is found dead.

34 ABY - Battle of Crait

Bows to Kylo Ren as the new Supreme Leader and follows him into the attack on the Resistance outpost on Crait, from which the survivors escape.

35 ABY - Supreme Council and Demotion

Sits on the First Order Supreme Council but loses influence and serves under Allegiant General Enric Pryde aboard the Steadfast.

35 ABY - Resistance Spy

Secretly leaks intelligence to the Resistance, including word of the Sith Eternal's fleet on Exegol, hoping to see Kylo Ren lose.

35 ABY - Execution Aboard the Steadfast

After helping Finn, Poe Dameron and Chewbacca escape from the Steadfast above Kijimi, he reveals that he was the spy. Pryde shoots him dead for treason.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and Early life section: born 1 BBY on Arkanis.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 35 ABY aboard the Steadfast above Kijimi, executed by Enric Pryde (Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker).

notes.detail: Most of canon, both films and tie-ins, calls him 'General Hux'. Putting that in altTitle would help search and recognition.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Boba_Fe.description: Boba Fett is known as the most feared bounty hunter of the Imperial age. He later became something rarer: a hunter who went legitimate and ruled a city. He began as "Alpha," the one unaltered clone that Jango Fett asked for as payment for serving as the clone army's template, and Jango raised him as a son. Jango trained him in combat, piloting and the bounty trade, and Boba flew Slave I as a boy. At ten he watched Mace Windu kill his father in the Geonosis arena. His first attempt at revenge, sabotaging the Republic cruiser Endurance with Aurra Sing's crew, ended with him in a Coruscant prison. After his release he led the Krayt's Claw syndicate and learned from hunters such as Cad Bane. He then rebuilt his father's armor and built a reputation that made him the first choice of Jabba the Hutt and Darth Vader. His best-known job was capturing Han Solo in carbonite at Cloud City, a prize fought over in the War of the Bounty Hunters. At Solo's rescue a damaged jetpack dropped him into the sarlacc. He clawed his way out, lived for a time with a Tusken tribe, and took back his armor from Din Djarin. He then helped rescue Grogu from Moff Gideon, killed Bib Fortuna and claimed Jabba's old throne. With Fennec Shand beside him, he fought off the Pyke Syndicate, the Hutt Twins and his old mentor Cad Bane to earn Mos Espa's loyalty as its Daimyo.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Boba_Fe.socialDesc: Boba Fett, Jango's cloned son, became the galaxy's most feared bounty hunter, survived the sarlacc and seized Jabba's throne as Daimyo of Mos Espa.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Boba_Fe.timeline:
32 BBY - Created on Kamino

Grown in Tipoca City as "Alpha," the unaltered clone Jango Fett asked for as part of his payment for being the clone army's template. He has no growth acceleration and no behavioral conditioning. Jango raises him as his son.

~32–23 BBY - Childhood training

Raised by Jango on Kamino, he learns marksmanship, survival skills and how to fly Slave I, sometimes going along on his father's hunts.

23 BBY - First mission on Ord Mantell

Joins Jango and a hired crew to recover a runaway Twi'lek. When the crew turns on them, Boba kills two of the traitors, his first taste of the trade.

22 BBY - Flight from Kamino

After Obi-Wan Kenobi finds the Fetts, Boba fires Slave I's cannons at the Jedi during his duel with Jango, then helps the two of them escape to Geonosis.

22 BBY - Death of Jango Fett

Watches Mace Windu behead his father in the Geonosis arena. He picks up Jango's helmet, flees in Slave I and swears revenge.

~21 BBY - Sabotage of the Endurance

Disguised as a clone cadet, he plants a bomb meant for Windu and wrecks the Republic cruiser Endurance, working with Aurra Sing, Bossk and Castas.

~21 BBY - Capture on Florrum

Upset by Sing's cruelty to their hostages, he is captured by Plo Koon and Ahsoka Tano. On Hondo Ohnaka's advice he reveals where the hostages are, and he is sent to prison on Coruscant.

~20 BBY - Prison riot

Paid by Cad Bane to start a fight with "Rako Hardeen," who is really Kenobi in disguise, as a cover for Bane's escape from the Republic detention center.

~20 BBY - Krayt's Claw

Released from prison, he forms a bounty hunter syndicate based on Tatooine. On a job on Quarzite, Asajj Ventress double-crosses him and leaves him tied up in a cargo chest.

~19 BBY - Raid on Serenno

Hired by Ventress to rescue Quinlan Vos. Count Dooku easily beats Krayt's Claw, and the crew retreats.

~19–11 BBY - Assuming his father's mantle

Rebuilds Jango's armor, takes back Slave I, adopts the EE-3 carbine and becomes known as the best bounty hunter in the galaxy.

~10 BBY - The Corellia job

A contract with Nakano Lash's crew against the Unbroken Clan falls apart. Boba's shot meant for Lash kills T'ongor instead, starting lasting grudges with Beilert Valance and Bossk.

9 BBY - Collecting Caij Vanda

Captures the bounty hunter Caij Vanda on Koboh after a tense standoff with the Jedi Cal Kestis.

1 BBY - Docking Bay 94

Is with Jabba the Hutt when the gangster confronts Han Solo on Tatooine.

3 ABY - Capture of Han Solo

Hired by Darth Vader, he tracks the Millennium Falcon to Cloud City and claims Solo, now frozen in carbonite, to deliver to Jabba.

3 ABY - War of the Bounty Hunters

Loses Solo on Nar Shaddaa when Crimson Dawn steals him. He fights through hunters, syndicates and the Empire to get him back and finally hands him to Jabba.

4 ABY - Fall into the sarlacc

During the Rebels' rescue of Solo above the Great Pit of Carkoon, a blow to his jetpack sends him into the sarlacc. He cuts his way out, but Jawas strip his armor.

~4–9 ABY - Life among the Tuskens

Taken captive by a Tusken tribe, he earns their respect, learns their ways and fights beside them until the Nikto gang working for the Pykes massacres the tribe.

9 ABY - Reclaiming his armor

Confronts Din Djarin on Tython, gets his armor back and helps rescue Grogu from Moff Gideon's cruiser.

9 ABY - Daimyo of Mos Espa

Kills Bib Fortuna and takes Jabba's old throne, with Fennec Shand as his partner.

9 ABY - Battle of Mos Espa

With Djarin, Grogu, Krrsantan and allies from the city, he defeats the Pyke Syndicate. He kills his old mentor Cad Bane and wins the loyalty of Mos Espa's people.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox: birth = 32 BBY, Kamino. The article also dates the Sith takeover of the clone program and Boba's creation to 32 BBY.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox has no death date. Boba is alive at the end of The Book of Boba Fett (9 ABY), and no canon source records his death.

notes.detail: Wookieepedia says Boba's original Kaminoan code name was "Alpha." It is the only real second identity he has, and it ties him to Omega.

Boba appears in A New Hope only in the 1997 Special Edition's Docking Bay 94 scene with Jabba, not in the 1977 theatrical cut. It is valid for current canon, but you may want to note that it depends on the edition.
He appears in 9 BBY collecting Caij Vanda on Koboh. Add it if the timeline plots video games.
His last dated on-screen appearance is The Book of Boba Fett (9 ABY). The 30 ABY column end is only a rendering bound; no canon source places him after 9 ABY.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Garazeb.description: Zeb Orrelios is the hot-tempered, bo-rifle-wielding muscle of the Ghost crew. He was once a captain of the Lasan High Honor Guard and fought to hold the royal palace when the Empire devastated his homeworld with banned T-7 ion disruptors. Kanan Jarrus found him afterwards, adrift and believing himself one of the last of his kind, and he joined Hera Syndulla's Spectres. On Lothal he spent years humiliating stormtroopers, trading barbs with Ezra Bridger and Chopper, and fighting Agent Alexsandr Kallus, the officer who had overseen the slaughter on Lasan. His outlook changed when he guided the Ghost through a collapsed star cluster to Lira San, the ancestral Lasat world, and found that his people had survived. Stranded with Kallus on an icy moon, he formed a grudging bond with his old enemy, and that bond helped turn Kallus into a rebel spy. Zeb forgave him. Zeb stayed with the Spectres through the founding of the Rebel Alliance, the disaster at Atollon and the liberation of Lothal. After the war he brought Kallus to Lira San. He later served with the New Republic's Adelphi Rangers, helping Din Djarin hunt Imperial warlords and joining the assault on Nal Hutta to rescue him.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Garazeb.socialDesc: Zeb Orrelios, Lasan Honor Guard captain turned Ghost crew brawler, fought the Empire as a Spectre and later joined the New Republic's Adelphi Rangers.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Garazeb.timeline:
~44 BBY - Birth on Lasan

Born on Lasan. His birth year comes only from his stated age of thirty-nine at the start of Star Wars Rebels.

Before 19 BBY - Lasan High Honor Guard

Joins the Honor Guard, earns his bo-rifle and rises to captain, charged with protecting the royal family and the Lasat people.

Early Imperial Era - Fall of Lasan

The Empire devastates Lasan with T-7 ion disruptors. Zeb defends the palace until a bomb knocks him out, then wakes to find his people almost wiped out.

Early Imperial Era - Found by Kanan Jarrus

Kanan Jarrus finds the despairing survivor, and Zeb joins Hera Syndulla's crew aboard the Ghost.

5 BBY - Meeting Ezra Bridger

On Lothal the Spectres run into Ezra Bridger. Zeb helps free Wookiee prisoners from Kessel and grudgingly accepts Ezra as a crewmate.

5 BBY - The T-7 Disruptors

Steals a shipment of T-7 disruptors on Garel and duels Agent Kallus, who boasts of his part in the genocide on Lasan. Ezra saves Zeb, and the weapons are destroyed.

5 BBY - Raids on Lothal

Steals a TIE fighter with Ezra, escapes the Grand Inquisitor at the Spire on Stygeon Prime and helps extract Ezra from the Imperial Academy.

5 BBY - Joining the Wider Rebellion

After the rescue of Kanan from Grand Moff Tarkin and the burning of Lothal's skies, the Spectres join the larger rebel network under Ahsoka Tano and Commander Sato.

4 BBY - Legends of the Lasat

Meets the surviving Lasat Chava and Gron and uses his bo-rifle to guide the Ghost through a collapsed star cluster to Lira San, where he finds his people alive.

3 BBY - Stranded with Kallus

Trapped with Agent Kallus on the ice moon Bahryn, Zeb forms an unlikely truce with him that sets Kallus on the path to defection.

3 BBY - Kallus Defects

Kallus, now the rebel spy Fulcrum, is exposed by Thrawn. Zeb welcomes his old enemy into the Rebellion and forgives him for Lasan.

2 BBY - Battle of Atollon

Survives Thrawn's assault on Chopper Base as the Phoenix Cell rebels escape Atollon.

1 BBY - Liberation of Lothal

Fights in the final campaign to free Lothal, which drives out the Empire and destroys the Imperial Dome with Thrawn's Star Destroyer carried off by the purrgil.

After 4 ABY - Return to Lira San

After the Galactic Civil War, Zeb takes Kallus to Lira San to show him that the Lasat live on.

~9 ABY - Adelphi Rangers

Now a member of the New Republic's Adelphi Rangers, he is stationed on Adelphi as Din Djarin and Carson Teva deal with pirate attacks on Nevarro.

After 9 ABY - Hunting Imperial Warlords

Helps Din Djarin track down Imperial warlords, including Barro and Janu Coin.

After 9 ABY - Attack on Nal Hutta

Joins the rest of the Adelphi Rangers in an attack on Nal Hutta to rescue Din Djarin.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's infobox leaves the birth field blank. The article says Zeb had joined the Spectres 'by the time he was thirty-nine', and Rebels season one is set in 5 BBY, which gives roughly 44 BBY. This is derived from his age, not stated in any source.

death.source: Wookieepedia's infobox has no death date. Zeb is alive in his latest canon appearance, The Mandalorian and Grogu.

notes.detail: Canon never gives Zeb's birth year, and Wookieepedia's infobox birth field is empty. The 44 BBY figure is worked out from his stated age of 39 in 5 BBY, so it's close but still an estimate and should carry the '(this is a guess)' label. Keep -44 as the value.

Wookieepedia's infobox labels Zeb's The Mandalorian and Grogu image 'c. 14 ABY'. That doesn't obviously match the usual placement of the film shortly after The Mandalorian season 3 (~9 ABY). If the timeline plots when the film takes place, check how Wookieepedia dates it. The appearance itself is confirmed.

notes.suggested: Affiliation: Lasan High Honor Guard; Spectres / Rebel Alliance; New Republic (Adelphi Rangers)
notes.detail: The entry doesn't track his affiliations. Two of them, the Honor Guard captaincy and his Adelphi Rangers service, are central to the character.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Snoke.description: Supreme Leader of the First Order and the dark side master who seduced Ben Solo into becoming Kylo Ren, Snoke believed he was a self-made seeker of forbidden Force lore. In reality he had been grown in the Sith Eternal's laboratories on Exegol, an early attempt at a vessel for Darth Sidious's spirit. Sidious rejected the body as unworthy, but after his resurrection he used Snoke as an unwitting puppet. Snoke gathered ancient knowledge in the Unknown Regions and, with the help of his navigators, guided the Imperial remnant that fled there after the Empire's collapse. He then pushed aside its old leadership and rebuilt it as the First Order, ruling from the mobile Star Dreadnought Supremacy. For years he whispered to the young Ben Solo, feeding his resentment toward his family and his uncle Luke Skywalker. After the fall of Luke's Jedi temple in 28 ABY, Snoke took Ben as his apprentice and sent him to take command of the Knights of Ren. In 34 ABY he approved the Starkiller Base strike that destroyed the New Republic's capital and began the First Order–Resistance War. Months later he was betrayed and cut in half by Kylo Ren in his throne room. His death was the final step of Sidious's plan to shape Ren into a Sith-worthy successor.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Snoke.socialDesc: Snoke ruled the First Order as Supreme Leader, seduced Ben Solo to the dark side as Palpatine's unwitting puppet, and died by his apprentice's blade.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Snoke.timeline:
By 12 BBY - Created on Exegol

The Sith Eternal grows Snoke in the Sith Citadel's laboratory as one of its earliest attempts at a body to hold Darth Sidious's spirit. Sidious rejects him as an unworthy vessel but keeps him as a potential pawn. Several of his clone "brothers" are kept dormant in vats.

Imperial Era - Seeker of Lost Lore

Snoke becomes a master of the dark side and searches the Unknown Regions for forgotten Force knowledge, including the prophecy of the Force dyad. He visits Darth Vader's castle on Mustafar, where he finds the gold ring he later wears.

4 ABY - Witnesses the Emperor's Fall

From afar, Snoke watches the Battle of Endor, where Vader betrays Sidious to save his son. He later blames the Empire's defeat on Vader's sentiment.

~4 ABY - Becomes Sidious's Proxy

Sidious returns in a failing clone body on Exegol and begins steering Snoke from the shadows without Snoke knowing.

~5 ABY - Guides the Imperial Exodus

After the Empire's collapse, Snoke's navigators lead the Imperial remnant into the Unknown Regions. There he helps it survive and reorganize.

~5–15 ABY - Seizes the First Order

Snoke sidelines, co-opts or kills the old Imperial leadership, takes power as Supreme Leader and launches a large rearmament program.

15 ABY - Whispers to Ben Solo

As Ben Solo begins Jedi training under Luke Skywalker, Snoke starts speaking to him in his mind and wins the boy's trust.

19 ABY - Elphrona

During Ben's mission to Elphrona with Luke, Snoke encourages his grievances against his uncle and the Jedi.

28 ABY - Fall of the Jedi Temple

Snoke uses the public revelation of Vader's parentage and Luke's moment of doubt to push Ben into destroying Luke's temple. He then welcomes Ben at the Amaxine space station.

~28 ABY - Birth of Kylo Ren

Snoke vouches for Ben with the Knights of Ren. After Ben kills Ren, their leader, and takes command of the Knights, he swears loyalty to Snoke as his apprentice, Kylo Ren.

34 ABY - The Hosnian Cataclysm

Snoke approves the Starkiller Base strike that destroys the New Republic's capital. He orders Kylo Ren to bring him the scavenger Rey after the base is destroyed.

34 ABY - Death Aboard the Supremacy

While chasing the Resistance, Snoke links the minds of Rey and Kylo Ren and then captures Rey. In his throne room Ren turns Luke's lightsaber on him and cuts him in half, taking the title of Supreme Leader.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox: 'By 12 BBY, Exegol'. The article says his creation 'was done by the year 12 BBY'. That is a latest-possible date, not an exact year.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: 34 ABY, aboard the Supremacy in the Crait system (Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi).

notes.detail: Canon only says Snoke was created 'by 12 BBY', which is the latest possible year, not his actual creation year. Showing -12 as a known fact claims more precision than canon gives. Keep -12 as the position, but flag it as a guess or label it 'by 12 BBY'.

notes.current: Episode VII: The Force Awakens; Episode VIII: The Last Jedi
notes.suggested: Add Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker
notes.detail: Snoke's dormant strandcast bodies are shown in vats in the Exegol laboratory in The Rise of Skywalker, and Palpatine claims credit for creating him. Whether that counts as an appearance is your call.

Canon calls Snoke a genetic strandcast made through the Sith Eternal's cloning experiments, not a clone of a specific person. Identical copies of him exist, so 'Clone: Yes' is defensible, but 'Strandcast' would be more accurate.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cad_Ban.description: Feared as the deadliest bounty hunter of the Clone Wars, Cad Bane was a cold, wide-brimmed gunslinger who would take any job for the right price and made a specialty of beating Jedi. He started out as a street orphan named Colby who was pulled into the gangster Lazlo's crew. After Lazlo was killed, he went after revenge, gunned down a marshal, served time on Torano and later killed his childhood friend Niro. Mentored for a short time by Jango Fett, he built his reputation working for Darth Maul before the Battle of Naboo and became the top hunter in the galaxy after Jango died. For Darth Sidious he stole a holocron from the Jedi Temple, forced Anakin Skywalker to unlock a kyber memory crystal and kidnapped Force-sensitive children. For the Hutts he took the Senate hostage to free Ziro, and later fought Obi-Wan Kenobi and Quinlan Vos to a standstill on Teth. He came through Count Dooku's deadly tournament in the Box and led the plot to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine, but was arrested once Kenobi's cover as Rako Hardeen was blown. He kept working under the Empire and hunted the clone girl Omega, but Fennec Shand and Clone Force 99 took her back from him. In 9 ABY he was an enforcer for the Pyke Syndicate on Tatooine, where his former protégé Boba Fett beat him in a duel and killed him in the streets of Mos Espa.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cad_Ban.socialDesc: Cad Bane, a hat-wearing gunslinger, raided the Jedi Temple, held the Senate hostage in the Clone Wars and died in a duel with Boba Fett on Tatooine.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cad_Ban.timeline:
~62 BBY - Birth on Duro

Born as Colby. He never knew his parents and grew up an orphan on the streets of a crime-ridden city alongside his friend Niro.

Early life - Recruited by Lazlo

After watching Colby and Niro con a droid, the gangster Lazlo takes them on for a raid on a shop's casino. Niro is caught by police, and Colby escapes with Lazlo's gang, who give him his friend's share.

Early life - Becomes Cad Bane

Now calling himself Cad Bane, he is a member of Lazlo's gang and in a relationship with Arin, another gang member.

Early life - Revenge for Lazlo

When a marshal kills Lazlo, Bane takes his hat and hunts the lawman down. He kills the marshal in a showdown, but Arin is wounded, and Niro, now a deputy, has him arrested.

Early life - Prison and the killing of Niro

Bane serves time on Torano and is freed five years early on a technicality. He comes home, discovers that Arin married Niro, kills Niro in a gunfight and leaves town after meeting the boy Isaac.

Before 32 BBY - Mentored by Jango Fett

At the start of his bounty hunting career, Jango Fett mentors Bane for a short time. Bane ends up owing him favors he never repays.

Before 32 BBY - Hired by Darth Maul

On Nar Shaddaa, Bane, Aurra Sing and other hunters help Maul capture the Padawan Eldra Kaitis from Xev Xrexus's auction. They survive a crash on the Moon of Drazkel and the hunters sent after them.

22 BBY - Top of the trade

With Jango Fett dead at Geonosis, Bane is regarded as the best bounty hunter in the galaxy. He works for the Separatists and the Hutts.

~21 BBY - Raid on the Jedi Temple

Darth Sidious hires Bane to steal a holocron from the Jedi Temple's vault. With help from Cato Parasitti and Todo 360, he gets away with it.

~21 BBY - Battle of Devaron

Bane captures Jedi Master Bolla Ropal and his kyber memory crystal, and Ropal dies under torture. Bane then holds Ahsoka Tano hostage to make Anakin Skywalker open the holocron, fakes his own death and escapes.

~21 BBY - Kidnapping Force-sensitive children

For Sidious he abducts Wee Dunn and Zinn Toa. He is caught on Naboo while trying to take Roo-Roo Page, leads the Jedi into a trap at Black Stall Station and escapes.

~21 BBY - Senate hostage crisis

Working for Jabba and the Hutt Council, Bane's crew takes senators hostage in the Senate Building and trades them for Ziro the Hutt's release.

~21 BBY - Hunt for Ziro

Hired again to find Ziro after he escapes, Bane tracks him to Teth and finds him already dead. He fights Obi-Wan Kenobi and Quinlan Vos there and gets away.

~20 BBY - Prison break with Moralo Eval

Bane lets himself be locked up so he can break Moralo Eval out of the Republic's Central Detention Center. With help from Boba Fett and Bossk they escape, taking "Rako Hardeen" with them.

~20 BBY - The Box and the plot against Palpatine

Bane kills Bulduga for his hat on Serenno, survives Count Dooku's tournament in the Box and oversees the plot to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine. The plan fails because Hardeen is Kenobi in disguise, and Bane is arrested.

19 BBY - The hunt for Omega

Now working under the new Empire, Bane is hired by Lama Su to bring back the clone Omega. He catches her, but Fennec Shand and Clone Force 99 take her from him.

9 ABY - Enforcer for the Pykes

Bane works as the Pyke Syndicate's enforcer on Tatooine while they push the spice trade into Mos Espa. He shoots down Cobb Vanth and taunts his old protégé Boba Fett.

9 ABY - Death in Mos Espa

During the fight for Mos Espa, Bane duels Boba Fett in the street. Fett beats him and runs him through with his gaffi stick, killing him.

birth.source: Wookieepedia Cad Bane infobox: born "c. 62 BBY" on Duro. The article gives this as an approximate date (circa), not an exact one.

death.source: Wookieepedia Cad Bane infobox: died 9 ABY, Tatooine. Killed by Boba Fett in Mos Espa in The Book of Boba Fett, "Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor".

notes.detail: Wookieepedia's infobox says the birth year is "c. 62 BBY", so it is approximate, not exact. The year itself is right, but we show it as a firm fact. Consider marking it as circa/approximate, or setting startYearUnknown if the app can't label circa dates.

Cad Bane does not appear in Star Wars Rebels, and the article's biography has no Rebels-era events: it goes straight from the Omega hunt to 9 ABY. His screen appearances are The Clone Wars, The Bad Batch and The Book of Boba Fett, plus the Tales of the Underworld anthology.

The Wookieepedia article covers Bane's origin (the episodes "The Good Life", "A Good Turn" and "One Good Deed": Colby, Niro, Lazlo, Arin) from Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld, and lists it in its update template.
According to Tales of the Underworld, Bane was born Colby and later took the name Cad Bane.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hera_Sy.description: Hera Syndulla was the steady hand at the controls of the Ghost and one of the people who made the Rebel Alliance possible. As a child during the Clone Wars she watched Republic gunships over her home, pulled the astromech Chopper from a crashed Y-wing, and decided she would fly. In the early Imperial years her father Cham's Free Ryloth Movement and her mother Eleni's death left Hera at odds with her father's cause, so she left home to fight the Empire across the galaxy instead. During the Gorse Conflict she met Kanan Jarrus, a Jedi hiding after Order 66, and together they founded the Spectres. Sabine Wren, Garazeb Orrelios and later Ezra Bridger joined the crew. Their insurgency on Lothal brought them into Phoenix Cell, where Hera rose to Phoenix Leader and helped build a base on Atollon until Grand Admiral Thrawn destroyed it. After Kanan died saving her, she helped liberate Lothal and then gave birth to their son, Jacen. As a general she fought at Scarif, Hoth and Endor. In the New Republic she commanded forces that included Alphabet Squadron, fought at Jakku, and later went against her superiors to pursue Thrawn's return.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hera_Sy.socialDesc: Hera Syndulla, ace pilot of the Ghost, built a rebel cell into a pillar of the Rebel Alliance and rose to general, fighting from Lothal to Endor.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hera_Sy.timeline:
29 BBY - Birth on Ryloth

Born to Twi'lek resistance leader Cham Syndulla and his wife Eleni.

~22 BBY - Clone Wars on Ryloth

Hides underground with her mother while Separatist forces occupy Ryloth. Seeing Republic ships overhead makes her want to be a pilot, and she rescues the astromech Chopper from a crashed Y-wing.

~19 BBY - Rescue on Ryloth

Captured by the Empire after a supply run with Gobi Glie. After her parents are arrested, she calls in Clone Force 99 and flies a stolen shuttle, her first solo flight, to help free them.

~14 BBY - Relief mission to Ryloth

Flies the freighter Eclipse past an Imperial blockade to bring gattis-root medicine to her people. Free Ryloth leaders praise her leadership.

~11 BBY - The Gorse Conflict

While tracking Count Vidian in the Gorse system, meets Kanan Jarrus. Together they stop Vidian's plan to destroy the moon Cynda, and Kanan joins her aboard the Ghost.

~11 BBY to 5 BBY - Forming the Spectres

Builds a rebel cell with Kanan, Chopper, Garazeb Orrelios and Sabine Wren, working as an agent in Fulcrum's network and with Bail Organa.

5 BBY - Ezra Bridger joins the crew

Meets Ezra Bridger on Lothal. The Spectres rescue Wookiee slaves from Kessel, destroy T-7 disruptors, and free Kanan from Grand Moff Tarkin.

4 BBY - Joining Phoenix Cell

Brings the Spectres into Phoenix Cell and later becomes Phoenix Leader. Reconciles with her father during a mission on Ryloth.

3 BBY - Chopper Base on Atollon

Helps set up the rebel base on Atollon while Grand Admiral Thrawn hunts the rebels.

2 BBY - Battle of Atollon

Thrawn finds and attacks the base. Hera helps lead the survivors' escape, and her cell becomes part of the newly formed Rebel Alliance.

1 BBY - Attack on Lothal and Kanan's death

Leads a failed strike on Lothal's Imperial Armory Complex and is captured. Kanan dies saving her during the Spectres' rescue.

1 BBY - Liberation of Lothal

Helps free Lothal from the Empire. Ezra vanishes with Thrawn during the battle.

1 BBY - Battle of Scarif

Takes part in the Alliance's attack on Scarif as General Syndulla, flying the Ghost.

~0 ABY - Birth of Jacen Syndulla

Gives birth to Jacen, her son with Kanan.

3 ABY - Mako-Ta and Hoth

Serves at the Battle of Mako-Ta and during the Alliance's time on Hoth.

4 ABY - Battle of Endor

Fights at Endor, the battle in which Emperor Palpatine dies.

~4 ABY - 5 ABY - Barma Battle Group

As a New Republic general, commands the Barma Battle Group, including Alphabet Squadron, against the remnants of the Empire.

5 ABY - Battle of Jakku

Takes part in the Empire's final defeat at Jakku.

~9 ABY - Hunt for Thrawn

Commands New Republic forces, looks into signs of Thrawn's return, and takes the Ghost to Seatos without authorization to back Ahsoka Tano. She faces a hearing before the Senate for it.

~9 ABY - Battle of Lothal's Remnant

Fights the Imperial forces tied to Thrawn over Lothal and welcomes Ezra Bridger home.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox, Hera Syndulla: birth = 29 BBY. This matches her being about 10 during the 19 BBY Bad Batch episode 'Rescue on Ryloth'.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox has no death date. She is alive in canon as of the Ahsoka era (~9 ABY).

notes.suggested: Add family facts: parents Cham and Eleni Syndulla, partner Kanan Jarrus, son Jacen Syndulla
notes.detail: The Wookieepedia infobox lists these relationships. They connect to other characters on the timeline, and Jacen appears in the Ahsoka series.
She is called General Syndulla from Rogue One onward and holds high command in the New Republic in Ahsoka and the Alphabet Squadron novels.

notes.current: The Bad Batch, Star Wars Rebels, Ahsoka
notes.detail: In Rogue One she is only paged by name as 'General Syndulla', with the Ghost and Chopper seen in the background. Hera herself is never on screen, so leaving Rogue One out of seenIn is defensible. Her Scarif role could still be shown as a timeline event.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mitth'r.description: Grand Admiral Thrawn is the Empire's most feared strategist, a commander who beat his enemies by studying their art and culture until he could predict how they would act. He was born into the small, poor Kivu family, and his talent got him adopted into the powerful Mitth family as a merit adoptive. At the Taharim Academy he was accused of cheating after posting a record score on a combat simulation, then cleared himself by repeating the tactic in a live exercise. He rose through the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet, hunting pirates and fighting the Vagaari, a campaign that cost him his adoptive brother Thrass. Near the end of the Clone Wars he fought alongside Anakin Skywalker at Mokivj. He then broke the Nikardun Destiny at Primea, defused a Grysk-backed plot to start a Chiss civil war, and led an alliance of neighboring nations to victory at Sunrise. That victory made him too controversial to keep, so he went into exile in the service of both the Ascendancy and the Empire. With cadet Eli Vanto as his translator and protégé, he graduated from the Royal Imperial Academy in three months and climbed to Grand Admiral in command of the Seventh Fleet. From his flagship Chimaera he hunted the Lothal rebels, crushed them at Atollon, and worked with Darth Vader against the Grysks. During the liberation of Lothal, purrgil dragged the Chimaera through hyperspace, and he was stranded on the distant world of Peridea alongside Ezra Bridger. Years later his protégée Morgan Elsbeth and the Great Mothers brought him back, and he returned to the galaxy to plan a revival of Imperial power.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mitth'r.socialDesc: Thrawn, the Chiss tactician who studied enemies through their art, rose to Imperial Grand Admiral, vanished at Lothal and escaped Peridea in 9 ABY.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mitth'r.timeline:
~59 BBY - Birth on Rentor

Born Kivu'raw'nuru, core name Vurawn, into the small and poor Kivu family.

~56 BBY - Loss of His Sister

His older sister Vurika is taken to serve as a sky-walker navigator. Only three years old, he believes she has died.

~39 BBY - Adopted into the Mitth Family

Thurfian interviews him, and Patriarch Thooraki quietly arranges his immediate adoption as a merit adoptive. He becomes Mitth'raw'nuru, "Thrawn." On his first spaceflight, to the Taharim Academy on Naporar, he meets Al'iastov, and at his rematching dinner on Avidich he meets Thrass.

~39 BBY - Cheating Accusation at Taharim

Accused of cheating on a combat simulation after a record score, he proves his innocence in a live exercise arranged by General Ba'kif at the urging of Senior Cadet Ziara (Ar'alani).

~37 BBY - Commissioned as Lieutenant

Graduates from the Taharim Academy. Thrass declares his friendship, which secretly settles a Stybla offer to rematch him into their family.

Before 19 BBY - Pirate Hunts and the Vagaari

As a Junior Commander and later senior officer, he fights pirates on the Ascendancy's frontier and leads operations against the Vagaari, during which Thrass is killed.

~19 BBY - Mission to Mokivj

Travels into known space looking for allies against the Nikardun and fights alongside Jedi Anakin Skywalker at Mokivj during the Clone Wars.

~19 BBY - Battle over Primea

Defeats General Yiv's fleet, bringing about the collapse of the Nikardun Destiny.

~18 BBY - Hoxim Incident

Defuses the Agbui scheme, backed by the Grysk agent Jixtus, to set three Chiss families against each other in civil war.

~18 BBY - Last Stand at Sunrise

Unites several allied nations to defeat Jixtus's Grysk fleet above Sunrise.

~18 BBY - Exile

Under political pressure over his methods, he is exiled with Supreme General Ba'kif's quiet blessing, so that he can study the Galactic Empire as a possible ally against the Grysks.

~14 BBY - Discovered by the Empire

Captain Voss Parck of the Strikefast finds him in Wild Space. He is presented to Emperor Palpatine and pledges his service.

~14 BBY - Royal Imperial Academy

With cadet Eli Vanto as his translator and aide, he learns Basic and graduates from the Coruscant academy in three months.

2 BBY - Promoted to Grand Admiral

Defeats the insurgent Nightswan at Batonn, is promoted to Grand Admiral by the Emperor, and sends Eli Vanto to the Chiss Ascendancy.

2 BBY - Lothal Campaign Begins

Takes command of the Seventh Fleet from the Chimaera at Governor Pryce's request to destroy the Lothal rebels, and champions the TIE Defender program.

1 BBY - Battle of Atollon

Finds and crushes Phoenix Cell's base on Atollon, though Chopper Base's survivors escape.

1 BBY - Mission with Darth Vader

Sent by the Emperor with Vader to Batuu. At Mokivj they defeat the Grysks and rescue captive Chiss children.

1 BBY - Project Stardust Supply Lines

Exposes Grand Admiral Savit's treason and defeats a Grysk force threatening Death Star supply lines.

~0 BBY - Liberation of Lothal

During the rebels' final assault, purrgil wrap around the Chimaera and jump it into hyperspace, stranding Thrawn and Ezra Bridger far beyond the galaxy.

0 BBY–9 ABY - Stranded on Peridea

Remains stranded on Peridea while the Empire falls. Remnant loyalists rely on his knowledge of the Unknown Regions.

9 ABY - Return from Peridea

With help from Morgan Elsbeth and the Great Mothers, escapes Peridea aboard the Chimaera, leaving Ahsoka Tano and Sabine Wren behind, and sets course for Dathomir.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and Biography: "c. 59 BBY, Rentor" (Chiss Ascendancy trilogy dating). The year is stated only as circa.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox leaves death blank. Thrawn is alive as of 9 ABY (Ahsoka), when he escapes Peridea and returns to the galaxy.

notes.detail: There is a stray space in the name. The canon spelling has no space (Wookieepedia article title and lead).
Wookieepedia gives the birth as "c. 59 BBY", which is approximate. -59 is the right value, but think about whether the UI should show it as circa rather than exact.
Canon (Chaos Rising / Lesser Evil) establishes his birth name and later names: Kivu'raw'nuru, then Mitth'raw'nuru, then Mitth'raw'nuruodo. These may be worth showing.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Reva_Se.description: Reva Sevander, known as the Third Sister, survived the massacre at the Jedi Temple and turned Darth Vader's own Inquisitorius into her means of revenge. She trained as a Jedi initiate under Yoda. During Order 66 she watched Anakin Skywalker cut down her clanmates, whom she thought had come to be saved by him. He stabbed her, and she lived by playing dead among their bodies. Years later she joined the Inquisitors, and she was ruthless and reckless enough to anger both the Grand Inquisitor and the Fifth Brother. Her plan was to deliver Obi-Wan Kenobi to Vader and strike while the Sith Lord was distracted. In 9 BBY she lured Kenobi out of hiding by arranging the kidnapping of young Leia Organa. She stabbed the Grand Inquisitor on Daiyu, captured Leia again on Mapuzo, and tracked the Hidden Path to Jabiim, which earned her the title of Grand Inquisitor. Her attempt on Vader's life there failed badly. He ran her through, stripped her of rank and left her for dead. She then learned about Luke Skywalker from a message meant for Kenobi and went to Tatooine to kill the boy. At the last moment she saw that she was becoming the man she hated.
