She returned Luke to his family, laid down her lightsaber on Kenobi's advice and walked away into an unknown future.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Reva_Se.socialDesc: Reva Sevander, the Third Sister, survived Order 66 as a youngling, hunted Jedi to get near Darth Vader, then chose to spare young Luke Skywalker.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Reva_Se.timeline:
~31 BBY - Birth

Reva Sevander is born. She is Force-sensitive and is taken into the Jedi Order as a child.

~22 BBY - Jedi Initiate

Reva trains as an initiate in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, taught by Yoda, and comes to see her clan of younglings as her family.

19 BBY - Survives Order 66

During Operation: Knightfall, Master Minas Velti leads Reva's clan away from the clone troopers until she is killed. Anakin Skywalker, now Darth Vader, slaughters the younglings and stabs Reva. She survives by hiding among the bodies and later needs cybernetic repairs.

~19 BBY - Turns to the Dark Side

Reva escapes the Temple, consumed by survivor's guilt and a thirst for revenge. She joins the Inquisitorius as the Third Sister so she can get close to Vader.

~19–9 BBY - Hunting Jedi

As an Inquisitor she hunts Jedi and Force-sensitives on worlds including Pantora, Valo, Cerea, Boz Pity and Alsakan, while fixating on finding Obi-Wan Kenobi.

9 BBY - Hunt for Nari on Tatooine

Reva goes to Tatooine with the Grand Inquisitor and the Fifth Brother. In Anchorhead she maims a local and threatens Owen Lars and his family to find Kenobi, and her fellow Inquisitors rein her in.

9 BBY - Kidnapping of Leia Organa

Defying her superiors, she hires bounty hunters to abduct Princess Leia Organa and bring her to Daiyu as bait for Kenobi.

9 BBY - Betrayal on Daiyu

Reva corners Kenobi and tells him Anakin is alive. When the Grand Inquisitor tries to take over, she stabs him and leaves him for dead, and Kenobi escapes with Leia. Vader promises her the Grand Inquisitor's post if she catches Kenobi.

9 BBY - Battle on Mapuzo

She finds a Hidden Path safehouse and its escape tunnel, kills the waiting pilot and recaptures Leia.

9 BBY - Fortress Inquisitorius

Kenobi and Tala Durith rescue Leia from the fortress on Nur. Vader chokes Reva for her failure, but spares her when she reveals she planted a tracker in Leia's droid, L0-LA59.

9 BBY - Named Grand Inquisitor

The tracker leads the Empire to the Hidden Path's base on Jabiim, and Vader promotes Reva to Grand Inquisitor aboard the Devastator.

9 BBY - Attack on Jabiim

Reva leads the siege. Kenobi realizes she survived the Temple massacre and wants revenge. When she tries to kill Vader, he defeats her, runs her through and strips her of rank, and the surviving Grand Inquisitor is at his side. Lying wounded, she plays a message from Bail Organa that reveals Luke Skywalker's existence.

9 BBY - Hunt for Luke Skywalker

Reva attacks the Lars homestead on Tatooine and chases Luke into Beggar's Canyon. On the point of killing him, she sees herself becoming Vader and spares him.

9 BBY - A New Path

She carries Luke back to Owen and Beru. Kenobi tells her she has not failed and is free to choose her own path, and she lays down her lightsaber and leaves to start a new life.

1 BBY - Fate Unknown

The Inquisitorius is gone by the time of the Battle of Scarif. What became of Reva is never revealed.

birth.source: Wookieepedia, Reva Sevander: the infobox and biography give her birth as 'c. 31 BBY'. The year is approximate in canon, consistent with her being a youngling at Order 66 in 19 BBY.

death.source: Wookieepedia, Reva Sevander: no death date is given. She survives Obi-Wan Kenobi Part VI, and the Legacy section says her fate remained a mystery.

notes.current: true (31 BBY flagged as a guess)
notes.detail: Wookieepedia gives 'c. 31 BBY' as her birth year, so -31 is a sourced approximation rather than our own guess. You can keep the flag because canon hedges with 'c.', but -31 comes from a source and should not be changed without a reason.
Her full canon name is Reva Sevander, and the Wookieepedia article title is Reva_Sevander.

notes.suggested: Add a note that she briefly held the rank of Grand Inquisitor
notes.detail: Vader promoted her to Grand Inquisitor in Obi-Wan Kenobi Part V and stripped her of the rank after her failed attempt on his life. This could go in the metadata or in altTitle.

notes.suggested: Masters: Yoda; Darth Vader; the Grand Inquisitor
notes.detail: The Wookieepedia infobox lists Yoda, who taught her as an initiate, Vader as her dark side master, and the Grand Inquisitor.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rey_Sky.description: Rey rose from a lonely scavenger's life in the Starship Graveyard to become the Jedi who ended Palpatine's return. Left behind as a child by parents who died protecting her from the Sith, she grew up salvaging wrecks for Unkar Plutt and waiting for a family that never came back. That changed in 34 ABY, when she rescued the droid BB-8 and fled aboard the Millennium Falcon with the defector Finn. She joined Han Solo and Chewbacca, awakened to the Force, and beat Kylo Ren in a duel on Starkiller Base. She then found Luke Skywalker on Ahch-To and pushed the reluctant exile to train her. Through a Force bond with Ben Solo she learned the two of them were a dyad. She killed Snoke alongside him, but after he refused to turn back to the light, she helped the last of the Resistance escape Crait and carried on her training under Leia Organa. A year later she learned she was Palpatine's granddaughter. On Exegol, with Ben's help and the voices of past Jedi, she destroyed the Emperor but died in the effort, and Ben gave his own life to revive her. Afterward she buried the lightsabers of Luke and Leia on Tatooine and took the Skywalker name as her own.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rey_Sky.socialDesc: Rey Skywalker, a Jakku scavenger turned Jedi, rose to defeat her grandfather Palpatine on Exegol and claimed the Skywalker name to honor her mentors.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rey_Sky.timeline:
1 BBY - A Voice Across Time

Years before she is born, Ezra Bridger hears Rey's voice in the World Between Worlds.

15 ABY - Birth on Hyperkarn

Born to Dathan, a Strand-Cast clone of Darth Sidious, and his wife Miramir. Her parents go into hiding as junk traders to keep her from the Emperor's agents.

~21 ABY - Left on Jakku

Her parents leave her with Unkar Plutt at Niima Outpost. Ochi, the Sith assassin, catches and kills them. Rey grows up alone, still waiting for them to return.

~21 ABY - The Scavenger of Niima Outpost

Rey salvages parts from the Starship Graveyard in exchange for food rations and makes her home inside the fallen AT-AT Hellhound Two.

~25 ABY - The Rebel Pilot's Helmet

At about ten, she finds Dosmit Ræh's Rebel flight helmet and makes up stories about the pilot's adventures. She also teaches herself to fly on a salvaged simulator.

28 ABY - A Chill in the Force

Rey feels a cold sensation as Ben Solo falls to the dark side, without understanding what it is.

28–34 ABY - Life on Jakku

She repairs a Ghtroc 690 freighter, only for Devi and Strunk to steal it. She also rescues Unkar Plutt from Zool Zendiat's gang and keeps working as Niima Outpost's best scavenger.

34 ABY - Meeting BB-8 and Finn

She rescues BB-8 from Teedo and turns down Plutt's offer to buy the droid. With Finn, she escapes the First Order aboard the Millennium Falcon.

34 ABY - Han Solo and Chewbacca

Han Solo and Chewbacca take in the fugitives. Rey helps them get free of the Guavian Death Gang and Kanjiklub, and Han offers her a job on the Falcon.

34 ABY - Maz Kanata's Castle

On Takodana, Luke Skywalker's old lightsaber calls to Rey and gives her a Force vision. Kylo Ren captures her during the First Order attack.

34 ABY - Starkiller Base

She resists Kylo Ren's mind probe, uses a Jedi mind trick to escape, and sees Han die. She then defeats Kylo Ren in a lightsaber duel as the base collapses.

34 ABY - Finding Luke Skywalker

Using the completed map, Rey flies with Chewbacca and R2-D2 to Ahch-To and offers Luke his lightsaber.

34 ABY - Training on Ahch-To

Luke reluctantly teaches her about the Force. A Force bond forms between Rey and Kylo Ren, and she is drawn into the dark side cave.

34 ABY - Snoke's Throne Room

Rey goes to the Supremacy to turn Ben Solo back to the light. They kill Snoke and his Praetorian Guards together, but Ben will not come with her, and Luke's lightsaber is broken in two.

34 ABY - Battle of Crait

Rey clears the rocks blocking the survivors' escape and saves the last of the Resistance. She takes the Jedi texts with her.

34–35 ABY - Apprentice to Leia

Leia Organa trains Rey as a Jedi while the Resistance rebuilds.

35 ABY - Search for Exegol

When Palpatine returns, Rey follows Ochi's trail to Pasaana, Kijimi, and Kef Bir. There she learns she is Palpatine's granddaughter and nearly kills Kylo Ren before healing him.

35 ABY - Exile on Ahch-To

Afraid of her heritage, Rey tries to exile herself. Luke's spirit convinces her to face Palpatine, and she takes Luke's X-wing to Exegol.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

Rey and a redeemed Ben Solo face Palpatine together. With strength from past Jedi, she turns his lightning back on him and destroys him, dying in the process.

35 ABY - Resurrection

Ben Solo gives his life force to revive Rey. They kiss before he becomes one with the Force.

35 ABY - Rey Skywalker

On Tatooine, Rey buries Luke's and Leia's lightsabers at the Lars homestead, shows her own yellow-bladed saber, and takes the name Skywalker.

After 35 ABY - Jedi Master

At some later point, Rey becomes a Jedi Master.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and biography: born 15 ABY on Hyperkarn.

death.source: Wookieepedia lists death 35 ABY on Exegol but only briefly: Ben Solo resurrected her there, and she later became a Jedi Master. She is alive at the end of current canon.

notes.suggested: Note Rey's brief death and resurrection on Exegol in 35 ABY (Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker)
notes.detail: Wookieepedia's infobox gives death as '35 ABY, Exegol (briefly, resurrected)'. Keeping endYearUnknown: true is correct because she survives, but an event marker for her death and revival could be worth adding.
Wookieepedia gives Jakku as her homeworld (which matches ours) but Hyperkarn as her birthplace (15 ABY). This was established in The Rise of Skywalker reference material and Shadow of the Sith.
For most of her story she goes by just 'Rey'. She only takes the name Skywalker at the end of The Rise of Skywalker.

notes.suggested: Consider adding Star Wars Rebels (voice cameo, 'A World Between Worlds')
notes.detail: Wookieepedia notes that Ezra Bridger hears Rey's voice in the World Between Worlds in 1 BBY. It is only an audio cameo, so including it is up to the maintainer.

Wookieepedia doesn't give a birth year in its lead summary for when she was left on Jakku. The infobox doesn't list one either. Shadow of the Sith is placed around 21 ABY, which is why the timeline dates her abandonment ~21 ABY as an estimate.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Kaydel_.description: Kaydel Ko Connix is best known as one of the steady voices in the Resistance command center, relaying orders between Leia Organa's staff and the pilots in the thick of the First Order–Resistance War. She served as an operations controller in Fleet Command at the D'Qar base. After coordinating communications during the attack on Starkiller Base, she was promoted to lieutenant. Her first job at that rank was running the evacuation of D'Qar, and she got off the planet on one of the last shuttles before the Dreadnought Fulminatrix destroyed the base. During the Resistance fleet's flight, she helped Poe Dameron hide Finn and Rose Tico's secret departure and then joined his mutiny against Vice Admiral Holdo, until Leia stunned Poe and Connix surrendered. She survived the near destruction of the Resistance on Crait and escaped with the last survivors aboard the Millennium Falcon. Leia forgave her and let her keep her rank. Connix went on to help build the new base on Ajan Kloss. At the Battle of Exegol she joined the boarding team that struck the Star Destroyer Steadfast's navigation tower, where she was wounded in the leg, and she lived to celebrate the First Order's defeat.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Kaydel_.socialDesc: Kaydel Ko Connix, Resistance lieutenant who ran fleet comms at Starkiller Base, joined Poe Dameron's mutiny against Holdo, and fought at Exegol.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Kaydel_.timeline:
~13 ABY - Birth on Dulathia

Kaydel Ko Connix is born on Dulathia during the New Republic era.

~28–34 ABY - Joins the Resistance

She joins the naval branch of Leia Organa's Resistance and is assigned to Fleet Command at the D'Qar base.

34 ABY - Operations controller on D'Qar

She serves as an operations controller directly under General Organa as tensions with the First Order boil over.

34 ABY - Battle of Starkiller Base

From the D'Qar command center, she coordinates communications between the Resistance pilots and their commanders during the attack that destroys Starkiller Base.

34 ABY - Promotion to lieutenant

She is promoted to lieutenant for her service during the Starkiller crisis.

34 ABY - Evacuation of D'Qar

She oversees the evacuation of the base, putting supplies first and organizing the retreat. She escapes on one of the last shuttles before the Dreadnought Fulminatrix destroys the base.

34 ABY - Covering the Canto Bight mission

Aboard the Raddus, she helps Poe Dameron keep Finn and Rose Tico's unauthorized departure hidden from Vice Admiral Holdo.

34 ABY - Mutiny against Holdo

She joins Dameron's mutiny and helps seize the Raddus's bridge. Leia Organa stuns Dameron, and Connix surrenders.

34 ABY - Battle of Crait

She fights with the Resistance at the old Rebel outpost on Crait and escapes with the few survivors aboard the Millennium Falcon.

34–35 ABY - Regaining Leia's trust

Leia forgives her and she keeps her rank. At the Resistance camp on Anoat, she reports the destruction of Tah'Nuhna and later warns General Jonato that a First Order armada is heading for Mon Cala.

35 ABY - Building the Ajan Kloss base

She helps Rose Tico and Beaumont Kin set up the Resistance's new jungle base on Ajan Kloss.

35 ABY - Battle of Exegol

She joins Tico and Kin in the assault on the Steadfast's navigation tower. She is wounded in the leg, and Kin helps her back to the Fortitude.

35 ABY - Victory celebration

She celebrates the First Order's defeat with Tico and Kin at the Ajan Kloss base.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox and biography give 'c. 13 ABY' / 'Born around 13 ABY'. This is an approximate reference-book date, not an exact one.

death.source: No death recorded. Canon shows her alive after the Battle of Exegol in 35 ABY.

notes.suggested: true, or label as circa 13 ABY
notes.detail: Wookieepedia gives her birth as 'c. 13 ABY' ('Born around 13 ABY'), so the year is approximate. The app currently presents it as fact. The year itself is the best available figure; the issue is only how precise we claim it to be.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Carson_.description: Carson Teva is the New Republic X-wing captain who saw the Imperial resurgence coming while his superiors on Coruscant refused to believe it. He fought for the Rebel Alliance as early as the destruction of Alderaan, serving alongside the astromech R5-D4. After the war he became a captain in the Adelphi Rangers, patrolling the Outer Rim with too few ships to cover it. In 9 ABY he and Trapper Wolf chased Din Djarin's Razor Crest onto Maldo Kreis. When they found out the Mandalorian had helped New Republic officers aboard the Bothan-5, they rescued him from ice spiders and let him go. Teva later looked into the destroyed Imperial base on Nevarro, where he tried to recruit Cara Dune, and he let Djarin off with a warning above Tatooine. When pirates took Nevarro, he flew to Coruscant to ask for help and was turned away by Colonel Tuttle and Amnesty officer Elia Kane. He then took Greef Karga's plea to the Mandalorian covert himself, which led to the planet's liberation. He also found the wrecked prison shuttle that proved Moff Gideon never reached trial, and he agreed to hire Djarin as an unofficial contractor. Later he flew with Hera Syndulla on her unauthorized mission to Seatos, stood up for her at the hearing that followed, and helped rescue Djarin, Grogu and Rotta from Nal Hutta.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Carson_.socialDesc: Carson Teva is a Rebellion veteran turned New Republic X-wing captain who kept warning Coruscant the Empire was regrouping while few would listen.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Carson_.timeline:
Unknown - Birth on Torolis

Carson Teva is born on Torolis. Canon gives no birth year.

1 BBY - Rebel Service at Alderaan

Teva is already serving in the Rebel Alliance when the Death Star destroys Alderaan. During his time with the Rebellion he serves alongside the astromech R5-D4.

~5 ABY - Joins the New Republic Starfighter Corps

After the Empire falls, Teva stays on with the New Republic. He becomes a captain flying a T-65B X-wing with the Adelphi Rangers out of Adelphi Base.

9 ABY - Pursuit of the Razor Crest

On Spinward patrol with Trapper Wolf, Teva stops the Razor Crest because its transponder is off. When the pilots tie it to the Bothan-5 breakout, Din Djarin flees and they chase him into the canyons of Maldo Kreis.

9 ABY - Rescue on Maldo Kreis

The Bothan-5 records show that Djarin helped the New Republic officers. Teva and Wolf save him from a swarm of ice spiders and let him go, telling him to fix his transponder.

9 ABY - Investigation on Nevarro

Teva questions Greef Karga about the destroyed Imperial base and the Razor Crest. He offers Cara Dune a place in the New Republic, and when she turns him down he leaves her a rank plaque.

~9 ABY - Warning Above Tatooine

Teva and Lieutenant Reed pull over Djarin's N-1 starfighter. Teva recognizes the Mandalorian's voice and lets him off with a warning. Djarin escapes before Teva can ask about Nevarro.

~9 ABY - Plea to Coruscant

Greef Karga sends word that Gorian Shard's pirates have taken Nevarro. Teva flies to Coruscant to ask for help, but Colonel Tuttle and Amnesty officer Elia Kane turn him down.

~9 ABY - Recruiting the Mandalorians

Teva follows R5-D4's signal to the Mandalorian covert and gives Djarin Karga's message. The Mandalorians go on to free Nevarro from the pirates.

~9 ABY - Gideon's Wrecked Transport

Teva finds the breached prison shuttle that was carrying Moff Gideon. The dead guards and a fragment of beskar suggest Gideon was broken out before he could reach trial.

~9 ABY - Djarin Signs On

After Mandalore is liberated, Teva agrees to take on Din Djarin as an unofficial New Republic contractor. As an advance payment, he supplies parts to rebuild IG-11.

~11 ABY - Mission to Seatos

Teva leads fighters escorting Hera Syndulla's Ghost on her unauthorized mission. He survives the shockwave when the Eye of Sion jumps to hyperspace, and he helps search for Ahsoka Tano and pull her from the sea.

~11 ABY - Stalling the Fleet

Teva holds off Captain Girard's fleet while Syndulla and Tano leave to follow the purrgil. Then he watches the purrgil jump away.

~11 ABY - Syndulla's Hearing

At Hera Syndulla's hearing on Coruscant, Teva challenges Senator Hamato Xiono's claim that the Imperial remnants pose no threat. Leia Organa's authorization ends the proceedings.

~9-12 ABY - Rescue on Nal Hutta

Teva flies with the Adelphi Rangers under Colonel Ward to rescue Din Djarin, Grogu and Rotta from Nal Hutta. The Rangers fight off Starhoppers and destroy the Hutt hideout.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Din_Dja.description: Known across the Outer Rim simply as "the Mandalorian," Din Djarin was a feared bounty hunter who threw away his livelihood to save the child he had been hired to capture. Orphaned as a boy when Separatist droids destroyed his village during the Clone Wars, he was carried off by a Death Watch warrior and raised as a foundling on Concordia. He took the creed of the Children of the Watch and swore never to remove his helmet in front of another living being. In the years after the Empire fell he became one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild's best hunters, working out of Nevarro in his gunship, the Razor Crest. In 9 ABY an Imperial remnant hired him to retrieve a mysterious asset. It turned out to be Grogu, a Force-sensitive infant of Yoda's species, and Djarin rescued him from his Imperial clients instead of handing him over. That turned the Guild and Moff Gideon against him. With allies like Greef Karga, Cara Dune, Kuiil and IG-11 he fought his way free. The Armorer then named him and Grogu a clan of two and charged him with finding the child's own kind. That search brought him to Bo-Katan Kryze, Ahsoka Tano and Boba Fett. It ended with Djarin beating Gideon, taking the Darksaber, and taking off his helmet to say goodbye as Luke Skywalker took Grogu away. The Armorer cast him out as an apostate. He fought beside Boba Fett at Mos Espa and got Grogu back. He then bathed in the Living Waters beneath Mandalore to redeem himself, and helped Bo-Katan unite the Mandalorians and retake their homeworld, where Gideon was killed. After that he formally adopted Grogu as his son and apprentice and settled on Nevarro, taking contracts from the New Republic to hunt down Imperial warlords. Those jobs later pitted him against the warlord Barro, the Hutt Twins and the Imperial commander Janu Coin.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Din_Dja.socialDesc: Din Djarin, the helmeted bounty hunter who defied an Imperial client to protect Grogu, adopted him as his son and helped free Mandalore from Moff Gideon.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Din_Dja.timeline:
~30 BBY - Birth on Aq Vetina

Din Djarin is born on Aq Vetina, late in the life of the Galactic Republic. Canon only says he was born before 19 BBY.

~20 BBY - Orphaned in the Clone Wars

Separatist battle droids attack his village. His parents hide him in a hatch and are then killed. A super battle droid finds him, but a Death Watch warrior destroys it and flies the boy to safety.

~20 BBY - Raised as a Foundling

The Mandalorians take him in as a foundling. He grows up on Concordia, trains in the Fighting Corps and becomes part of Death Watch.

Before 9 ABY - Joining the Tribe

After the Great Purge of Mandalore he joins the Tribe, a Children of the Watch covert hidden on Nevarro. He receives his armor and swears never to show his face to anyone.

Before 9 ABY - Mercenary Work with Ranzar Malk

He works alongside Ranzar Malk and the Twi'lek siblings Xi'an and Qin, and has a relationship with Xi'an. The crew falls apart after Qin is captured.

Before 9 ABY - Guild Bounty Hunter

Flying the Razor Crest, he becomes one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild's top hunters, taking pucks from Greef Karga on Nevarro.

9 ABY - The Mythrol Bounty

He tracks down a Mythrol fugitive on the ice world Pagodon, freezes him in carbonite and collects the payment on Nevarro.

9 ABY - The Client's Commission

An Imperial remnant officer known as the Client hires him to bring in an unnamed asset, paying a beskar ingot up front. The Armorer forges it into a pauldron.

9 ABY - Finding the Child on Arvala-7

With help from the Ugnaught Kuiil and the droid IG-11, he storms a Nikto camp and finds the asset: an infant of Yoda's species. He shoots IG-11 to keep it from killing the child.

9 ABY - The Mudhorn

To buy back his ship's parts from the Jawas, he fights a mudhorn for its egg. The child saves him by lifting the beast with the Force.

9 ABY - Rescuing the Child

He hands the child over for a camtono of beskar and a full armor set, then turns around, raids the Imperial compound and takes the child back. The Tribe comes out of hiding to cover his escape from the Guild.

9 ABY - Sorgan

While lying low on Sorgan, he and Cara Dune train villagers who then destroy a raider gang's AT-ST.

9 ABY - The Prison Ship Job

He joins Ranzar Malk's crew to free Qin from a New Republic prison ship. When the crew betrays him, he leaves them locked in cells.

9 ABY - Battle of Nevarro

Karga lays a trap, and he fights Moff Gideon's forces alongside Karga, Dune, Kuiil and a reprogrammed IG-11. Kuiil and IG-11 are killed. The Armorer names him and the child a clan of two, Clan Mudhorn, and tells him to find the child's own kind.

9 ABY - Tatooine and the Krayt Dragon

He meets Marshal Cobb Vanth in Mos Pelgo, and together with the Tusken Raiders they kill a krayt dragon. Vanth gives him Boba Fett's armor in return.

9 ABY - Meeting Bo-Katan Kryze

While escorting the Frog Lady to Trask, he meets Bo-Katan Kryze and learns the Children of the Watch are a fringe sect. He helps her raid an Imperial freighter, and she tells him to look for Ahsoka Tano on Corvus.

9 ABY - Ahsoka Tano on Corvus

He helps Ahsoka free Calodan from Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth. Ahsoka learns the child's name is Grogu, but she refuses to train him.

9 ABY - Grogu Taken on Tython

At the seeing stone on Tython he meets Boba Fett and Fennec Shand. Dark troopers kidnap Grogu, and Gideon's forces destroy the Razor Crest.

9 ABY - Morak

With Migs Mayfeld, he infiltrates an Imperial refinery to get Gideon's coordinates, taking off his helmet to pass a facial scan.

9 ABY - Rescue of Grogu

He boards Gideon's light cruiser with Bo-Katan, Koska Reeves, Dune and Fennec. He defeats Gideon and wins the Darksaber. Luke Skywalker arrives, and Djarin takes off his helmet to say goodbye before Grogu leaves with him.

9 ABY - Declared an Apostate

Back with the surviving covert, he admits he removed his helmet, and the Armorer casts him out. He replaces the Razor Crest with a modified N-1 starfighter.

9 ABY - Battle of Mos Espa

He fights for Boba Fett against the Pyke Syndicate on Tatooine. Grogu, choosing him over Jedi training, joins him there.

9 ABY - Bathing in the Living Waters

He goes into the mines of Mandalore and bathes in the Living Waters, which restores his standing with the Armorer. Bo-Katan saves him, and she gains the Darksaber when she defeats the creature that had disarmed him.

9 ABY - Plazir-15 and the Pirate Attack

He fights alongside the Armorer's covert to repel Gorian Shard's pirates from Nevarro and serves the Duchess of Plazir-15.

9 ABY - Liberation of Mandalore

With Bo-Katan and the reunited Mandalorians, he retakes Mandalore from the Imperial Remnant, and Moff Gideon is killed.

9 ABY - Din Grogu

He formally adopts Grogu as his son and apprentice, and they settle in a cabin on Nevarro. He takes work as an independent contractor for the New Republic.

After 9 ABY - Hunting Barro

Years later, working with Garazeb Orrelios, he hunts the Imperial warlord Barro on Phostera and kills him. The New Republic rewards him with a new Razor Crest.

After 9 ABY - Mission to Shakari

Colonel Ward sends him after Rotta the Hutt, who has become a gladiator on Shakari. There he discovers that crime lord Janu is really Imperial Commander Coin and captures him with Zeb's help.

After 9 ABY - Battle of Nal Hutta

Embo captures him and hands him to the Hutt Twins. Grogu and Minch free him, and he leads the assault on the Hutt palace to rescue Rotta while New Republic forces attack from orbit. Afterward he and Grogu fly off again in the new Razor Crest.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Plo_Koo.description: Plo Koon was a Jedi Council master and one of the Republic's best starfighter pilots during the Clone Wars. He was known above all for how much he cared about the clone troopers under his command. As a young master he found a three-year-old Ahsoka Tano on Shili and brought her to the Jedi Temple, and he stayed a protective mentor to her for the rest of his life. He trained Bultar Swan to knighthood and sat on the Council that met Anakin Skywalker. He fought in the arena at Geonosis and survived, then took command of the 104th "Wolfpack" Battalion alongside Commander Wolffe. After his fleet was wiped out by the Malevolence's ion cannon, he flew escort for the attack that crippled the warship. He also escorted the evacuation of Felucia, hunted down a young Boba Fett, led the fleet that pulled the strike team out of the Citadel, and helped retake Felucia. He was part of the Council that expelled Ahsoka after the Temple bombing and later invited her to return. In the last days of the war he won the Battle of Cato Neimoidia. When Order 66 was issued, his own ARC-170 escort shot his fighter down over the planet's bridge cities, and he died in the crash.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Plo_Koo.socialDesc: Plo Koon was the Jedi Council master and ace pilot who led the Wolfpack in the Clone Wars, found Ahsoka Tano, and was shot down by his own clones.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Plo_Koo.timeline:
Unknown - Birth on Dorin

Born on the Kel Dor homeworld. Canon gives no year. He was later taken into the Jedi Order and became the Padawan of Master Tyvokka.

34 BBY - Rescue on Oosalon

Arrives on Oosalon with Depa Billaba and Qui-Gon Jinn to back up Mace Windu after Windu defeats Warlord Guattako's army of kidnapped children.

33 BBY - Discovers Ahsoka Tano

On Shili he finds the three-year-old Togruta Ahsoka Tano, who had just escaped a false Jedi, and brings her to the Jedi Temple. The two stay close for the rest of his life.

~33 BBY - Council mission to Kwenn

Now a Council master, he travels to Kwenn with Saesee Tiin. They settle a labor dispute at Kwikhaul, help rescue a beached oroko, and he coordinates the taxi fleet that evacuates civilians during the pirate attack on the Bicentennial Celebration.

32 BBY - Naboo Crisis

Sits on the Council that doubts the Sith have returned and refuses to let Qui-Gon Jinn train Anakin Skywalker. After Jinn's death he attends the funeral on Naboo.

~22 BBY - Bultar Swan knighted

His Padawan Bultar Swan becomes a Jedi Knight shortly before the war.

22 BBY - First Battle of Geonosis

Joins the 212-member Jedi assault team in the Petranaki Arena, is among the survivors rescued by Yoda and the clone army, and fights in the first battle of the Clone Wars.

22 BBY - Hunting the Malevolence

Leads the 104th Battalion from the Triumphant. The Malevolence's ion cannon disables his fleet at Abregado. He holds out in an escape pod with Wolffe, Sinker and Boost until Anakin and Ahsoka rescue them.

22 BBY - Battle of the Kaliida Nebula

Flies the Blade of Dorin as escort for Shadow Squadron through a neebray herd. The squadron wrecks the Malevolence's ion cannon, and he then helps command the pursuit that ends with the ship's destruction.

21 BBY - Evacuation of Felucia

Leads fighters that break through the Separatist blockade to cover the gunships evacuating Kenobi, Skywalker and Tano's troops.

~21 BBY - Hunt for Boba Fett

Rescues Mace Windu and Anakin from the wreck of the Endurance on Vanqor. With Ahsoka he tracks Aurra Sing to Florrum, captures Boba Fett, and gets the hostages freed.

~21 BBY - Rescue from the Citadel

Briefs the strike team sent to free Even Piell, then leads the fleet to Lola Sayu that extracts the survivors. Afterward he covers for Ahsoka's unauthorized part in the mission.

~20 BBY - Second Battle of Felucia

Leads an assault on a droid outpost with Anakin and Ahsoka. When Trandoshan hunters kidnap Ahsoka, he alerts Republic forces to search for her and later welcomes her home.

~20 BBY - Rescue of Adi Gallia

Leads the Wolfpack aboard General Grievous's ship to free Adi Gallia.

19 BBY - Ahsoka's trial and departure

Sits on the Council that expels Ahsoka after the Temple hangar bombing. Once Barriss Offee is exposed, he and the Council offer to take her back, and she declines.

19 BBY - Battle of Cato Neimoidia

Commands the 442nd Siege Battalion to victory in the last days of the war.

19 BBY - Death during Order 66

While he flies over the bridge cities of Cato Neimoidia, his own ARC-170 wingmen open fire when Order 66 is issued. His starfighter is shot down and he dies in the crash.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Owen_La.description: Owen Lars is best known as the stern uncle who raised Luke Skywalker in hiding on a remote moisture farm. The son of Cliegg Lars, he became Anakin Skywalker's stepbrother when his father freed and married Shmi Skywalker. In 22 BBY he watched that family fall apart: Shmi was taken and killed by Tusken Raiders, Anakin came back in a rage to recover her body, and a grieving Cliegg died soon afterward. Owen then took over the homestead and married Beru Whitesun. In 19 BBY, after some reluctance, he agreed to adopt Anakin's infant son. He believed the Jedi had destroyed his stepbrother, so he spent years keeping Obi-Wan Kenobi away from Luke, hiding the boy's heritage and keeping him busy with farm work. He stood up to the Inquisitor Reva when she came for Luke, and he survived a beating by the bounty hunter Black Krrsantan. His caution could not keep the galaxy out forever. In 1 BBY he bought the droids C-3PO and R2-D2, and stormtroopers hunting the stolen Death Star plans tracked R2-D2 to the farm and killed Owen and Beru. Their deaths sent Luke off with Kenobi toward the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Owen_La.socialDesc: Owen Lars, the gruff Tatooine moisture farmer who raised Luke Skywalker, kept Kenobi at arm's length and was killed by stormtroopers hunting R2-D2.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Owen_La.timeline:
Date unknown - Birth

Owen is born to the moisture farmer Cliegg Lars and his wife Aika, who met on a Core World. After Aika dies, father and son move to the Lars homestead near Anchorhead on Tatooine.

Date unknown - Meeting Beru Whitesun

On a trip to Anchorhead, Owen meets Beru Whitesun, a third-generation moisture farmer, and the two start dating.

Date unknown - A New Stepmother

With the family's help, Cliegg wins Shmi Skywalker from Watto, frees her and marries her. Owen grows to love his stepmother, and he resents the son who left her to join the Jedi.

22 BBY - Shmi's Abduction

Tusken Raiders take Shmi. Cliegg leads a rescue party that goes badly, loses a leg, and comes back with only three other survivors.

22 BBY - Anakin Returns

Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala arrive at the homestead. Anakin borrows Owen's swoop to track the Tuskens, brings back Shmi's body, and the family buries her. Owen comes away seeing his stepbrother as violent and full of anger.

22 BBY - Inheriting the Farm and Marriage

Cliegg dies soon after, heartbroken, and leaves Owen the farm. Owen marries Beru and the couple work the homestead together. They struggle with infertility.

19 BBY - Adopting Luke

Obi-Wan Kenobi gives Owen and Beru Anakin's infant son, Luke. Owen is reluctant, but Beru convinces him, and he forbids Kenobi to visit or train the boy.

~12 BBY - Blaster Lessons

Owen finds seven-year-old Luke outside alone waiting for a meteor shower. He decides the boy needs to learn farm safety and teaches him to use a blaster rifle.

9 BBY - Confronting the Inquisitors

Owen confronts Kenobi in Anchorhead, and then the Third Sister holds him at lightsaber-point in the town square while hunting a Jedi. He gives nothing away.

9 BBY - Defending the Homestead

Warned that the Third Sister is hunting Luke, Owen and Beru fight her at the farm. She eventually spares Luke and brings him back. Afterward Owen makes peace with Kenobi and offers to let him meet the boy someday.

Date unknown - The Great Drought

During a severe drought, Kenobi secretly shields the farm from Jabba's water-tax collectors and rescues Luke after the boy sneaks out to steal water.

Date unknown - Krrsantan's Captive

A year after the drought, Owen angrily tells Kenobi to stop interfering. The Wookiee bounty hunter Krrsantan then kidnaps and tortures Owen. Kenobi and Luke, flying the repaired skyhopper, save him.

~7 BBY - Proud Uncle

Owen tells Beru that twelve-year-old Luke is like a son to him and says he will not let him join the Imperial Academy. After Kenobi rescues Luke from a krayt dragon, Owen thanks him but warns him never to come back.

1 BBY - Buying the Droids

Owen buys C-3PO and R2-D2 from Jawas. He tells Luke that Obi-Wan died around the same time as his father and makes him wait another year to enroll at the Academy.

1 BBY - Death

Stormtroopers searching for the stolen Death Star plans track R2-D2 to the homestead. They interrogate and kill Owen and Beru and burn the farm. The loss pushes Luke to leave Tatooine with Kenobi.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Marrok.description: Marrok is best known as the silent, armored duelist who fought Ahsoka Tano twice during Morgan Elsbeth's plot to bring back Grand Admiral Thrawn. He was raised in the Jedi Order, but after the Jedi Purge he became an Inquisitor for the Empire under the title First Brother. He knelt before Darth Vader when the Inquisitorius was presented to its new master on Nur. A few years later, he and the Eleventh Brother hunted Maul and the fugitive Jedi Eeko-Dio Daki and Devon Izara across Janix. Using his rare gift of psychometry, he tracked his prey and met Maul blade to blade more than once, until Daki pushed him off a ruined structure into the jungle. He survived the fall of the Empire and became a mercenary for Elsbeth, working alongside Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati. In 9 ABY he held off Ahsoka at the Corellian shipyards while Elsbeth's forces stole a hyperdrive core. He then flew with Hati against Ahsoka's shuttle over Seatos. In the forests below, Ahsoka struck him down. His armor released a shrieking green mist and collapsed empty, which left his true nature a mystery. Decades later, historians could not agree whether the figure in the Corellian recordings had really been an Inquisitor.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Marrok.socialDesc: Marrok, the First Brother, was a fallen Jedi turned Inquisitor who hunted Maul on Janix, then served Morgan Elsbeth until Ahsoka Tano cut him down.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Marrok.timeline:
Before 19 BBY - Member of the Jedi Order

Marrok is raised in the Jedi Order. The dates of his birth and his time as a Jedi are not recorded in canon.

19 BBY - Becomes the First Brother

After Order 66, Marrok is chosen for the Inquisitorius and given the title First Brother. His job is to hunt the Jedi who survived the Purge.

19 BBY - Presented to Darth Vader

In the Fortress Inquisitorius on Nur, he kneels with the Eleventh Brother, the Fourth Sister and Barriss Offee as the Grand Inquisitor presents them to their new master, Darth Vader.

~18 BBY - The Hunt for Maul on Janix

After Janix's Tactical Defense Force calls in the Empire, the First Brother arrives and interrogates Chief Klyce and Captain Brander Lawson. He then uses psychometry to read the aftermath of Maul's fight with two hidden Jedi.

~18 BBY - Clashes with Daki, Izara and Maul

He attacks Eeko-Dio Daki and Devon Izara at Lawson's home. He later chases Izara onto a hovertrain, where Maul joins the fight and the two cut him loose in a tunnel. He reports to Vader that Maul is more dangerous than expected.

~18 BBY - Duel with Maul Beside the Eleventh Brother

Joined by the Eleventh Brother, he duels Maul in the caverns of Janix, and the two Inquisitors kill the Nightbrother Scorn. Maul escapes by bringing the cave down on them, and they are pulled from the rubble.

~18 BBY - Chase Across Janix

He survives an ambush that goes wrong when the informant Rheena Sul turns on the Empire. He follows the fugitives across the city, destroys Maul's droid Spybot during a duel over a lake of acid, and warns Vader that the group is headed his way.

~18 BBY - Defeated by Eeko-Dio Daki

In jungle ruins, he and the Eleventh Brother corner Izara, then fight her and Daki together. Daki pushes the First Brother off the ruins into the jungle, but he survives.

9 ABY - Mercenary for Morgan Elsbeth

Now a mercenary, Marrok serves Morgan Elsbeth alongside Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati. He searches the ruins on Arcana with Skoll for the star map to Peridea.

9 ABY - Duel on Corellia

At the Santhe Shipyards, he duels Ahsoka Tano with the help of an HK-87 assassin droid while Elsbeth's forces steal a hyperdrive core for the Eye of Sion. Shin Hati picks him up once the transport has escaped.

9 ABY - Dogfight in the Denab System

Flying his Fiend fighter in Hati's squadron, he attacks Ahsoka's T-6 shuttle and chases it through a pod of purrgil down to Seatos.

9 ABY - Death on Seatos

Sent with Hati to delay Ahsoka and Sabine Wren in the forest, Marrok duels Ahsoka a final time and is cut down. Green mist bursts from his armor, which collapses empty.

35 ABY - An Uncertain Legacy

In The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire, the historian Beaumont Kin studies the Corellian security recordings and cannot confirm whether the armored figure was a real Inquisitor.

notes.detail: Marrok, as the First Brother, appears in the Tales of the Empire episode 'Devoted', kneeling before Darth Vader at the Fortress Inquisitorius alongside Barriss Offee, the Fourth Sister and the Eleventh Brother (Wookieepedia's image file is 'FirstBrotherEleventhBrotherKneel-Devoted').

No birth year exists in canon, so flagging it as a guess is correct. The only constraint is that he was a Jedi before 19 BBY. 50 BBY is plausible, and anything up to about 30 BBY would fit equally well.

Wookieepedia notes that another Inquisitor, the Eleventh Brother, was at one point mistakenly identified as the First Brother. Keep this in mind if you add the Eleventh Brother or link the Shadow Lord material. Marrok's nature is also unresolved: when he died, his armor released green mist and fell empty, which fans read as a Nightsister magick connection, but canon has not explained it.
If the data supports episode-level detail, his death happens in Part Four: Fallen Jedi.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rotta.description: Jabba the Hutt's only son, Rotta is best remembered as the sickly Huttlet whose kidnapping early in the Clone Wars became a Separatist plot to turn the Hutts against the Republic. Count Dooku arranged the abduction with Rotta's great-uncle Ziro, and Asajj Ventress carried it out, holding the infant on Teth so the Jedi could be framed for his death. Anakin Skywalker and his new Padawan Ahsoka Tano fought their way into the B'omarr Monastery to rescue him. Ahsoka, who nicknamed him "Stinky," nursed him through a dangerous fever and carried him across the Tatooine desert while Anakin led Dooku away. Returning Rotta safely won Jabba's alliance and secured Republic access to Hutt hyperspace routes. Rotta stayed at his father's palace for the rest of the war. Decades later, after Jabba's death left him heir to the family's criminal empire, he turned his back on that legacy. He grew into a huge, muscular gladiator and became a crowd favorite in the fighting pits of Shakari while working off a debt to the Imperial warlord Janu Coin. When his scheming relatives, the Twins, sent Din Djarin and Grogu to bring him in, Rotta first fought the Mandalorian. Once Coin tried to have him killed, the two became allies and escaped the arena together.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rotta.socialDesc: Rotta the Hutt, Jabba's son, went from a kidnapped Huttlet rescued by Anakin and Ahsoka to a gladiator champion who refused his father's criminal empire.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rotta.timeline:
~32 BBY - Birth

Rotta is born to Jabba the Hutt of the Desilijic kajidic. Jabba tells the young bounty hunter Greedo that he has recently become a father.

~32 BBY - A Wookiee Toymaker

Hoping to impress Jabba, Greedo brings him a captured Wookiee named Brewhada. Jabba makes Brewhada the infant Rotta's personal toymaker, and he crafts toys for the Huttlet, including a plush Wookiee.

22 BBY - Kidnapped by Ventress

During the Clone Wars, Asajj Ventress snatches Rotta from Jabba's sail barge, the Khetanna, with a Trident-class assault ship. The plot is Count Dooku's, aided by Rotta's great-uncle Ziro, and Rotta is locked in a cell at the B'omarr Monastery on Teth.

22 BBY - Rescue on Teth

After the Battle of Christophsis, Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano and Torrent Company storm the monastery and find the sick Huttlet. The droid 4-A7 secretly records the Jedi so the rescue can be passed off as a kidnapping.

22 BBY - Escape from the Monastery

Trapped by Ventress and Separatist droids, Rotta points the Jedi to a distant landing platform. From there they escape Teth aboard the freighter Twilight.

22 BBY - Fever Broken

With the Republic cruiser's hangar destroyed, the Jedi head straight for Tatooine. On the way, Ahsoka gives Rotta a medical booster that breaks his life-threatening fever.

22 BBY - Returned to Jabba

After the Twilight crash-lands on Tatooine, Anakin draws Dooku away with a decoy backpack while Ahsoka fights MagnaGuards and delivers Rotta to his father. Padmé Amidala exposes Ziro's role, and Jabba allies with the Republic.

21 BBY - Papanoida at the Palace

Rotta is at Jabba's palace when Baron Papanoida and his son Ion come looking for Greedo, who has kidnapped the Baron's daughters. Rotta smashes a slug-beetle and eats it.

4 ABY - Heir to the Empire

Jabba dies during the rescue of Han Solo, leaving Rotta sole heir to his criminal empire. This angers his relatives, the Hutt crime lords known as the Twins, and Rotta rejects the inheritance to become his own man.

New Republic Era - Champion of Shakari

Now fully grown and heavily muscled, Rotta owes a debt to the Imperial warlord Janu Coin and must fight in Coin's gladiatorial pits on Shakari. Crowds first jeer Jabba's son, but they come to cheer him as he keeps winning.

New Republic Era - Hunted by the Mandalorian

The Twins make a deal with the New Republic to have Din Djarin and Grogu find Rotta, secretly planning to kill him. Rotta turns the Mandalorian away, insisting he has no interest in leaving Shakari or taking over the family business.

New Republic Era - Freedom in the Arena

Coin sets Rotta against Djarin, who lets the Hutt win. Coin then unleashes dejarik beasts to kill Rotta, and the two fight side by side. Rotta short-circuits the arena's electric fence, the beasts pour into the stands, and the chaos lets them escape.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox gives 'c. 32 BBY'. The circa date comes from Rotta being roughly ten years old when he was kidnapped in 22 BBY (StarWars.com, 'An Ode to Rotta', August 20, 2026, which also fits Hyperspace Stories). No source gives an exact birth year.

death.source: Rotta is alive at the end of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu (New Republic Era). No canon death.

notes.detail: Wookieepedia only gives 'c. 32 BBY'. The year is worked back from a stated age of about ten at the 22 BBY kidnapping, and no source states it outright. We should mark it as a guess or show it as approximate.

A 2018 StarWars.com Clone Wars Rewatch post says Rotta was 55 during the Clone Wars film and left the brood pouch five years earlier, which would put his birth around 77 BBY. A newer StarWars.com article (August 20, 2026) says he was 'just about ten', and Hyperspace Stories 6 shows him newborn around Greedo's early career. Wookieepedia follows the newer source and treats the 2018 age as an error.

Canon gives no exact year for the Mandalorian and Grogu events. Wookieepedia's infobox labels the adult image 'c. 14 ABY', but that is only an image-era label, not a sourced event date, so the timeline uses 'New Republic Era'. Check this if a reference book pins down the film's year.
Ahsoka's nickname for him ('Stinky') appears on screen and is widely recognized. Jabba also calls him 'Pedunkee Mufkin' (Punky Muffin).

notes.suggested: switch to the adult image only in the New Republic Era (after 4 ABY)
notes.detail: Canon shows Rotta grown only in the New Republic Era, after Jabba's death in 4 ABY. At 1 ABY he would be about 33, still young for a Hutt, so the adult image cutover is early and has no source.
His parentage is the core of both story arcs. Ziro (great-uncle) and the Twins are also relatives worth linking.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Tobias_.description: Tobias Beckett was the veteran thief and gunslinger who took a young Han Solo under his wing, then betrayed him, and taught him the hard way that nobody in the underworld can be trusted. A career criminal working for the Crimson Dawn syndicate in the early years of the Empire, Beckett ran a small crew with his lover Val and the pilot Rio Durant. He was notorious for the death of the bounty hunter Aurra Sing, though he claimed he only pushed her and the fall did the rest. While posing as an Imperial captain during the Mimban campaign, he crossed paths with Solo, first jailing him and then taking him and Chewbacca aboard. The botched coaxium heist on Vandor cost Beckett both Val and Rio. To make up the loss to Dryden Vos, he led a daring raid on the Kessel spice mines aboard the Millennium Falcon. On Savareen he sold out Solo's plan to Vos, then turned on Vos too and tried to take the coaxium for himself. Solo shot him before he could draw. Dying in his protégé's arms, Beckett told him he had finally made the smart move, and admitted that he had meant to go home to Glee Anselm and learn to play the valachord.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Tobias_.socialDesc: Tobias Beckett, the Crimson Dawn thief who mentored a young Han Solo, taught him to trust no one, then betrayed him and was shot by him on Savareen.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Tobias_.timeline:
Date unknown - Birth on Glee Anselm

Tobias Beckett is born on Glee Anselm. Canon gives no birth year.

~13 BBY - Death of Aurra Sing

Beckett pushes the feared bounty hunter Aurra Sing to her death, and the kill makes his name across the underworld.

~10 BBY - Cato Neimoidia Job

Beckett's crew steals a crate from a freight platform in Zarra. Val finds Qi'ra's old logbook inside, and the gang plans to hit a conveyex carrying Crimson Dawn cargo.

~10 BBY - Heist on Hovun IV

Beckett poses as a death priest and steals identichips from Dvorad for Crimson Dawn. Enfys Nest ambushes him on Munt Ontdal, and he blows up the chips and his ship, the Rampart, so the Cloud-Riders can't have them.

10 BBY - Undercover on Mimban

Disguised as an Imperial Army captain, Beckett ends up leading mudtroopers in battle. He has the deserter Han Solo jailed, then takes Solo and Chewbacca aboard a stolen AT-hauler.

10 BBY - Heist on Vandor

The plan to steal coaxium from an Imperial conveyex falls apart when the Cloud-Riders attack. Val and Rio Durant die, the cargo is lost, and Beckett builds grave markers for his fallen crew.

10 BBY - Deal with Dryden Vos

Beckett avoids execution by promising Vos unrefined coaxium from Kessel. As part of the deal, he has to take Qi'ra onto his crew.

10 BBY - Raid on Kessel

Posing as a guard named Tuul, Beckett helps steal coaxium from the Pyke mines. The crew escapes on Lando Calrissian's Millennium Falcon.

10 BBY - Death on Savareen

Beckett tells Vos about Solo's plan to give the coaxium to the Cloud-Riders, then abandons Vos and tries to take the coaxium himself. Solo shoots him, and Beckett dies admitting that Solo made the smart move.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's infobox has an empty birth field. It gives Glee Anselm as his birthplace but no year, and no canon source dates his birth. Our -55 is correctly flagged as a guess.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 10 BBY on Savareen (Solo: A Star Wars Story).

notes.detail: Canon gives no birth year, so the guess flag is right. For reference, Woody Harrelson was about 56 when Solo was filmed, and the character reads as middle-aged to older, with graying hair. A year around -60 to -65 might look more natural, but no source supports any specific year.
Wookieepedia lists Crimson Dawn (and his own gang) as his affiliation. He worked for the syndicate for his whole on-screen career.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jyn_Ers.description: Jyn Erso is best remembered as the leader of Rogue One, the small band of rebels who stole the Death Star plans at the Battle of Scarif and so made the Rebel victory at Yavin possible. She was the daughter of scientist Galen Erso and his wife Lyra. Her early childhood was spent on the move: she was born in a Separatist prison, spent the last days of the Clone Wars on Coruscant and Lokori, and then lived inside the Empire's kyber research program until her parents fled to the remote farm world of Lah'mu. When she was eight, Orson Krennic found the family there. He killed her mother and took her father back to work on the Death Star. Saw Gerrera rescued Jyn and raised her as a child soldier among his Partisans, where she learned to fight and forge codes. At sixteen he abandoned her on Tamsye Prime to protect her identity. She briefly found a new family with the Pontas on Skuhl, but lost them to an Imperial crackdown. After that she survived for years as a forger, smuggler and petty criminal under a string of aliases, until she was sent to the Wobani labor camp. The Rebel Alliance freed her so she could reach Saw on Jedha. There she learned that her father had secretly built a fatal flaw into the Death Star, and she then watched him die on Eadu. When the Alliance Council refused to act, she and Cassian Andor took a volunteer squad to Scarif. Jyn transmitted the plans to the Rebel fleet, and she and Cassian died together when the Death Star's blast engulfed the base.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jyn_Ers.socialDesc: Jyn Erso, Galen Erso's daughter raised by Saw Gerrera, led Rogue One to steal the Death Star plans on Scarif and died there before the Battle of Yavin.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jyn_Ers.timeline:
21 BBY - Birth on Vallt

Born to Galen and Lyra Erso inside the Separatist Tambolor prison on Vallt, where her father was being held for refusing to help the Confederacy.

~20 BBY - Rescue to Coruscant

About six months old when Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic of the Republic extracts the family and brings them to the Institute of Applied Science on Coruscant.

~20 BBY - Move to Lokori

The family relocates to Lokori after Krennic arranges for Galen to take a position with Helical HyperCom.

19 BBY - Battle on Lokori

Trapped with her parents as Separatist droids overrun the Helical HyperCom facility, the family survives only because the droids shut down when the Clone Wars end.

~19 BBY - Life inside Project Celestial Power

Grows up in the project complex on Coruscant, mostly in the care of the nanny droid Mac-Vee, while her father's kyber research is secretly turned toward a superweapon.

~18 BBY - Trip to Alpinn

At age three, travels with her mother, Has Obitt and Nari Sable to an archaeological dig on Alpinn.

~17 BBY - Flight from Coruscant

At four, escapes the Empire with her parents aboard Saw Gerrera's ship and helps choose Lah'mu as their hiding place.

~17–13 BBY - Childhood on Lah'mu

Grows up on an isolated skycorn farm, taught at home by her mother and drilled in the family's emergency plans.

13 BBY - Loss of her parents

Krennic and his death troopers arrive at the homestead. Lyra is killed, Galen is taken away, and Jyn hides in the family's bunker until Saw Gerrera comes to rescue her.

~13 BBY - Taken in by Saw Gerrera

Brought to Saw's hidden outpost on Wrea and trained there in blasters, truncheons, hand-to-hand combat and forging codes.

~10 BBY - Meeting Enfys Nest

At eleven, goes with Saw to meet Enfys Nest and the Cloud-Riders, who offer him coaxium for the fight against the Empire.

~9 BBY - Meeting Arhul Nemo

At twelve, meets Arhul Nemo of the Commenor Underground.

~9–5 BBY - Partisan missions

Takes part in Partisan operations, including her first solo mission to Horuz and the massacre on Inusagi, where her friend Maia is killed.

~5 BBY - Abandoned on Tamsye Prime

At sixteen, after Reece Tallent betrays a mission, Saw leaves her hidden in a bunker and never returns. She escapes the planet on her own.

~5 BBY - Life on Skuhl

Taken in by freighter captain Akshaya Ponta. On Skuhl she begins a relationship with Akshaya's son, Hadder.

~4 BBY - Escape from Skuhl

Stormtroopers raid the Ponta home and the family flees. Hadder and Akshaya die when their freighter is destroyed, and Jyn reaches Five Points station alone.

~4 BBY - Forger for Lucka Solange

On Five Points, she is pressed into forging casino credits for Imperial Commander Lucka Solange.

~4–1 BBY - Years as a criminal

Drifts across the galaxy as a forger, smuggler and petty criminal under aliases such as Liana Hallik and Tanith Ponta. On Garel she rescues a girl's tooka-cat from stormtroopers.

1 BBY - Imprisoned on Wobani

Arrested as "Liana Hallik" and sentenced to twenty years at the Wobani labor camp. She helps Dunning Tredup's crew escape but gives herself up to save Theera.

1 BBY - Freed by the Rebellion

Freed during a prisoner transfer by a Rebel team including K-2SO, and recruited by Mon Mothma and Cassian Andor to find Saw Gerrera.

1 BBY - Jedha

Reunites with Saw on Jedha and sees her father's message about the Death Star's hidden flaw, just before the Death Star destroys Jedha City.

1 BBY - Eadu

Reaches her father on Eadu only to see him mortally wounded in a Rebel airstrike. He dies in her arms.

1 BBY - Rogue One

After the Alliance Council refuses to act, she and Cassian lead a volunteer squad to Scarif under the call sign Rogue One.

1 BBY - Death on Scarif

Steals the Death Star plans from the Citadel and transmits them to the Rebel fleet. She dies beside Cassian Andor when the Death Star fires on Scarif.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox: born 21 BBY, Vallt (Tambolor prison), per Rogue One: Catalyst and the Rogue One novelization.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 1 BBY, Scarif (Rogue One: A Star Wars Story; Galactic Atlas dating).

notes.current: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
notes.suggested: Add Star Wars: Forces of Destiny
notes.detail: Jyn appears in the Forces of Destiny short "The Strangers", where she rescues a tooka-cat on Garel. Her voice (archival audio) is also heard in the Star Wars Rebels episode "A World Between Worlds". That is only a voice cameo, so it is optional whether to count it as an appearance.
Galen's nickname for her is canon and prominent in the film. She also used several aliases, most notably Liana Hallik, the name she was arrested and imprisoned under on Wobani.

Wookieepedia marks the article with a Conflicting tag: Rebel Rising and the Rogue One novelization disagree on details of her backstory. Her age in 1 BBY is also muddled. Wookieepedia says her rap sheet dates to when she was twenty-one, and that the Imperials put her at about twenty-two but were a year off. A 21 BBY birth would make her 20 at her arrest. The birth and death years themselves are not in dispute, but the ages given in the middle of her life are, so the years in her teens (Tamsye Prime at 16, Skuhl, Five Points) are estimates.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Luthen_.description: The hidden architect of the early Rebellion, Luthen Rael spent nearly two decades running a secret spy network against the Empire while posing as a refined antiques dealer on Coruscant. Born under the name Lear, he served as an Imperial Army sergeant until he was ordered to take part in a massacre around 18 BBY. Sickened by it, he deserted and took with him a young survivor he named Kleya Marki, who grew up to be his second-in-command. From about 15 BBY he built the web of operatives, informants and financiers that the ISB would come to call "Axis." Mon Mothma's money funded it, he armed Saw Gerrera's Partisans, and he ran a mole, Lonni Jung, inside the ISB itself. In 5 BBY he recruited Cassian Andor from Ferrix and sent him on the Aldhani heist, a raid meant to provoke the Empire into a crackdown that would turn people against it. Rael was ruthless. He let Anto Kreegyr's fighters walk into a trap to protect his source, had Tay Kolma eliminated, and shot Jung once his cover was blown. When Dedra Meero finally identified him in 1 BBY, he stabbed himself rather than be captured. Imperial medics kept him alive for interrogation, but Kleya slipped into the hospital and let him die. Before his fall he had passed Jung's warning about Krennic's secret weapon to the Alliance, and the Rebellion he had sacrificed everything for went on to win without him.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Luthen_.socialDesc: Luthen Rael, the Imperial deserter turned antique dealer, secretly ran the Axis spy network that built the Rebellion and died on Coruscant in 1 BBY.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Luthen_.timeline:
~18 BBY - Massacre and Desertion

Lear, an Imperial Army sergeant from Fondor serving as a swamp trooper, has a crisis of conscience during a massacre. He deserts and takes with him a young survivor he later names Kleya Marki.

~16 BBY - Bombing on Naboo

Now calling himself Luthen Rael, he stages one of his first attacks, bombing an Imperial convoy on Naboo. Kleya is with him, but at the last moment he presses the detonator himself.

15 BBY - Foundations of a Movement

Rael starts building a counter-Imperial movement, knowing it will cost him any ordinary life.

~10 BBY - Galactic Antiquities

He opens Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest on Coruscant as a cover. The gallery gives him access to the elite, and he cultivates allies such as Mon Mothma, Saw Gerrera and the ISB mole Lonni Jung.

5 BBY - Recruiting Cassian Andor

Rael goes to Ferrix to buy a stolen Starpath unit and instead recruits Cassian Andor. The two fight their way past Preox-Morlana security to escape.

5 BBY - The Aldhani Heist

He places Andor on Vel Sartha's team, which robs the Aldhani Garrison of a sector's payroll. Afterward he tells Mon Mothma the point was to provoke the Empire into cracking down harder.

5 BBY - The Spellhaus Sacrifice

Jung warns him that the ISB has set a trap for Anto Kreegyr's attack on Spellhaus. Rael refuses to let Jung quit, persuades Saw Gerrera to let Kreegyr's group be wiped out so the mole stays hidden, and escapes an Imperial Arrestor cruiser on the way out.

5 BBY - Ferrix Uprising

He returns to Ferrix intending to kill Andor at Maarva Andor's funeral. Instead, after the riot, he accepts Andor into the rebellion.

4 BBY - Mothma Family Wedding

Rael attends Leida Mothma's wedding on Chandrila as the curator of a gift. While there he has Cinta Kaz eliminate Tay Kolma, who had become a security risk.

3 BBY - Ghorman Intrigue

Rael sends Andor to assess the Ghorman Front. When Andor turns the job down, Rael sends Vel Sartha and Cinta Kaz in his place. With Kleya's help he also removes the listening device from Davo Sculdun's collection during the Senate Investiture party.

2 BBY - Ghorman Massacre and Mothma's Escape

Rael sends Andor to kill Dedra Meero on Ghorman, but the attempt fails amid the massacre. He then warns Mothma that Bail Organa's extraction team has been compromised and arranges for Andor to get her off Coruscant.

1 BBY - Killing Lonni Jung

Jung tells him about Krennic's secret weapon project and Galen Erso. Rael then shoots Jung and passes the intelligence to Kleya to send on to the Alliance.

1 BBY - Death on Coruscant

Cornered by Dedra Meero in his gallery, Rael stabs himself. Imperial medics keep him alive at Lina Soh Hospital, but Kleya infiltrates the building and disconnects his life support, and he dies.

birth.source: Wookieepedia's birth field is empty, and no canon source gives a birth year. He was already an adult Imperial Army sergeant around 18 BBY, so he was born well before about 38 BBY. Our 58 BBY guess is plausible, but canon does not confirm it.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 1 BBY on Coruscant, as depicted in Andor Season 2 ("Make It Stop"), where Kleya Marki disconnects his life support at Lina Soh Hospital.

notes.detail: The ISB code name "Axis" is his best-known second identity in Andor. Canon also gives his birth name as Lear, which is revealed in Season 2.

notes.suggested: Birth name: Lear; Affiliation: Imperial Army (deserter), Axis network, Rebel Alliance
notes.detail: Wookieepedia lists his birth name as Lear and his affiliations as the Imperial Army, the Axis network and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
No canon birth year exists. The only constraint is that he was an adult sergeant around 18 BBY. Keeping the guess flag is correct.

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Amilyn_.description: Amilyn Holdo is remembered for the Holdo maneuver, the lightspeed ramming attack that tore through the First Order fleet above Crait and let the last of the Resistance escape. She started out as a flamboyant, astrology-loving teenage delegate to the Imperial Apprentice Legislature. There she spoke out against Imperial policy and became Leia Organa's closest friend. She helped Leia warn Bail Organa of the Imperial strike on the rebel fleet at Paucris, and she was with Leia when Kier Domadi died. Once the Galactic Civil War broke out in earnest, Holdo joined the Rebel Alliance as a civil minister. She proved herself a commander when she took over the stricken blockade runner Candor and broke it free of a Star Destroyer's tractor beam, which earned her a captain's commission. After that she secured fuel and supplies through underworld contacts, including Crimson Dawn. Decades later Leia recruited her into the Resistance as a vice admiral. She commanded the cruiser Ninka on covert missions and bomber campaigns during the cold war with the First Order. After the Resistance leadership was wiped out in 34 ABY, she took command of the fleet as it fled. Her secretive escape plan clashed with Poe Dameron, and when it was betrayed she stayed aboard the Raddus and jumped it into the Supremacy. She gave her life to save the Resistance.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Amilyn_.socialDesc: Amilyn Holdo, Leia Organa's eccentric rebel friend turned Resistance vice admiral, died ramming the Raddus through the First Order fleet at Crait.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Amilyn_.timeline:
~19 BBY - Birth on Gatalenta

Born on Gatalenta around the start of the Empire's reign. As a child she took to spelunking, tobogganing, skyfaring, astrology and philosophy, and she pushed back against her homeworld's traditions of quiet simplicity.

3 BBY - Pathfinding on Alderaan

Takes part in Queen Breha Organa's pathfinding class in the Istabith range. She turns her emergency tent into a toboggan so her group can bring an injured Harp Allor back before nightfall, and meets Leia Organa and Kier Domadi.

3 BBY - Apprentice Legislator

Represents Gatalenta in the Apprentice Legislature on Coruscant. She is horrified when the Arreyel vote leads to its people being displaced, and she argues against sanctions on Lolet, which wins her Leia's trust.

3 BBY - Stowaways to Ocahont

On Pamarthe, she and Leia overhear Senator Winmey Lenz's secret quadanium deal and stow away on a freighter to Ocahont. Leia tells her about the rebellion, and they meet Mon Mothma at a rebel outpost.

3 BBY - Warning at Paucris

Gives up her chartered ship so she and Leia can warn Bail Organa about an Imperial attack on the rebel fleet at Paucris. She watches Kier Domadi die, flies her grieving friend home to Alderaan, and bluffs past Imperial patrols with her astrology knowledge.

~3 BBY - Leia's Investiture and the Lost Museum

Attends Leia's investiture as crown princess and begins working for the rebellion in secret. Later, she and Leia go deep into Coruscant's underworld to find a lost museum on Level 4.

1 BBY - Rebel Minister

Leaves Imperial politics when open war breaks out and becomes a minister in the Alliance Civil Government, known for her anti-Imperial speeches.

~1 BBY–3 ABY - Commanding the Candor

After a Star Destroyer attack kills the Candor's captain, she takes command and fires through the enemy hangar to break free of its tractor beam. The feat earns her a captain's commission in the Alliance Fleet.

3 ABY - Crimson Dawn Intelligence

While working the underworld for supplies, she learns that Crimson Dawn has returned and is auctioning Han Solo on Jekara. She sends Leia the information through a dead drop, then coordinates supply lines with Qi'ra during the Syndicate War.

~3–4 ABY - Auction on Spira

Brings Leia, Luke, Chewbacca and Lando to Spira to bid on a Nihil strikeship whose Path engine could lead to the lost Kezarat convoy's fuel. After losing the bid, the group steals the engine and flees in her ship Skyfarer, which is pulled into No-Space.

5 ABY - Galactic Concordance

The Alliance wins the Galactic Civil War, and the New Republic is founded.

~28 ABY - Joining the Resistance

Leia recruits her into the Resistance. She becomes a vice admiral of the fleet and takes command of the cruiser Ninka.

Before 31 ABY - Brooksdion Station

Leads a covert team that steals Admiral Mathieson's protocol droid head as evidence of New Republic inaction. She guides her pursuer, Poe Dameron, through the Lost Souls asteroid field without revealing who she is.

34 ABY - Battle of Sheh Soahi

Leads Cobalt and Crimson bomber squadrons against pirates acting as a First Order proxy in the Cassander sector, confirming that the First Order was arming them.

34 ABY - Atterra Campaign

Helps plan the covert relief bombing runs to Atterra Bravo with Leia and Casca Panzoro, and recruits Rose Tico to teach the Ninka's crew her baffler technology.

34 ABY - Evacuation of D'Qar

After the Hosnian Cataclysm, she brings the Ninka and the bomber force to cover the evacuation of D'Qar and escapes with the fleet after the Fulminatrix is destroyed.

34 ABY - Acting Commander of the Resistance

With Leia badly injured and Admiral Ackbar killed, she takes command of the fleet as it is tracked through hyperspace and runs low on fuel. She clashes with Poe Dameron over her secret plan to evacuate to Crait on cloaked transports.

34 ABY - The Holdo Maneuver and Death

After Poe's mutiny fails and her plan is betrayed to the First Order, she stays alone on the Raddus. She jumps it to lightspeed into the Supremacy, splitting the flagship and wrecking much of the fleet. She dies in the collision, and the survivors escape to Crait.

birth.source: The Wookieepedia infobox leaves birth blank and says only that she was born around the early days of the Empire. Leia, Princess of Alderaan puts her in the Apprentice Legislature in 3 BBY with Leia (born 19 BBY), so ~19 BBY is a reasonable estimate.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox: died 34 ABY aboard the Raddus in the Crait system (Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi).

https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/IG-11.description: IG-11 is the killer-turned-caretaker of The Mandalorian. He was a Bounty Hunters' Guild assassin droid with a built-in self-destruct charge, and in 9 ABY he teamed up with Din Djarin to storm a Nikto encampment on Arvala-7. When they found their target, the infant Grogu, IG-11 moved to carry out his order to terminate him, and Djarin shot him down. The Ugnaught farmer Kuiil salvaged the wreck and patiently retrained it into a gentle nurse droid whose new purpose was to nurse and protect. After Kuiil was killed on Nevarro, IG-11 rescued Grogu from Imperial scout troopers and rode into Nevarro City to break his companions out of a siege. He also treated Djarin's wounds, becoming the first to see the Mandalorian's face without breaking his creed. He then walked into a lava river and self-destructed to wipe out the stormtrooper platoon waiting in ambush, and Nevarro honored him with a statue. Djarin's first attempt to revive him failed when the droid's old assassin programming came back. The Anzellan droidsmiths turned his remains into IG-12, a mech that Grogu piloted in the battle to reclaim Mandalore. Afterward Djarin traded work for the New Republic for a replacement IG head, and IG-11 was rebuilt once more and installed as Nevarro's new marshal.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/IG-11.socialDesc: IG-11, the Guild assassin droid reprogrammed as Grogu's nurse, gave his life on Nevarro in 9 ABY and was later rebuilt to serve as the planet's marshal.
https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/IG-11.timeline:
Before or during the Galactic Civil War - Built by Holowan Mechanicals

IG-11 is built as an IG-series assassin droid in a Holowan Mechanicals factory, with a self-destruct mechanism to protect the design from capture.

Before 9 ABY - Joins the Bounty Hunters' Guild

He becomes a Guild bounty hunter and assassin, programmed to follow Guild protocols.

9 ABY - Hunt for the Asset on Arvala-7

IG-11 takes a contract to terminate a Force-sensitive infant, attacks a Nikto encampment and reluctantly teams up with Din Djarin to take the compound.

9 ABY - Shot Down by Din Djarin

When IG-11 raises his blaster to kill Grogu, Djarin shoots him in the head and takes the child.

9 ABY - Rebuilt by Kuiil

Kuiil salvages the droid and slowly retrains him. With his memory wiped, IG-11 learns to tend blurrgs, cook and serve tea, and takes on a caring new personality.

9 ABY - Journey to Nevarro

Djarin reluctantly lets IG-11 come along on the Razor Crest for the mission to Nevarro. The droid stays aboard the ship to guard it.

9 ABY - Rescue of Grogu

After Kuiil is killed, IG-11 overpowers the scout troopers who took Grogu, steals a speeder bike and fights his way through Nevarro City to the besieged cantina.

9 ABY - Saving the Mandalorian

He cuts an escape route into the sewers, refuses Djarin's request for a warrior's death, and treats his head wound with bacta. As a droid, he can remove Djarin's helmet without breaking his creed.

9 ABY - Sacrifice at the Lava River

Facing a stormtrooper ambush at the end of the lava river, IG-11 says goodbye to Grogu, wades through the lava and self-destructs, wiping out the platoon.

9 ABY - Memorial Statue

The people of Nevarro City build a statue in the market square to honor him, partly from his recovered parts.

9 ABY - Failed Revival

Djarin takes the remains from the statue and powers them up, but IG-11 reverts to his assassin programming and goes after Grogu. CU-28 destroys him again with a bust of Greef Karga.

9 ABY - Anzellan Workshop

The Anzellan droidsmiths cannot restore him without a new IG memory circuit, and none can be found. Djarin takes R5-D4 instead.

9 ABY - Repurposed as IG-12

The Anzellans strip the body to its basic motor functions and turn it into IG-12, a mech Grogu pilots. IG-12 is destroyed during the battle to reclaim Mandalore.

9 ABY - Marshal of Nevarro

Using an IG head that Djarin gets from Carson Teva in return for working with the New Republic, IG-11 is rebuilt from the IG-12 remains and introduced to cheering crowds as Nevarro's new marshal.

birth.source: Wookieepedia infobox: 'Before or during the Galactic Civil War' in an unidentified Holowan Mechanicals factory. Canon gives no year.

death.source: Wookieepedia infobox lists three destructions in 9 ABY: on Arvala-7 (Chapter 1), on Nevarro by self-destruct (Chapter 8), and on Nevarro again (Chapter 17), with the remains then turned into IG-12. Each time he was rebuilt. Chapter 24: The Return ends with him restored and serving as Marshal of Nevarro, so he has no final death in canon.

notes.current: endYear 9 presented as a known death (endYearUnknown absent)
notes.suggested: endYearUnknown: true (keep endYear 9 as the last point we draw)
notes.detail: IG-11 is not permanently dead. After the Chapter 8 self-destruct, Chapter 24: The Return (Season 3 finale) rebuilds him from the IG-12 remains with a replacement head and makes him Marshal of Nevarro. He is alive at his last appearance.
He does not die for good in The Mandalorian, so no death event should be recorded. If you keep the field, the destruction everyone remembers is Chapter 8: Redemption, but he returns in Chapter 24.
Canon only says he was built 'before or during the Galactic Civil War.' The guess is labeled correctly and is plausible. There is no canon year to swap in.

notes.detail: In Season 3, IG-11's body became IG-12, and he was later restored as Nevarro's marshal. Both are major, well-known parts of his story.
